title: The Fugitive (1948-08-15)
plotSynopsis: A celebrated thief escapes from prison in southern France and turns the pursuit by detective L'Amir into a contest of vanity and wits. As fear and obsession distort everyone around him, he realizes he cannot truly defeat the hunter who has come to represent fate itself; rather than be dragged down by the manhunt, he stages his own theatrical surrender by stepping into the empty frame of a great portrait and drawing back the curtains.

title: SS San Pedro (1948-08-22)
plotSynopsis: During a violent storm, a ship's first officer struggles with a dangerous list while an enigmatic passenger seems unnervingly tied to the vessel's fate.

title: The Diamond as Big as the Ritz -William Conrad (1948-08-29)
sortKey: 0|1948-08-29|00051|the diamond as big as the ritz -william conrad (1948-08-29)
plotSynopsis: John Unger visits the impossibly wealthy Washington family on a hidden Montana estate built around a mountain-sized diamond. When he learns that outsiders who discover the secret are imprisoned or killed, he and Kismine flee as the estate's defenses collapse; her father destroys the diamond and the family retreat rather than let the outside world seize it, leaving John and Kismine to face an ordinary future together.

title: Dream of Armageddon (1948-09-05)
plotSynopsis: A weary man repeatedly dreams that he inhabits a future ruler who abandoned power to live with the woman he loves, only to see that private choice help ignite a catastrophic world war. As the dream world collapses, his lover is killed and his future self dies amid the final violence, yet his consciousness remains trapped in the nightmare, making him terrified to fall asleep again.

title: Evening Primrose -William Conrad (1948-09-12)
plotSynopsis: A poet secretly moves into a department store so he can live and write without money, only to discover a hidden nocturnal society that has lived there for years. He falls in love with Ella and tries to help her escape, but the store's secret rulers close in, and the final clue suggests the missing lovers have become new wax figures in the display windows.

title: The Man Who Could Work Miracles (1948-09-19)
plotSynopsis: George Fotheringay discovers that whatever he commands can become reality and, with a clergyman's encouragement, spends a night performing increasingly ambitious miracles. When he stops the Earth's rotation and unleashes catastrophic winds, he uses his last control to restore everything to the moment before his powers appeared, remove the powers and forget the experience entirely.

title: The Lost Special (1949-02-12)
plotSynopsis: Inspector Collins investigates a special train that vanishes completely between stations despite apparently having no place to leave the main line. The mystery leads to railway official Bland, who bribed members of the crew and diverted the train down a mine spur into a shaft before covering the crime with a cave-in; the dead engineer's body and the surviving conspirators finally expose the scheme.

title: Orient Express (1949-02-19)
plotSynopsis: American traveler Gregory Myatt boards the Orient Express and becomes entangled with Dr. Czinner, a political exile trying to return secretly to his homeland, and Coral, a young woman caught in the same danger. After authorities pull them from the train, Myatt and reporter Miss Warren help engineer an escape from the station; Myatt and Coral flee by car while Czinner chooses to remain behind, and the journey leaves Myatt and Coral contemplating a future together.

title: Red Wine -Jeff Chandler (1949-02-26)
plotSynopsis: Investigator Paul Vernier reaches a remote Borneo station knowing one of three Americans is the murderer Stiques, but not which one. Attempts on Vernier's life and the murder of controller Kurt's wife narrow the field, and a suspect finally exposes himself by objecting when Vernier ruins a rare red wine with ice; Kurt kills the man as he reaches for a gun, avenging his wife but leaving Vernier without a prisoner.

title: Conquerors Isle -David Ellis (1949-03-05)
plotSynopsis: Navy flyer Brady and his crew are forced down on a Pacific island and discover an underground society made up of humans who represent the next stage of evolution. Their hosts intend eventually to take control of civilization as humanity's superior guardians; Brady escapes by raft and returns years later to warn the world, only to be committed as insane by a doctor who is secretly one of the advanced beings.

title: He Who Rides the Tiger (1949-03-12)
plotSynopsis: American David Armor wakes in a Chinese mission hospital after a long fever with two months missing from his memory. As General Kinto and others question him, fragments return about a resistance network, a temple and stolen Tang bronzes, leading them to the hidden art treasure and exposing collaborator Chen before Armor prepares to return to his wife in San Francisco.

title: A Shipment of Mute Fate -John Lund (1949-03-13)
plotSynopsis: A deadly bushmaster snake escapes from its container aboard a passenger liner, forcing Chris Warner and the officers to search the ship while trying to avoid a panic. The snake finally corners a stray cat in the galley, but the cat blinds and kills it in a savage fight; Warner then discovers the reason for her courage when three kittens crawl out from under the stove.

title: Finger of Doom (1949-03-19)
plotSynopsis: Kenny's fiancée Steffi vanishes after entering an apartment building to deliver a package, and every witness seems to deny she was ever there. Detective Gilman uncovers a spy network hidden behind false tenants and altered rooms, traces the conspirators to a house, and rescues Steffi from a burning basement before the agents are arrested.

title: The Country of the Blind -Edmond O Brien (1949-03-20)
sortKey: 0|1949-03-20|00062|the country of the blind -edmond o brien (1949-03-20)
plotSynopsis: Mountain guide Nunez survives a fall into an isolated Andean valley whose inhabitants have been blind for generations and cannot comprehend his claims about sight. He falls in love there and even agrees to have his eyes removed so he can belong, but on the eve of the operation he flees across the mountains to preserve his vision, only to return to civilization permanently blinded by the brutal journey through snow and glare.

title: The Adaptive Ultimate (1949-03-26)
plotSynopsis: An experimental serum gives a desperately ill woman the power to adapt almost instantly to disease, injury and even threats to her identity. Kira uses that ability to transform her appearance and escape a murder charge, forcing the doctors who created her to realize they have made someone effectively beyond ordinary restraint; they finally stop her in their laboratory, where her extraordinary adaptability fails and she dies.

title: The Diamond as Big as the Ritz -Sam Edwards Helen Thomas (1949-03-27)
sortKey: 0|1949-03-27|00064|the diamond as big as the ritz -sam edwards helen thomas (1949-03-27)
plotSynopsis: Prep-school student John Unger visits classmate Percy Washington and discovers a hidden Rocky Mountain estate whose fabulous wealth comes from a diamond mountain kept secret at any cost. When the outside world finally attacks the compound, Percy's father tries to bribe God and then destroys the estate and diamond rather than surrender, while John escapes with Percy's sister Kismine to face an ordinary future together.

title: Confidential Agent (1949-04-02)
plotSynopsis: Confidential agent David travels to England to secure industrial diamonds needed by his embattled anti-fascist country while enemy agents try to bribe, frame and kill him. With help from Rose and Forbes he escapes the trap, reaches a freighter with the diamonds, and discovers Rose has chosen to go with him into the dangerous future ahead.

title: When the Man Comes Follow Him (1949-04-09)
plotSynopsis: Blind racketeer Heineman follows the dying clues of his prospector brother to an Arizona treasure while Pascal and the other gunmen accompany him. At the final marker, greed turns the party against itself: the men shoot one another, Heineman is mortally wounded, and Pascal discovers their water has been destroyed, leaving the surviving treasure seeker stranded in the desert.

title: The General Died at Dawn (1949-04-16)
plotSynopsis: Broke adventurer O'Hara is drawn into Irene Mallory's attempt to recover half a million dollars in gold before it falls to warlord General Yang. The struggle ends aboard Yang's junk, where Yang is fatally stabbed and orders his own guards to kill one another to preserve his honor; afterward O'Hara learns the supposed treasure had already been lost in speculation and that much of the mystery was a desperate cover-up.

title: The Great Impersonation (1949-04-23)
plotSynopsis: German agents plan to replace English baronet Everard Dominey with his near-identical German acquaintance Leopold von Ragastein and use the impersonation to penetrate British society. The man who returns to England ultimately reveals that he is the real Dominey, having survived the plot, taken the German's place and secured a list of Nazi agents for British authorities before reuniting with his recovered wife.

title: The Fourth Man -Wilms Herbert (1949-07-07)
plotSynopsis: Three escaped convicts cross the sea on a primitive raft with a native guide whom they despise and underestimate. Thirst and greed turn the fugitives against one another until all three die, while the supposedly ignorant fourth man survives because the raft contains hidden bladders of fresh water he alone knew how to use, then calmly sails home.

title: The Drums of the Fore and Aft -Ben Wright (1949-07-14)
sortKey: 0|1949-07-14|00070|the drums of the fore and aft -ben wright (1949-07-14)
plotSynopsis: Two young regimental drummers, Jakin and Piggy, watch the British Fore and Aft break under Afghan fire and decide to shame the soldiers back into action. They march into the open playing drum and fife until enemy snipers kill them, and their deaths finally rouse the regiment to attack and turn the battle.

title: Action -Joseph Kearns (1949-07-21)
plotSynopsis: After a mild stroke convinces Christopher Bell that he will soon become helpless, the aging mountaineer chooses an impossible glacier climb as a disguised suicide. Near exhaustion he hears a woman in danger and saves her; she claims she too sought death because of an incurable illness, and they make a pact to keep living. The closing revelation is that her doctor husband and actress wife deliberately staged the encounter to give Bell a reason to live.

title: Second Class Passenger -Parley Baer- -1 (1949-07-28)
plotSynopsis: Second-class tourist Ronald Dawson leaves his cruise companions in Mozambique to retrieve a bronze idol and is unexpectedly swept into a night of murder, police pursuit and escape with a woman named Marlene. Armed only with the blood-stained idol, he follows her across rooftops and through the old lepers' gate before reaching the waterfront. Dawson rejoins his shipmates with the idol just before sailing, while they laugh off his truthful account of adventure and romance as something that could never happen to a second-class passenger.

title: Second Class Passenger -Parley Baer- -2 (1949-07-28)

title: Leiningen Versus the Ants -Tudor Owen (1949-08-04)
plotSynopsis: Plantation owner Leiningen refuses to abandon his Amazon estate when a vast army of man-eating ants approaches, trusting preparation and intelligence to defeat them. When every defensive line begins to fail, he runs through the swarm to open the floodgates, nearly dies under thousands of bites, and survives long enough to see the plantation flooded and the ants destroyed.

title: Red Wine -Willard Waterman (1949-08-11)
plotSynopsis: Investigator Paul Vernier reaches a remote Borneo station knowing one of three Americans is the murderer Stiques, but not which one. A suspect finally gives himself away by objecting when Vernier spoils a rare red wine with ice; after the man reaches for a gun, controller Kurt kills him and reveals that the same fugitive had murdered Kurt's wife, leaving Vernier with the solution but no prisoner.

title: Snake Doctor -Ira Grossel (1949-08-18)
plotSynopsis: Jealous J. F. Morner goes to the isolated Snake Doctor's cabin intending to kill him and steal the money hidden there. After Morner dies from terror while reaching into the cache, his son accuses the Snake Doctor of using a deadly cottonmouth; the supposed snake is revealed as a stuffed decoy, while barbed wire around the hiding place explains the marks on Morner's hand.

title: Evening Primrose -Harry Bartell (1949-08-25)
plotSynopsis: A poet secretly moves into a department store after closing and discovers an entire community that lives hidden there at night under strict rules. He falls in love with Ella and tries to save her from the mysterious Dark Men, leaving a written account behind; the next day a shopper notices three new wax figures in the store window, matching the poet, Ella and the night watchman who tried to help them.

title: The Fortune of Vargas (1949-09-21)
plotSynopsis: Toby Manning follows Consuela into the Mexican mountains in search of revolutionary gold hidden by her father. A former soldier trails them and confronts them at a rope bridge, where gunfire sends the gold into a gorge and leaves Consuela mortally wounded; Toby is left knowing that his distrust, including secretly unloading her gun, helped cost him the woman he loved.

title: Wild Oranges -Van Heflin (1949-09-28)
plotSynopsis: Sailor John Woolfolk anchors off an isolated Georgia plantation and is drawn to Millie, whose family lives in fear of the violent Nicholas. After Nicholas kills Millie's father, John fights him in the darkened house and gets Millie to the boat; the wounded sailor Halvard helps them through the dangerous passage before collapsing, and Millie takes the wheel without the fear that once ruled her.

title: The Sure Thing -William Conrad (1949-10-15)
plotSynopsis: A ship's doctor answers a distress call to a yacht carrying Joseph Ingram and a two-million-dollar bearer draft, then becomes trapped as greed turns the people aboard against one another. He eventually reaches port alone with the draft and tries to deposit it, but Ingram's supposedly absent wife appears, reveals that her husband was still alive, and accuses the doctor of murdering him for the money.

title: Night in Havana -1 (1949-10-22)
plotSynopsis: Tio Martinez is trying to abandon his underworld life and marry Amalia, but his need for money to help with her cafe mortgage draws him into the search for an American tourist's stolen emerald and then a smuggling run from Key West with Maru. A Coast Guard pursuit leaves Maru badly wounded and the cargo boat abandoned, after which Tio uses a final dockside deception to recover the emerald. Police later find only scrap metal in the abandoned crates, and Tio returns to Havana ready for his wedding and determined to continue experimenting with an honest life.

title: Flood on the Goodwins -Jack Edwards (1949-11-01)
plotSynopsis: One-armed veteran Dundas helps recover victims from a wartime sinking in the English Channel, then later takes aboard a German operative who offers him thousands of pounds for passage to safety. Dundas pretends to accept the bargain but strands the man on the Goodwin Sands at low tide, leaving him to face the rising sea and the fate of the men he helped kill.

title: Plunder of the Sun (1949-11-08)
plotSynopsis: Adventurer Colby accepts a job carrying an ancient Peruvian relic back toward Peru and becomes entangled with collector St. Ubarian, nurse Analus and the ruthless Jefferson. The relic leads to a hunt for hidden Inca treasure, but Jefferson's murders and escape attempt end when authorities corner him at Lake Titicaca, leaving Analus free of her obligation to St. Ubarian.

title: Three Skeleton Key -William Conrad- -1 (1949-11-15)
plotSynopsis: Jean, Louis and Auguste are isolated lighthouse keepers on Three Skeleton Key when a derelict ship releases an enormous swarm of rats onto their rock. The rats overrun the lighthouse, consume the supplies and trap the men in the lantern room; Auguste loses his sanity while Louis is badly bitten. When the light finally goes out, the rats abandon the key aboard a grounded banana boat. Auguste is committed to an asylum, Louis dies from blood poisoning, and Jean is left permanently uneasy whenever an unfamiliar ship approaches.

title: Three Skeleton Key -William Conrad- -2 (1949-11-15)

title: Maracas (1949-11-22)
plotSynopsis: Mate Doyle sails aboard a freighter carrying a shipment of rifles to Central American strongman General Topaz, while tension grows among the captain, shipper and passengers. At the destination Topaz discovers the crates contain useless imitation rifles, exposing a double-cross and leaving Doyle and his companions facing a drunken firing squad.

title: Letter from Jason (1949-11-29)
plotSynopsis: Alcoholic Jason Torrance leaves his wife after another collapse, and his uncle forces him into a harsh voyage meant to confront the weakness ruining his life. Jason becomes obsessed with finding and defeating a feared man called Jake Finch, only to discover that the name is local slang for any drunken derelict; realizing the enemy he has been hunting is his own alcoholism, Jason writes home, and his wife immediately stops the divorce and waits for his return.

title: Command -Elliott Reed (1949-12-06)
plotSynopsis: Young Lieutenant Cohill dismisses veteran Captain Brittles as an overcautious relic until an Indian threat turns a routine patrol into a deadly lesson in command. Forced to lead men under fire, Cohill survives long enough for Brittles to break the attack and then learns that the old captain's caution, observation and experience were exactly what kept the troop alive.

title: Border Town (1949-12-13)
plotSynopsis: Struggling actor Evan finds thousands of dollars hidden in belongings connected to an arrested bus passenger and detours into a Mexican border town instead of continuing directly to Hollywood. He is drugged, robbed and drawn deeper into the money's criminal trail, but eventually recovers enough to outfit himself lavishly; at customs he learns the fortune he has built his plans around is counterfeit and is detained.

title: Figure a Dame (1949-12-20)
plotSynopsis: Insurance detective Joe escorts wealthy Mrs. Bankner and the priceless Star of Kilimanjaro emerald across India, but greed turns him from guard into thief. After Mrs. Bankner is murdered, Joe hides the jewel and tries to frame Rafferty, only to discover Rafferty is the insurance company's chief agent and that Marian, the woman Joe has trusted, is Rafferty's wife; Joe's own admissions complete the trap around him.

title: Seeds of Greed (1949-12-27)
plotSynopsis: Drifter Kenneth Braun joins pearl dealer Lee on an expedition after convincing himself that one rich haul can solve his failures. Their greed peaks when a giant hand-shaped mass is raised from the sea and spills a fortune in pearls back into the water; Lee attacks Braun in fury, and Braun kills him, left alone with the bitter realization that greed destroyed everything they sought.

title: The Pistol (1950-01-03)
plotSynopsis: Jonathan Storm reaches a California gold camp seeking his murdered brother and finds killer Bart Mallory protected by the advantage of a new Colt revolver. Storm forces the final confrontation by setting Mallory's building on fire, then shoots him when he draws; afterward Storm sends Terry Blake away with the revolver and deliberately heads south rather than follow her north.

title: Vanishing Lady -Del Castillo (1950-01-10)
plotSynopsis: Young Cynthia Winship's mother becomes critically ill in a Paris hotel, and a doctor sends Cynthia away for medicine. When she returns, the hotel denies that her mother ever existed and even the room has been changed; years later Bruce admits the truth, that her mother died of a dangerous illness and officials removed the body, fumigated and redecorated the room, and organized the conspiracy to prevent public panic and economic damage.

title: The Sure Thing -Anthony Ross- -1 (1950-01-17)
plotSynopsis: A ship doctor is summoned to a schooner after wealthy aviation magnate Joseph Ingram is shot, only to discover that Ingram has exploited reports of his own death to disappear with a two-million-dollar bank draft. Felix and secretary Stephanie scheme around the wounded man, Felix is lost overboard, and Ingram kills Stephanie before dying himself. When the doctor reaches the bank with the draft, Ingram's wife appears and accuses him, leaving him trapped as the apparent survivor of a triple murder.

title: The Sure Thing -Anthony Ross- -2 (1950-01-17)

title: Treasure Incorporated -1 (1950-01-24)
plotSynopsis: Eddie Gillespie develops a remote Caribbean island as a resort and plants fake pirate relics as a tourist attraction, but greed overwhelms the project when Amanda, Brewer and beachcomber Clive become entangled in the hunt for treasure. Violence follows, the resort is abandoned, and the jungle steadily reclaims everything Eddie built. Obsessed with beating Clive and finding the hidden chest, Eddie remains behind digging while Clive repeatedly moves the treasure and mocks his futile struggle.

title: Treasure Incorporated -2 (1950-01-24)

title: Present Tense -1 (1950-01-31)
plotSynopsis: Condemned murderer Roger refuses to accept his approaching execution and repeatedly imagines ingenious escapes: a train wreck, a staged medical emergency, flight into Mexico under a new identity, and finally suspended animation that seems to let him rise from the dead. Each escape collapses back toward the prison and the death chamber. In the final vision he reaches his old home and believes he has all the time in the world, only for the official pronouncement of his death to return, revealing the limits of his imagined escape.

title: The Outer Limit (1950-02-07)
plotSynopsis: Test pilot Bill Westfall takes an experimental rocket aircraft far beyond its expected range and returns with a warning from beings outside Earth: another atomic explosion could bring destruction upon humanity. Doctors assume his story is a delusion until one impossible fact remains unexplained, that Westfall kept the aircraft aloft for ten hours with fuel designed to last only ten minutes.

title: Two If by Sea (1950-02-14)
plotSynopsis: British reporter Philip Sutherland leaves Moscow only after Soviet officials revoke the travel permission of his new wife, ballerina Mario. He secretly returns, assumes a false identity and races across Soviet territory with help from friends, finally reaching a waiting schooner and escaping with Mario toward England.

title: The Red Mark (1950-02-21)
plotSynopsis: Convict Bichot has only days left before release from the New Caledonia penal colony and plans to leave with Zellie, the young wife of the colony's hated executioner. The escape plan ends in tragedy: Bichot is killed, and while officials prepare to execute the prisoner they believe is Bichot, a native arrives with Bichot's severed head, revealing too late that the hooded victim already guillotined by the executioner was Zellie herself.

title: The Man Who Won the War -1 (1950-02-28)
plotSynopsis: Royal Navy officer Edward Bradman disobeys orders during the 1914 fighting in Flanders and uses a deception involving Highlander uniforms to make German forces believe British reinforcements have arrived, helping delay the attack until the Belgian defenses can act. With no official record or surviving witness, Bradman is court-martialed and disgraced despite insisting his action helped stop the German advance. Years later a German witness confirms Bradman's story, clearing his name and leading to a posthumous Victoria Cross that restores his family's honor.

title: The Man Who Won the War -2 (1950-02-28)

title: Port Royal (1950-03-10)
plotSynopsis: Down-on-his-luck Danny Quinn joins a diving expedition to recover treasure from the sunken ruins of Port Royal and becomes consumed by the fortune below. Mutiny and greed leave the expedition's ship sinking, and Danny kills one of his partners to keep control of the treasure, only to learn that diver Fletcher Travis overheard everything over the intercom and will rescue him only if he returns to shore to face the consequences.

title: Three Skeleton Key -Vincent Price (1950-03-17)
plotSynopsis: Three lighthouse keepers on remote Three Skeleton Key are besieged by a vast swarm of rats from a derelict ship. The animals overrun the tower and trap the men in the lantern room until the light fails and a passing freighter grounds nearby, drawing the swarm away; one keeper later dies from infected bites and another loses his sanity, leaving the survivor permanently terrified of approaching ships.

title: Danger at Matecumbe (1950-03-24)
plotSynopsis: Drifter Joe accepts work from a wealthy-looking couple in Florida and is soon caught inside their criminal scheme, then framed for a murder he did not commit. He escapes from their yacht by swimming for a nearby fishing boat while the killer pursuing him crashes on the reef, and police later clear Joe because the murder occurred while he was already in the Miami jail, even though they promptly escort him out of town again.

title: Green Splotches (1950-03-31)
plotSynopsis: An expedition enters a forbidden Andean valley and finds mysterious green splashes that test as pure chlorophyll where no ordinary plants grow. Their search brings them face to face with strange humanoid beings and an immense spacecraft, leading to the realization that the visitors are intelligent plant life and that the green fluid is their equivalent of blood.

title: The Ambassador of Poker (1950-04-07)
plotSynopsis: Virginia gambler Randolph Fairburn is hired to recover the priceless Yin seal from Chinese warlord General Kung, using poker as his way into the general's confidence. Red-haired Susan Jones steals the seal and double-crosses him, but after further pursuit and intrigue the two wind up married; Fairburn secretly hides the seal in his card box, only to watch Susan throw the cards overboard as a symbol of his reformed life.

title: The Golden Snake (1950-04-14)
plotSynopsis: A pilot and a woman venture into the jungle in pursuit of treasure despite warnings of an ancient Mayan curse, only to encounter forces that threaten their escape.

title: The Shanghai Document (1950-04-21)
plotSynopsis: American Tony Dana tries to escape chaotic postwar China by traveling down the Yangtze to Shanghai, repeatedly convinced that soldiers and strangers are pursuing him. Only after reaching Shanghai does he learn that a doctor secretly taped an important document to his back and that most of his apparent pursuers were protecting him while an impostor missionary tried to steal it.

title: Something for Nothing (1950-04-28)
plotSynopsis: Opportunist Gil Devin discovers that Belle Gassner murdered her husband and uses the secret to blackmail her, take control of the dead man's gambling interests and move into wealthy society. When Belle threatens to expose him, Gil sabotages his airplane so she will crash at sea, only to return to town and be arrested for Frank Gassner's murder after Gil's lost identification bracelet is found in the dead man's car.

title: The Man Who Stole the Bible -Ben Wright (1950-05-05)
sortKey: 0|1950-05-05|00109|the man who stole the bible -ben wright (1950-05-05)
plotSynopsis: During Mardi Gras, a traveling businessman casually takes a hotel Bible and is abruptly swept into danger, confusion and an undercover operation.

title: The Rim of Terror (1950-05-12)
plotSynopsis: A woman who stops for a hitchhiker is drawn into an espionage struggle of spies and betrayals that sends her fleeing across the Nevada desert.

title: Pass to Berlin (1950-05-19)
plotSynopsis: After trying to conceal a killing in postwar Berlin, an American soldier finds himself manipulated through a disturbing psychological contest by a mysterious mind reader.

title: Command -Harry Bartell (1950-05-26)
plotSynopsis: A cautious cavalry captain risks a young lieutenant and his men as bait while setting a trap for the war party responsible for a recent massacre.

title: Mars Is Heaven (1950-06-02)
plotSynopsis: The first crew to reach Mars finds an eerily familiar community waiting for them, but the welcoming surface conceals a deadly truth about the planet's inhabitants.

title: Serenade for a Cobra (1950-06-16)
plotSynopsis: A mercenary pilot's smuggling run becomes a fight for survival when a vengeful mechanic and a venomous cobra turn the flight into a lethal trap.

title: Sundown (1950-06-23)
plotSynopsis: An orphaned desert youth devotes himself to becoming a gunfighter so he can avenge himself on the outlaw who took his prized horse.

title: Blood Bath (1950-06-30)
plotSynopsis: Three prospectors chase partners who betrayed them, but the pursuit degenerates into a brutal contest for survival against the jungle and one another.

title: A Shipment of Mute Fate -David Ellis (1950-07-07)
plotSynopsis: A deadly bushmaster escapes aboard a passenger liner, leaving Chris Warner and the ship's officers to hunt the snake through cabins and passageways while trying to prevent panic. The animal is finally confronted in the galley by a stray cat, which blinds and kills it after a savage fight; Warner then discovers that the cat risked herself to protect three kittens hidden beneath the stove.

title: Shark Bait (1950-07-14)
plotSynopsis: A charter-boat captain is pulled into a Central American gun-running operation and must navigate rebels, double-crosses and shifting loyalties to survive.

title: Yellow Wake (1950-07-21)
plotSynopsis: A brutal first mate organizes a mutiny aboard a whaling vessel so he can seize a legendary treasure said to be hidden in Panama.

title: Poison (1950-07-28)
plotSynopsis: A terrified man lies motionless because he believes a deadly krait is resting on his body, and the ordeal exposes darker prejudices beneath the immediate danger.

title: Two Came Back (1950-08-04)
plotSynopsis: A gold hunt in New Guinea turns deadly as two men and an untrustworthy woman face both hostile headhunters and betrayal within their own party.

title: The Red Forest -Ben Wright (1950-08-11)
plotSynopsis: A fugitive and a hitchhiker are trapped together as a massive Idaho forest fire closes in, forcing them into a desperate struggle to escape.

title: The Footprint (1950-08-18)
plotSynopsis: A hunt for ancient rubies in the Mexican desert becomes lethal when the treasure seekers cross paths with a secretive cult and a deadly hidden threat.

title: Crossing Paris (1950-08-25)
plotSynopsis: In occupied Paris, a black-market meat carrier is forced to find a replacement partner and recruits a powerful stranger to help carry illegal meat through the city at night. The stranger turns out to be a wealthy artist treating the underworld as an adventure, and their growing hostility ends in a fatal knife fight before the carrier completes the delivery and realizes the dead man's portrait and knowledge of his name may expose him.

title: A Sleeping Draft -John Dodsworth (1950-10-01)
plotSynopsis: Captain Godfrey transports hundreds of convicts to Australia and secretly agrees to help prisoner Jonathan Abbey escape if Abbey first secures the knives hidden among the men. Abbey keeps his bargain, but when thick fog forces the ship to anchor miles offshore he mistakes the anchor for the promised escape signal, jumps into a powerful current fifteen miles from land, and leaves the captain haunted by the trust that killed him.

title: Roulette (1950-10-08)
plotSynopsis: Young English traveler Richard meets the frightened Tina after losing his money at Monte Carlo and agrees to help her evade men she claims are pursuing her. After a chase across France, his friendly acquaintance McLennan reveals that he is British military intelligence and that Tina is actually carrying an assassination message for a foreign service, leaving Richard to realize he has been manipulated by the woman he tried to save.

title: The Power of Hammer (1950-10-15)
plotSynopsis: Sam Kerrigan helps authorities track fugitive Benjamin Hammer, an embezzler and killer who has made himself ruler of a remote African people by cultivating a reputation for supernatural invulnerability. Hammer threatens his pursuers and holds power through fear until Kerrigan shoots him; when the supposedly immortal king falls dead, his followers abandon the myth that protected him and release the captives.

title: The Time Machine -John Dehner- -1 (1950-10-22)
plotSynopsis: Dudley and Fowler travel in a time machine to the year 100,000 and 80, where they meet a gentle childlike people and Wina, but discover their machine has been stolen and locked away by the subterranean Morlocks. After descending into the Morlocks' underground world and searching for a way home, they fight their way back when the machine is exposed as bait. They escape to their own time, but Wina is torn from Fowler at the last moment, leaving only a piece of her green tunic as evidence that the journey really happened.

title: The Time Machine -John Dehner- -2 (1950-10-22)

title: Seven Hours to Freedom (1950-10-29)
plotSynopsis: Fisherman Jeff and his crew are taken hostage aboard their boat by escaped convicts who demand passage toward Mexico. Jeff secretly radios the Coast Guard, then uses the boat's handling and ballast to capsize the convicts' skiff and leave the surviving gunmen freezing in the water, turning the attempted hijacking into a capture and a likely reward.

title: Earth Abides Part 1 (1950-11-05)
plotSynopsis: After surviving a global plague, an ecology student discovers civilization nearly empty and begins trying to build a new human community in a world rapidly returning to nature.

title: Earth Abides Part 2 (1950-11-12)
plotSynopsis: Years after a plague destroys civilization, Ish and Em try to turn the survivors from scavenging toward farming, but a typhoid outbreak kills much of their small community, including their first child. The survivors abandon San Francisco and begin again on fertile land, raising a new generation as old technology fails and practical skills replace it. When violent newcomer Charlie kills one of the group, the community forms a council and executes him, marking the birth of a new government. By year 48, the aged Ish has become a living legend; he passes his symbolic hammer and leadership to Joey and dies after seeing the ruined Golden Gate once more, affirming that people pass but the earth endures.

title: Journey Into Fear (1950-11-19)
plotSynopsis: English engineer Graham survives an assassination attempt in Istanbul and learns that enemy agents want him dead because of his work for an armaments firm. Turkish security sends him out by ship, but the killers follow under false identities and even an apparent ally betrays him; Colonel Haki ultimately intercepts the plot, the assassins die while trying to escape, and Graham is put safely on a plane home.

title: Funeral Fires (1950-11-26)
plotSynopsis: Doctor Mark Donovan arrives in plague-stricken Malaya with life-saving serum and discovers that someone has stolen the supply while hundreds are dying. Suspecting plantation owner Ford and his associates, Donovan pretends to inject them with plague bacteria and lets fear force the truth out: Ford arranged the theft for profit and hid the serum in his house, while Donovan's threatening injections were only distilled water.

title: This Side of Nowhere (1950-12-03)
plotSynopsis: Barnstorming pilot Gannett agrees to fly Phyllis Naylor to Wichita and learns that her suitcase contains a quarter-million dollars from a bank robbery. After they crash in the Mexican desert, a mysterious village takes the money, map and animals, forcing them to flee on foot; Phyllis dies after a venomous bite, and when Gannett is finally rescued he cannot lead police back to the vanished village or the missing fortune.

title: A Passenger to Bali (1950-12-10)
plotSynopsis: Captain English accepts a high-paying passenger calling himself Reverend Wokes, then suspects him of murdering a Chinese stowaway who followed him aboard. Every port refuses the wanted criminal, whose influence breeds violence and disorder among the crew; after a storm wrecks the Roundabout, English finally abandons the ship and leaves Wokes aboard rather than carry him any farther.

title: Wild Jack Rhett -John Dehner- -1 (1950-12-17)
plotSynopsis: The citizens of Red Mesa hire feared professional town-tamer Jack Rhett as sheriff after another lawman is killed. Rhett imposes his own cold rules while outlaw Todd Mallon and saloon owner Boylan maneuver against him, and he recognizes that the final showdown is approaching. Rhett sends Deputy Marshal Matt Travener safely away, then deliberately faces Mallon, Boylan and their men alone in the moonlit street. He kills the two ringleaders before dying himself, meeting the end he had predicted in the style he chose.

title: The Cave (1950-12-24)
plotSynopsis: Ten-year-old Dan enters a vast seaside cave on Christmas Day with his friend George and discovers a hidden world of pirates, adventure and a mysterious Lady Alicia. When George finds the route home, Dan refuses to leave the enchanted world; years later he remains there as a grown man, with Alicia and the pirates still part of the life he chose.

title: The Man Who Could Work Miracles -1 (1950-12-31)
plotSynopsis: George Fotheringay discovers that spoken commands can produce real miracles and, encouraged by the Reverend Maydig, expands from small demonstrations to sweeping changes around their village. Trying to perform one final grand miracle, he orders the Earth to stop rotating and unleashes catastrophic destruction as everything on its surface keeps moving. Horrified, he commands the world restored to the moment before his first miracle and gives up the power, returning to his old argument with no memory of what happened.

title: The Man Who Could Work Miracles -2 (1950-12-31)

title: Conquest (1951-01-07)
plotSynopsis: Chase Hamilton devotes his life to becoming the first man to reach the summit of Mount Everest and survives an ascent that kills his companion. At the top he finds George Mallory's cigarette case, proof that Mallory reached the summit before him; although tempted to hide the evidence, Hamilton ultimately tells the press the truth and gives the dead climber the honor of the first conquest.

title: A Bullet for Mr Smith -1 (1951-01-14)
plotSynopsis: Freelance correspondent Alan Rogers is recruited by French intelligence to trace an espionage network across Western Europe. He follows Mr. Smith, Tallchief and Mary Donnelly onto a train, where Mary admits the gang has stolen secret plans and agrees to help him. Rogers discovers the plans hidden in a freshly printed newspaper, but a struggle for the gun leaves Mary fatally shot. Swiss authorities arrest Smith and Tallchief, and Rogers returns to Paris with the recovered plans and his assignment completed.

title: A Bullet for Mr Smith -2 (1951-01-14)

title: The Killer Mine (1951-02-11)
plotSynopsis: A deserter is coerced into helping blast open an abandoned Cornish mine for smugglers and becomes trapped between a violent accomplice and the incoming tide.

title: The Follower (1951-02-18)
plotSynopsis: A man arrives home to discover a corpse and his wife gone, sending him across borders in a dangerous search for what really happened.

title: The Island -Harry Bartell (1951-07-11)
plotSynopsis: Marine Corporal Lacy survives the Pacific war by clinging to a dream of an untouched island filled with peace, food and beautiful people. When he and another Marine actually reach the island, they discover it is a leper colony whose residents the Japanese planned to use as a terror weapon, destroying Lacy's fantasy and forcing him back toward Okinawa.

title: Macao (1951-07-18)
plotSynopsis: Connie Rawls, the ruthless woman who controls much of Macao's underworld, recruits former flyer Johnny Hook for a scheme meant to increase her power. Johnny refuses when he realizes the plan would betray people who fought against Communist control, and Connie's own lieutenant turns against her for that betrayal, stripping away her organization and leaving her marked for death as she goes looking for Johnny.

title: The Earthman (1951-07-25)
plotSynopsis: The first Earth expedition to Mars finds Martians who treat the crew's claims of coming from Earth as symptoms of insanity. A psychiatrist concludes Captain Williams is a telepathic psychotic projecting his companions and rocket, kills the Earthmen as treatment, and is left baffled when the supposedly imaginary rocket and crew persist after Williams's death.

title: The Gladiator (1951-08-01)
plotSynopsis: Retired heavyweight Joe Scarlatti is abducted to a remote island ruled by a family descended from an exiled Roman commander, where he is to be forced into a modern gladiatorial fight. Joe, his manager and Lucretia rebel and escape under gunfire; as their boat pulls away, the strange island is consumed in destruction, leaving them with a story no one is likely to believe.

title: Up Periscope (1951-08-08)
plotSynopsis: Retired American submariner Tom Baker accepts command of an old Chinese submarine and attacks Japanese warships with an inexperienced crew. After sinking major enemy vessels, his submarine is lost and Baker reaches shore alone, only to face a Chinese court that refuses to believe his story and condemns him for losing the boat; his death sentence is suspended on condition that he leave China forever.

title: Rough Shoot (1951-08-15)
plotSynopsis: Roger Taine accidentally kills a stranger he mistakes for a poacher and hides the body, only to learn that the dead man was tied to a dangerous political conspiracy. A former German officer coerces Roger into helping expose the plot, and after a violent confrontation Roger escapes with a briefcase of incriminating documents and goes straight to the police to confess the original killing and tell the full story.

title: The Silent Horror (1951-08-22)
plotSynopsis: Painter Tom Dorsey discovers his wife Elizabeth with another man, abandons his former life and hides among headhunters in a remote New Guinea valley. A boast that his wristwatch is magical makes the jealous headman Ramabu tie Tom's survival to the watch continuing to tick; after illness and a desperate escape Tom believes Jerry has been killed, only to learn later that she survived, leaving him with a reason to return to the valley.

title: The Man Who Stole the Bible -Sam Pierce (1951-08-30)
sortKey: 0|1951-08-30|00151|the man who stole the bible -sam pierce (1951-08-30)
plotSynopsis: Bored hotel guest Cummings takes a Gideon Bible simply because he wants something to read during Mardi Gras, unaware that narcotics smugglers have hidden a crucial address inside it. His accidental theft puts him between the gang and federal agents, and after beatings and confusion an undercover Treasury man recovers the Bible and the warehouse clue it contains.

title: Gringo (1952-10-12)
plotSynopsis: Jim Canavan joins Chavez and Maria on a voyage to a wrecked plane carrying a valuable mining-company payroll, only to be trapped on a dangerous island as greed and distrust turn the expedition against itself. Jim and Maria eventually reach the schooner and escape, but after Jim recovers in a hospital he learns Maria never returned the forty thousand dollars as promised and instead sailed away with it, leaving him ruefully aware that the adventure has changed him more than it changed her.

title: The Price of the Head -William Conrad (1952-10-19)
plotSynopsis: Abusive drunk Christopher Pellith is repeatedly protected by the devoted native Karaki, who helps him escape after murder and nurses him through a dangerous canoe voyage across the islands. Only when they reach Karaki's homeland beyond British authority does Pellith learn the reason for that loyalty: Karaki has spent years preserving the red-haired white man because his head will be a prized trophy.

title: Robert of Huntingdon (1952-10-26)
plotSynopsis: The sheriff of Nottingham recruits Sir Martin of Metlock to infiltrate Sherwood Forest and help destroy Robin Hood's band. Martin gains the outlaws' confidence while Little John's capture forces Robin into a rescue attempt, but the final clash ends with the sheriff's force routed by Robin's archers and Martin cut down as the men of Sherwood disappear back into the forest.

title: The Running Man (1952-11-02)
plotSynopsis: Ambitious banana planter Owen becomes convinced that a local curse placed through Selena makes him unbeatable at gambling and begins sacrificing everything to chase a fortune. When his longtime mentor tries to stop him, Owen accidentally kills the older man in a struggle, forcing him to flee toward Selena and the jungle with his wealth, future and former life destroyed.

title: The Return -1 (1952-11-09)
plotSynopsis: World-weary traveler Reeser reaches Bizerte searching for a place where there is no struggle. A blind beggar leads him through a mysterious wall into a seemingly perfect world where every need is met, love is effortless and nothing resists him. Reeser gradually realizes that perfection has eliminated challenge, individuality, effort and meaningful choice, so he rejects it and returns to the ordinary world. Back in Bizerte he discovers that what seemed like a brief experience in the perfect place has cost him a full year.

title: The Return -2 (1952-11-09)

title: The Loup-Garou (1952-11-16)
plotSynopsis: Superstitious bayou villagers blame outsider Zeb for a baby's death and other misfortunes, branding him a loup-garou while Marie insists he is innocent. Gus helps inflame the mob and pursues Zeb and Marie into the swamp, but Marie's father finally kills Gus after the violent confrontation and declares that the real evil threatening them is dead.

title: Incident in Quito -1 (1952-12-07)
plotSynopsis: Explorer Frank Harvey returns to Ecuador years after the expedition that made his reputation, when his wealthy first wife Edith disappeared and he came home with a collection of shrunken heads. His new wife Gloria and museum associate Clifton draw him back toward Quito, where his fear and drinking intensify. When Gloria confronts him with a blonde shrunken head obtained from a local curio dealer, Frank breaks down and confesses that he killed Edith, exposing the secret behind his earlier success.

title: Incident in Quito -2 (1952-12-07)

title: Four Went Home (1952-12-14)
plotSynopsis: Five American prisoners of war decide to escape a German camp as Allied forces draw near. During the breakout Dutch accidentally kills the frightened Mitch while trying to keep him quiet, and the remaining four walk through an abandoned gate to meet Patton's advancing troops, realizing that waiting only a few more minutes would have saved their friend.

title: The Man Who Liked Dickens (1952-12-21)
plotSynopsis: An English traveler lost in the Amazon is rescued by the isolated Mr. Todd, whose hospitality has one condition: his guest must spend hours every day reading Dickens aloud. Todd repeatedly delays any chance of escape, starves the traveler when he refuses to read and even deceives a rescue party by giving them the man's watch and a grave as proof of death, condemning his captive to a lifetime of Dickens readings.

title: Conquerors Isle -Harry Bartell (1953-01-11)
plotSynopsis: Navy flyer Brady and his crew are stranded on a Pacific island and discover a hidden underground society of humans who represent a far more advanced stage of evolution. Their hosts calmly explain that they intend to take control of the world as humanity's superior guardians; Brady escapes on a life raft to warn everyone, only to be judged insane by a doctor who is himself revealed to be one of the conquerors.

title: A Matter of Conscience -1 (1953-01-18)
plotSynopsis: A Dutch colonial resident in northern Bali faces a crisis after three young English tourists desecrate a temple and leave with two local women, one of them the high priest's daughter. The insult triggers an armed uprising, and the resident, police and a small group of Europeans are forced to escape the threatened town while trying to prevent bloodshed. The resulting diplomatic problem is finally defused when one of the Englishmen, calling it a matter of conscience, agrees to marry the priest's daughter. She accepts, the immediate conflict subsides, and the ports remain closed to tourist ships for a time while tensions settle.

title: A Matter of Conscience -2 (1953-01-18)

title: Diary of a Madman (1953-01-25)
plotSynopsis: German deserter Hans Brock leads a small band south across the Sahara, dreaming of founding an empire beyond the war. Thirst, exhaustion and his own ruthlessness destroy the others one by one, but Hans keeps staggering onward until he reaches a French post delirious and alone, proclaiming himself king of the empire he believes he has won.

title: A Study in Wax (1953-02-01)
plotSynopsis: Two surveyors isolated in the Arctic begin turning on one another as loneliness and psychological strain intensify after their radio link to civilization fails.

title: Jetsam (1953-02-08)
plotSynopsis: A disgraced former aviator stranded on a remote island tries to recover both his future and a valuable discovery from the man who stole it.

title: Wild Jack Rhett -Harry Bartell (1953-02-15)
plotSynopsis: Red Mesa hires notorious gunfighter Jack Rhett as sheriff to stop Todd Malan's gang, and Rhett imposes order with a cold, calculating style that makes the townspeople fear him almost as much as the outlaws. Knowing his own luck has finally turned, Rhett deliberately faces Malan, saloonkeeper Bo Helen and their hired men in the open street, killing Malan and Bo Helen before he dies himself.

title: I Saw Myself Running -1 (1953-02-22)
plotSynopsis: A woman plagued by recurring nightmares discovers that the frightened figure she keeps seeing is not merely herself but another version of Susan, carrying the fears she has suppressed throughout her life. In the dream world the two flee an unseen horror through shifting scenes until Susan reaches an exit where her husband and doctor force a choice between them. The fearful Susan is left behind in the darkness, while the version who escapes wakes beside her husband with a changed voice, suggesting that the other self has taken her place.

title: I Saw Myself Running -2 (1953-02-22)
plotSynopsis: A woman plagued by recurring nightmares discovers that the frightened figure she keeps seeing is not merely herself but another version of Susan, carrying the fears she has suppressed throughout her life. title: The Tramp (1953-03-01)
plotSynopsis: Jennings and two partners sign onto the decrepit tramp steamer Lacewing with a scheme to seize the ship and its cargo. Their plan unravels when the vessel begins sinking and the radio operator gets out a distress call, leaving the conspirators trapped among witnesses as their murders and sabotage come to light.

title: The Island -Stacy Harris- -1 (1953-03-08)
plotSynopsis: On Okinawa in 1945, Marines Robert Lacey and Tabori encounter a beautiful young woman named Taki and follow her by canoe to the secluded island Lacey has long imagined as a peaceful refuge from war. Lacey becomes determined to remain with her and even threatens Tabori rather than return. The island's leader finally reveals that Taki and the other residents are leprosy patients, and that Japanese forces removed many patients to use their appearance as a terror weapon against American troops. Lacey abandons his dream and starts the long return to Okinawa.

title: The Man with the Steel Teeth (1953-03-15)
plotSynopsis: American correspondent Arthur Luttrell is arrested in Moscow by MVD inspector Golovin and subjected to a calculated campaign of imprisonment and pursuit. After an apparent escape carries him across Eastern Europe to Berlin, Luttrell discovers Golovin engineered the chase as cover for his own defection, then hands the inspector over to the authorities after settling a personal score.

title: Pressure (1953-03-22)
plotSynopsis: The submarine Amberfish attacks a Japanese carrier and then endures a prolonged depth-charge hunt while damaged systems, heat and bad air push the crew toward their limits. When the escort finally breaks off, Amberfish surfaces to find oil and wreckage from the carrier it hit, confirming the kill before the boat sets course for home with all eighty-two men.

title: The Invader (1953-03-29)
plotSynopsis: During an atomic test, tiny extraterrestrial observers debate whether humanity deserves survival while chemistry teacher Albert Tanner accidentally contacts their ship by radio. Tanner guides them toward what he believes is a safe inland landing, not realizing their scale makes his backyard fishpond an ocean; the craft splashes down and disintegrates in the water, and officials suppress the incredible incident for lack of proof.

title: A Sleeping Draft -Alec Harford (1953-04-05)
plotSynopsis: A convict-ship captain strikes a bargain with condemned murderer Jonathan Abby: Abby will recover hidden knives from the prisoners, and the captain will let him escape when the anchor drops near Sydney. Abby keeps his word, but fog and a dangerous current force an emergency anchoring fifteen miles offshore; mistaking the signal for his promised chance, Abby jumps into the sea and is swept away, leaving the captain haunted by the trust he accidentally betrayed.

title: Classified Secret (1953-04-12)
plotSynopsis: A man carrying sensitive plans on a cross-country bus realizes mysterious pursuers are closing in, turning the trip into a deadly espionage chase.

title: El Guitarrero (1953-04-19)
plotSynopsis: When an American poet's wife is kidnapped in Mexico, he is forced to depend on a local man who openly despises him to help bring her back.

title: The Derelict (1953-04-26)
plotSynopsis: Shipwreck survivor Cora and three men board an abandoned vessel carrying a fortune in gold, and thoughts of dividing the treasure quickly turn them against one another. One man disappears overboard, another kills a rival, and Cora impulsively shoves the final survivor into the sea; she is left alone on the drifting derelict, rich on paper but running out of food and water while begging for rescue.

title: Lili and the Colonel (1953-05-03)
plotSynopsis: Young officer Temple visits Colonel Abernathy during Mau Mau unrest and sees both the colonel's harsh treatment of his Kikuyu servant Gombe and Lili's growing desperation. After the colonel humiliates Gombe and Lili extinguishes a signal lamp hoping Temple will come for her, the household's tensions end in a fatal Mau Mau attack.

title: The Vessel of Wrath (1953-05-10)
plotSynopsis: On a remote island, drunken troublemaker Ginger Ted seems beyond reform until missionary Miss Jones recruits him to help fight a dangerous epidemic in the outer islands. Months of hard work transform him, and he returns sober and determined to marry Miss Jones and begin a new life working beside her.

title: North of Polaris (1953-05-17)
plotSynopsis: Explorers land on what they believe is an alien planet and find ruins, radiation-scarred soil and enormous organized rats. An old survivor explains that atomic war made the rats immune while nearly destroying humanity, and after the expedition escapes the swarming animals the final revelation is that the devastated world is actually Earth, while the explorers themselves came from a world 'just north of Polaris.'

title: A Good Thing (1953-05-31)
plotSynopsis: Bitter, self-destructive Daniel joins his idealistic brother Matthew on an expedition among Philippine headhunters and repeatedly sabotages Matthew's attempt to make peaceful contact. Daniel ultimately shoots his brother and tries to pass the death off as native violence, but guide Yolo returns to the plantation with evidence of what happened and identifies Daniel, who answers by shooting Yolo as well.

title: The Voyages of Sinbad (1953-06-07)
plotSynopsis: Wealthy Sinbad the Sailor tells a poor porter how repeated voyages brought shipwreck, strange kingdoms and deadly ordeals. In one adventure he is enslaved by the Old Man of the Sea, tricks his captor into getting drunk on wine, kills him and escapes, later returning to Baghdad wealthy enough to reward the porter and make him part of his household.

title: Clear for Action (1953-06-14)
plotSynopsis: American Captain Steele is sent into the Caribbean to stop the French raider Hautefleur but is forbidden to attack without clear aggression. He finds a damaged American merchantman and turns it into a decoy, hiding cannon and disguising sailors to tempt a French boarding party; once the raider commits the hostile act, Steele's men spring the trap, seize the boarders and join his warship in defeating the French vessel.

title: The Far-Away Island (1953-06-21)
plotSynopsis: Adam Hamish returns to the Pacific island he has idealized for six years while trying to escape troubles that followed him from America, and is joined by his estranged son Paul. Island life changes Paul: he works the coconut grove, falls for a local girl and chooses to remain, while Adam finally decides to go back and set his unfinished affairs right, knowing the island and his son will be waiting.

title: A Source of Irritation (1953-07-05)
plotSynopsis: Cantankerous English farm worker Sam Gates has his routine shattered when a German reconnaissance plane lands in his turnip field and its pilot takes him prisoner. Sam's stubbornness and local knowledge eventually help British officers expose enemy deception and identify a hidden German agent, after which the celebrated old farmer asks for only one reward: a flight home in time for tea.

title: The Out Station (1953-07-12)
plotSynopsis: British resident Warburton receives coarse new assistant Alan Cooper at an isolated colonial outstation, and their mutual contempt grows as Cooper mistreats local servant Abas. After Cooper violently humiliates the young man, Abas kills him with a kris before dawn; Warburton quietly accepts that the provocation was great and plans to take Abas into his own household after whatever sentence is imposed.

title: The Open Boat (1953-07-19)
plotSynopsis: Four survivors of a wrecked steamer struggle for hours in a tiny open boat against cold, surf and exhaustion while trying to reach the Florida coast. When they finally abandon the boat and swim through the breakers, the captain, cook and correspondent survive, but Billy the oiler is found dead at the water's edge.

title: The Notebook (1953-07-26)
plotSynopsis: Prospectors Robbie and Mac head toward Deadwood with knowledge of a rich claim while armed men stalk them for the secret. Mac is killed, Robbie survives long enough to care for an injured pursuer, and his notebook records the grim end of the journey as he is left in a cave without ammunition while a wolf pack closes in.

title: The Red Forest -Tom Tully (1953-08-02)
plotSynopsis: Wally, already carrying the burden of a killing, picks up hitchhiker Jan and becomes trapped with her and several others by a fast-moving forest fire. During the escape he goes back for injured policeman Hanson even though Hanson knows Wally's secret; after surviving the fire, Wally decides to give himself up, only to learn Jan has already called the police after hearing his confession while he was unconscious.

title: Three Skeleton Key -Antony Ellis (1953-08-09)
plotSynopsis: Three lighthouse keepers on Three Skeleton Key are besieged when a derelict ship releases an enormous horde of starving rats onto their isolated tower. Forced upward level by level, the men barricade themselves in the lantern room as hunger, wounds and madness take hold, until the rats suddenly abandon the lighthouse for a newly grounded banana boat, leaving one keeper dead of infection and another permanently insane.

title: The Thirteenth Truck (1953-08-16)
plotSynopsis: A six-man desert commando team slips behind German lines, disguises its vehicle as part of a Nazi convoy and becomes the unexpected thirteenth truck. They infiltrate an airfield, sabotage it and escape in a captured staff car without losing a man; a medal taken from a German officer turns out to be a rare Hitler Knight's Cross, leaving them wondering just how important their prisoner had been.

title: The Man from Tomorrow (1953-08-23)
plotSynopsis: Former fighter pilot Dick Kenman is chosen for an experiment that heightens his senses until he develops an uncanny ability to perceive danger and possibilities beyond ordinary knowledge. Realizing governments could turn him into a weapon or possession, he refuses the lucrative contract and chooses instead to use his abilities for medical work, with Dr. Frost joining him.

title: The Game (1953-08-30)
plotSynopsis: Two teenage friends, bored and drinking in an empty house, turn a dare into a game of Russian roulette with a real revolver. Each pull of the trigger pushes their bravado closer to panic until the game finally breaks under the strain; afterward the shaken boys clean up and take the gun away, painfully aware of how close their attempt to prove courage came to killing one of them.

title: Train from Oebisfelde -1 (1953-09-06)
plotSynopsis: British operative Bruce Callender escorts defecting nuclear physicist Herrick westward by train after Herrick escapes from East Germany with critical information. Agents learn that a bomb has been planted aboard and will explode if the train stops before reaching the river, forcing Callender and railway staff to search the moving train while time runs out. After eliminating innocent suspects, Callender traces the saboteur to a locked compartment at the end of the train, climbs outside, shoots him through the window, and allows the bomb to be disarmed before the train stops.

title: Train from Oebisfelde -2 (1953-09-06)
plotSynopsis: British operative Bruce Callender escorts defecting nuclear physicist Herrick westward by train after Herrick escapes from East Germany with critical information. Agents learn that a bomb has been planted aboard and will explode if the train stops before reaching the river, forcing Callender and railway staff to search the moving train while time runs out. After eliminating innocent suspects, Callender traces the saboteur to a locked compartment at the end of the train, climbs outside, shoots him through the window, and allows the bomb to be disarmed before the train stops.

title: The Abominable Snowman (1953-09-13)
plotSynopsis: Three climbers and Sherpa Narsang enter the Himalayas to prove the existence of the Abominable Snowman despite local warnings. One expedition member is killed, Narsang is badly injured, and the surviving climber finally shoots a Yeti at close range, only to have an avalanche bury the body and erase the physical proof before he escapes the mountain alive.

title: The Log (1953-09-20)
plotSynopsis: Reporter Bill Rollins joins former submarine commander Jan Sabatos as the old officer learns his beloved Sea Gull has been sold for scrap. Sabatos takes the submarine to sea one last time and resists orders to surrender until depth charges cripple her; he finally sends the crew out through the escape chamber, gives Rollins his final log, and remains aboard as the submarine sinks.

title: The Untouchable (1953-09-27)
plotSynopsis: Fastidious chemical engineer Henry Ridell is already terrified of germs when a leper touches his bare skin in India. His fear becomes an obsession with washing and then with patches of numb flesh that convince him he has leprosy, ending in a breakdown and removal from India; months later at home, a tiny ant on his arm causes sudden pain, showing that sensation has returned even though his terror has not completely left him.

title: Zero Hour (1953-10-04)
plotSynopsis: Parents dismiss a new children's game called 'Invasion' as harmless make-believe, even as youngsters everywhere follow instructions from a mysterious figure named Drill and prepare for a five o'clock 'zero hour.' When the appointed time comes, explosions begin, alien visitors enter the houses, and the children calmly admit the invaders while their terrified parents realize the game was real.

title: Elementals (1953-10-11)
plotSynopsis: Cab driver Dave Latimer and his fiancée Cathy accept a rich man's experiment testing whether love can survive total deprivation for a cash prize. Locked together without food, hunger reduces them toward animal desperation, but when a single slice of bread is finally offered, Dave remembers who Cathy is and gives it to her; the experimenter, disgusted with himself, ends the test and orders them released with the money.

title: The Bird of Paradise (1954-03-11)
plotSynopsis: A fortune hunter searching a remote island for rare birds of paradise encounters a mysterious woman and her giant protector, and his own greed ultimately defeats him.

title: Violent Night (1954-03-18)
plotSynopsis: During a Caribbean uprising, a plantation owner flees a rebel leader bent on revenge and receives unexpected aid from the rebel's own daughter.

title: The Second Shot -Repeat (1954-03-25)
plotSynopsis: A brilliant young French officer has built a deadly reputation by forcing perceived insults into duels he almost always wins. When his latest romantic rivalry leads to another challenge, a senior officer arranges a final encounter in which the duelist believes he has drawn the empty pistol and must face certain death; only afterward does he learn that neither weapon was loaded, a calculated lesson in the fear and responsibility he had imposed on others.

title: The Return (1954-04-01)
plotSynopsis: Reiser spends years searching for a place without struggle and is finally led beyond an Arab town into a hidden valley whose people claim to have achieved perfect peace. He soon discovers that their perfection depends on total conformity, without ambition, risk, disagreement or even resistance, and he flees back to the imperfect outside world, only to learn that what felt like a brief absence has lasted a full year.

title: The Scarlet Plague (1954-04-08)
plotSynopsis: Professor James Smith watches the Scarlet Plague race across America, killing within minutes and unleashing panic and violence as civilization collapses. He and Myra appear to be the last survivors in San Francisco and begin imagining a future in which they rebuild humanity together, only for Smith to see the scarlet rash appear on Myra's face as well.

title: Affair at Mandrake (1954-04-15)
plotSynopsis: A British colonel takes command of a secret rocket installation and becomes the target of an espionage plot that culminates in betrayal and violence.

title: The Adversary (1954-05-06)
plotSynopsis: A ruthless captain plans to wreck a steamer and steal its pearl cargo, but blackmail from an adversary and an unforeseen turn threaten the scheme.

title: An Ordinary Man (1954-06-03)
plotSynopsis: A seemingly ordinary tourist on a Mediterranean cruise is drawn into a criminal conspiracy after a beautiful stranger places a valuable secret in his hands.

title: Benscelina and the Fisherman (1954-06-10)
plotSynopsis: A fisherman's search for trout on a lonely Irish moor becomes a desperate escape after meeting a gypsy woman pursued by a violent man.

title: Bloodwaters (1954-06-17)
plotSynopsis: Diver Trent is lured into the South American interior by Murdoch, an old enemy obsessed with recovering a chest of gold from a deadly river. Murdoch keeps Trent's name off the official expedition list and later leaves him hanging helplessly while hauling up the treasure, but piranhas swarm the blood-filled water; when the winch fails, Murdoch clings to the falling gold and is dragged down to the fish he intended to leave for Trent.

title: Judgment Day at Crippled Deer (1954-06-24)
plotSynopsis: At the isolated Crippled Deer trading post, a blizzard traps a small group with Blakey, who is blamed for the disappearance and presumed murder of Marco. Convinced they are administering frontier justice, the others hang Blakey, only to be horrified when Marco arrives alive moments later.

title: The Dark Wall (1954-07-01)
plotSynopsis: Alan seeks help for his wife Joyce after violent blackouts turn her from loving and frightened into a threatening stranger. In an isolated Andorran village, a doctor concludes two opposing personalities are battling within her; the violent self finally boasts that it has killed Alan, while the remaining Joyce awakens among strangers with no understanding of what her other self has done.

title: The Birds (1954-07-10)
plotSynopsis: Disabled veteran Nat and his family notice birds gathering in strange, coordinated masses before the creatures suddenly begin attacking people and houses across England. Nat fortifies the cottage, survives assaults through windows and the chimney, finds neighboring farmers killed, and listens as broadcasts fall silent while larger birds methodically tear at the house, leaving the family trapped as the attacks continue.

title: Eye of Evil (1954-07-17)
plotSynopsis: Stephen Lorring searches Burma for his missing friend Campbell and follows clues to an ancient temple cult whose beliefs center on beauty, evil and the power of sight. He finds Campbell alive but blind by choice after surrendering to the cult's doctrine, and although Lorring flees the temple and its priestess, he leaves knowing that its fascination has taken hold of him and may someday draw him back.

title: Flood on the Goodwins -Vic Perrin (1954-07-24)
plotSynopsis: One-armed veteran Dundas helps recover victims from a wartime sinking in the English Channel, then later takes aboard a German operative who offers him thousands of pounds for passage to safety. Dundas pretends to accept the bargain but strands the man on the Goodwin Sands at low tide, leaving him to face the rising sea and the fate of the men he helped kill.

title: Night of the Guns (1954-07-31)
plotSynopsis: Two young Americans on a dream trip to Haiti are mistaken for the men bringing guns to a revolutionary movement. A woman connected to the mix-up is killed, and the travelers are captured first by one faction and then by its enemies; taken to the Citadel to be executed because neither side can risk letting them talk, they turn on their captor and survive the deadly misunderstanding.

title: The Price of the Head -Hans Conreid (1954-08-07)
plotSynopsis: Abusive drunk Christopher Pellith is repeatedly protected by the devoted native Karaki, who helps him flee after murder and nurses him through a grueling canoe voyage. Only after reaching Karaki's homeland beyond British authority does Pellith learn the truth: Karaki's years of loyalty were an investment in the magnificent red-haired head he intends to take as a trophy.

title: The Coward (1954-08-14)
plotSynopsis: Former pilot Frank Dorian, branded a coward after surviving a crash that killed his passengers, returns to the Caribbean determined to recover money hidden at the wreck. He and Maria reach the island with the dangerous Rico, but a violent fight leaves Dorian wounded and Rico dead; when Rico's unmanned boat drifts back within reach, Frank and Maria escape and Frank resolves to tell the full truth about the old crash.

title: Two and Two Make Four (1954-08-21)
plotSynopsis: Merchant seaman David Parker awakens near Dover convinced he was in Calais only hours earlier and follows the contradiction to a secret wartime tunnel beneath the English Channel. The man exploiting the tunnel tries to kill David and traveler Emily Haydock to protect the secret, but they escape through it to France; once safely in Calais, they discover they cannot relocate the entrance because the sign they copied was only an air-raid-shelter marker.

title: The King of Owanatu (1954-08-28)
plotSynopsis: Remington and his mate Haggart reach a hidden Pacific island while searching for black pearls and discover that its ruler, Jerome, controls access through a concealed gate in the reef. Remington falls for Jerome's daughter Mikaela and plans to escape with her, but Haggart betrays the plan and tries to steal the pearls; after the betrayal ends violently, Remington recovers the treasure, keeps only enough for Mikaela and throws the rest back into the sea.

title: The Boiling Sea (1954-09-04)
plotSynopsis: A wartime cargo ship carrying Rangers is caught over a newly forming submarine volcano as the sea heats, pumice rises and an erupting crater walls them in. The crew finds a narrow break, threads the ship and boats through just before the volcano explodes, and survives the enormous seismic wave that follows.

title: Carnival in Vienna -1 (1954-09-11)
plotSynopsis: Carnival worker Johnny Allison sees a chance to steal a wealthy American tourist's $23,000 letter of credit, disables the Ferris wheel to strand the man high above the midway, then forges his identity and withdraws the money. His drunken associate Joey demands a share and Allison kills him, then his girlfriend Lily rejects both the stolen fortune and Allison's endless promises. Violence follows again, and Allison flees through the carnival's Hall of Mirrors, surrounded by distorted reflections of himself as his scheme collapses into murder, fear and self-confrontation.

title: Carnival in Vienna -2 (1954-09-11)
plotSynopsis: Carnival worker Johnny Allison sees a chance to steal a wealthy American tourist's $23,000 letter of credit, disables the Ferris wheel to strand the man high above the midway, then forges his identity and withdraws the money. Violence follows again, and Allison flees through the carnival's Hall of Mirrors, surrounded by distorted reflections of himself as his scheme collapses into murder, fear and self-confrontation.

title: The Target (1954-09-18)
plotSynopsis: Kennedy tracks fugitive Arthur Matson to a remote island believing Matson stole a fortune and must be dealt with for Laura. Matson reveals that Laura has controlled the money all along and manipulated Kennedy into becoming her killer, forcing all three into a violent final confrontation when Laura arrives with a gun.

title: The Heart of Kali -Last Show (1954-09-25)
plotSynopsis: Daniel Carley returns to India obsessed with stealing the huge ruby known as the Heart of Kali and murders his way back to the hidden temple. Instead of killing him, the priests make him the new guardian of the jewel, revealing that the previous guardian was himself a thief sentenced to watch it for forty years; decades later Carley is still trapped beside the ruby, waiting desperately for another would-be thief to take his place.

title: Elusive Card Game (1950-01-12)
plotSynopsis: After Christmas bills alarm Jim, he imposes a strict economy campaign on the family, only to undermine it himself when his desire for a poker game turns a supposedly inexpensive evening at home into an unexpectedly costly one.

title: A Weekend in the Country (1950-02-16)
plotSynopsis: The Anderson children push for a snow-filled weekend at a mountain cabin, but turning their simple getaway idea into a real family trip proves much more complicated.

plotSynopsis: This Father Knows Best installment centers on “Jim's Birthday,” the family situation identified in the transcribed episode index.
