title: Norman Conquest of England (1953-12-27)
plotSynopsis: The series finale imagines the Norman invasion failing in 1066, leaving England unconquered by William and using that failed conquest as the starting point for a different English history.

title: Suspense 1948-01-10 (279) The Khandi Tooth Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam Spade is drawn back into a Maltese Falcon-style case when Casper Gutman returns in pursuit of another fabulous object, leaving Spade facing a murder charge.

title: A Shipment of Mute Fate
plotSynopsis: A deadly bushmaster snake escapes aboard a cruise ship, leaving passengers and crew trapped with a silent, highly venomous threat.

title: Russian New Year
plotSynopsis: Russian conspirators prepare to assassinate the Czar and royal officials during a New Year theater celebration, but the plot turns against its leader.

title: Second Class Passenger
plotSynopsis: A mild-mannered clerk on a cruise retrieves a passenger’s forgotten idol in Mozambique and is suddenly pursued through the city before his ship sails.

title: Freedom This Way
plotSynopsis: Questioned by U.S. immigration officials, a refugee recounts how he assumed another man's identity to guide a family through a dangerous escape from Communist Europe.

title: Frankie and Johnny
plotSynopsis: A New Orleans retelling of the “Frankie and Johnny” ballad follows a betrayed woman, her unfaithful lover, and the violent consequences of jealousy.

title: Door of Gold
plotSynopsis: Two archaeologists honeymooning in Peru enter a legendary Incan treasure complex, where ancient traps and altered passageways leave them separated and fighting to escape.

title: Murder and Aunt Delia
plotSynopsis: A drifter murders a lookalike and assumes his identity to claim an elderly aunt’s fortune, only to encounter a crucial fact he never anticipated.

title: Two Hundred and Twenty-Seven Minutes of Hate
sortKey: 0|1957-02-24|00687|two hundred and twenty-seven minutes of hate
plotSynopsis: A furious radio employee steals a small plane to terrorize his former workplace, forcing police and the Air Force to solve the problem he cannot: landing safely.

title: Present Tense
plotSynopsis: A condemned murderer seems to escape again and again, only for reality to reset around him as his desperate fantasies collapse back toward the gas chamber.

title: The Paralta Map
plotSynopsis: A ruthless treasure hunter leads a party after the Lost Dutchman Mine, but greed, shifting alliances and distrust become as dangerous as the desert itself.

title: The Outer Limit
plotSynopsis: A test pilot pushing a rocket-plane to unprecedented altitude encounters an alien craft and returns with an ominous warning that his skeptical superiors struggle to dismiss.

title: Shooting Star
plotSynopsis: A furious actress follows the producer who rejected her to his secluded retreat, takes him hostage and demands the career opportunity she believes he denied her.

title: A Good Neighbor
plotSynopsis: A diamond thief hides in a quiet Maine town, only to find his relentlessly helpful elderly neighbor far more dangerous to his secrecy than the police.

title: Vanishing Lady
plotSynopsis: A young Englishwoman’s mother vanishes from a Paris hotel, and every witness denies she ever existed as the daughter desperately searches for the truth.

title: Thou Shalt Not Commit

title: Lion Hunting (1940-03-20)
plotSynopsis: The recording opens with an extended version of Abbott and Costello's baseball-name routine before shifting into outdoor and hunting comedy. Abbott tries to explain deer ticks and other hunting hazards, Lou mangles the terminology, and the pair prepare for a hunting trip where Marilyn Maxwell and the orchestra join the program. Lou eventually boasts of a lion-skin trophy, only for Abbott to discover a manufacturer's label that exposes the trophy as a fake.

title: With Wc Fields Abbott and Costello (1941-09-21)
plotSynopsis: W.C. Fields is the featured guest in a show built around Lou's need to apologize after a prank involving a wire across Fields's garden path. The reconciliation repeatedly collapses into insults about Fields's nose, health and drinking image, while the supporting cast tries to keep the peace. Music, sponsor comedy and more Fields-Costello exchanges fill out the broadcast.

title: Lou Subs for Joe Dimaggio (1942-05-11)
plotSynopsis: A telegram says injured Joe DiMaggio wants Lou to take his place, launching a baseball-heavy show in which Abbott tries to explain players and positions while Lou mangles the terminology. The program includes the familiar 'Who's on First?' style baseball wordplay, a sporting-goods-shop routine and music before a closing telegram from DiMaggio jokes about Lou's supposed natural talents.

title: Bank Robbery W Marle (1942-10-15)
plotSynopsis: With Marlene Dietrich as guest, the show mixes football and studio banter with a comic crime-and-western setup. Lou is pushed into the role of a lawman who must clear himself by chasing a gang of bank robbers and cattle rustlers, leading to horse-riding, posse and frontier jokes, while Connie Haines, the orchestra and Dietrich's guest material round out the broadcast.

title: Knights in Shining A (1942-11-19)
plotSynopsis: Broadcast from an Air Transport Command base at Long Beach with Merle Oberon as guest, the show opens with aviation and military-base jokes before shifting to fashions and a movie sketch. Oberon plays a princess in a story of the knights of old, while Lou becomes her comic knight and the routines mix romance, costumes, military humor and wartime service messages.

title: Hunting Guide with Claire Trevor (1943-01-14)
plotSynopsis: After opening jokes about the meat shortage, vitamins and Lou's appetite, Abbott and Lou prepare for a hunting trip and expect their guide to be a man. Guest Claire Trevor arrives as the guide instead, prompting routines about guns, animals, tracking, her screen career and Lou's surprise at following a woman through the woods. Connie Haines, the orchestra and wartime recruitment material complete the broadcast.

title: At the Circus with Alan Hale (1943-03-16)
plotSynopsis: The circus has come to town, and Lou reminisces about a family history of circus performers before the broadcast moves into sideshow and charity-fair comedy. Guest stars Sally Eilers and Alan Hale join the cast as Lou becomes the target in a baseball-throwing attraction, repeatedly taking hits to the head while Abbott insists he endure it for charity. Music and wartime service material round out the show.

title: Nylon Stockings With (1943-11-18)
plotSynopsis: Lou promises a girlfriend a pair of scarce nylon stockings and joins the rush when a store announces that only one pair will be sold. Bugs Bunny-style comedy and a frantic crowd lead into guest Lucille Ball offering Lou a movie job in exchange for the nylons. Lou eventually gives Ball the stockings, loses the favor of the women who expected them, and ends the show seeking consolation from Abbott.

title: Thanksgiving Day (1943-11-25)
plotSynopsis: On Thanksgiving, Abbott invites Lou to dinner but quickly regrets it as Lou, his brother Sebastian and the regular cast turn the preparations into chaos. The show runs through turkey, stuffing, formal seating and kitchen jokes, with Connie Haines and the orchestra providing music. Lou's heavily seasoned stuffing becomes the final gag when he admits even he cannot get close enough to taste it.

title: Trip to Palm Springs (1943-12-02)
plotSynopsis: Abbott and Lou plan a trip to Palm Springs, but Lou has already overturned a car with Mrs. Niles and Ken Niles underneath it and spends the show explaining the resulting traffic trouble. At Palm Springs they meet guest Veronica Lake and pitch her as a leading lady, producing Latin, movie and desert-riding jokes. Lou's driving catches up with him at the end when a police officer arrives to arrest him and Abbott refuses to let Lou drive them to the station.

title: English Butler With (1943-12-09)
plotSynopsis: Abbott prepares a fancy dinner for actress Lynn Bari, and Lou's efforts to understand household help and etiquette lead into jokes about butlers, wages and domestic work. Guest Arthur Treacher plays the polished English authority figure and later demonstrates how Lou should approach and kiss Bari, while Connie Haines and the orchestra supply the musical portions.

title: The Wild West with L (1943-12-16)
plotSynopsis: Guest Lynn Bari joins a show that begins with Lou dressing wildly to impress her and moves into Abbott's attempt to stage an original play with Bari and Lou. Their rehearsal becomes a string of butcher-shop, romance and leading-man jokes before Lou turns the ending into an exaggerated Wild West tale in which the number of attacking Indians shrinks every time Abbott challenges him.

title: The Lawyer with Bert (1943-12-30)
plotSynopsis: Lou's problems with a dog and a threatened legal case turn into a lawyer-and-courtroom program. Abbott calculates Lou's supposed wages down to almost nothing, Lou pleads for money to hire counsel, and the case becomes a string of legal, salary, animal and witness jokes before returning to Lou and the troublesome dog at the close.

title: Lous Engaged to Jud (1944-01-06)
plotSynopsis: On the first show of the new year, Abbott tries to teach Lou how to court a woman properly, acting out a doorstep proposal and romance lesson that Lou repeatedly derails. Guest Judy Canova becomes the center of the marriage comedy, with Lou imagining himself engaged until the relationship collapses in another kissing gag. Music and the regular cast fill out the program before next week's Peter Lorre appearance is teased.

title: Visit to a Sanitariu (1944-01-13)
plotSynopsis: Lou arrives soaked and sneezing, setting off routines about colds, exercise and physical fitness before a strongman-style professor demonstrates his supposed powers. Guest Peter Lorre then invites Lou to his isolated sanitarium, where eerie patients, a body without a visible head and Lorre's sinister medical manner frighten him. The visit ends with a comic diagnosis that Lou's appendix must be removed, which he agrees to only if the operation is somehow performed from the back.

title: With the Great Gildersleeve (1944-01-20)
plotSynopsis: Guest Harold Peary as the Great Gildersleeve joins a show that begins with shipyard, military and family jokes before moving into music lessons and neighborhood comedy. Young characters practice trumpet and other instruments, a football is kicked through a window, and the later football sequence turns into a chaotic game in which Lou struggles with signals, counting and carrying the ball while Gildersleeve and Abbott pile on the penalties and jokes.

title: Charles Laughton (1944-02-10)
plotSynopsis: Valentine's Day wordplay opens the show before guest Charles Laughton joins Abbott and Lou for a dramatic-sketch discussion. Laughton boasts of a family of seafaring men and is drawn into a shipboard play in which Lou expects him to serve as a supporting character, leading to theatrical and nautical comedy. Connie Haines and the orchestra provide music, and the broadcast closes with a Treasury war-bond appeal.

title: Making a Movie With (1944-02-17)
plotSynopsis: After comedy about Abbott becoming mayor of Sherman Oaks, the show turns to a movie-making sketch with guest Dorothy Lamour. Abbott casts himself as Lamour's leading man and Lou as the stuntman, forcing Lou through horse-riding and desert-adventure gags before the trio play out an Arabian-style rescue scene with Lamour as the captive princess.

title: With Hedda Hopper P (1944-03-02)
plotSynopsis: Abbott, acting as mayor of Sherman Oaks, decides the town needs its own newspaper and puts Lou into the publishing business. Guest Hedda Hopper is recruited as gossip columnist, prompting routines about scandal, Hollywood contacts, keyholes and Lou's own hopeless news sense, with music and supporting-character comedy between the newspaper scenes.

title: Snow White with Blon (1944-03-09)
plotSynopsis: The broadcast begins with Navy and wartime paper-drive comedy, with Abbott trying to collect waste paper as mayor of Sherman Oaks. Lou accidentally loses the show's script in the collection, bringing Blondie and Dagwood Bumstead into the confusion as guest stars while the cast tries to get the broadcast on the air through improvised routines, music and crossover comedy.

plotSynopsis: Lou buys a horse named Peanut Butter and insists on entering the animal in a race, while Abbott and young Sebastian try to explain bridles, bits, reins and training. Lou's horse loses after its rider follows a doctor's instruction to 'watch his stomach' by riding underneath the animal instead of on top.

title: Grade School (1944-11-16)
plotSynopsis: Lou receives a telegram from his old Public School 15 in Paterson inviting him back for the annual school play. The program builds schoolroom comedy around Lou's long grade-school career, his young brother Sebastian, an English teacher and the confusion surrounding the play, with music and the show's usual supporting characters between routines.

title: Visit to Tin Pan All (1944-12-07)
plotSynopsis: Lou tries to imitate Bing Crosby and decides the show needs a more sophisticated song, sending the comedy toward Tin Pan Alley. Abbott and Lou encounter would-be songwriters and musicians whose instruments, titles and musical terminology become verbal traps, while Lou offers his own mystery ballad and Connie Haines performs the featured song. The program stays centered on songwriting and music-business parody through the close.

title: Christmas Shopping (1944-12-14)
plotSynopsis: With Christmas approaching, Abbott pushes Lou to buy presents for family and friends. The show follows Lou through gift-shopping confusion, jokes with his brother Sebastian and Mr. Kitzel, and department-store routines involving pajamas, an easy chair and other presents, with seasonal music and a closing appeal for Army nurses.

title: Merchant Marines (1945-01-25)
plotSynopsis: Lou arrives in a naval-style uniform announcing that he plans to join the Merchant Marine. Abbott quizzes his nautical knowledge, and the show follows with sea-going, swimming, island and shipboard wordplay, including Mr. Kitzel-style language confusion and a later bit with Lou's brother Sebastian, while music and Merchant Marine recruiting material frame the comedy.

title: Stolen Oranges (1945-02-01)
plotSynopsis: Lou's attempt to tend his backyard orange tree leads to trouble with Mrs. Beanbag and a comic court case over the damage. Mr. Kitzel becomes part of the legal proceedings, Lou is found liable for fifty cents, Abbott insists on appealing instead of simply paying, and the escalating courtroom jokes eventually put Lou in jail before he is released and exonerated.

title: Guest Rudy Vallee (1945-02-15)
plotSynopsis: Guest Rudy Vallee becomes the target of a long opening routine in which Lou hopelessly tangles the rumor that Vallee sings through his nose with the words 'rumor,' 'nose' and 'false.' Mr. Kitzel contributes jokes before Vallee enters, and the later featured sketch turns into a comic Jack-and-the-Beanstalk scene with Lou climbing toward a giant and staging an exaggerated death. Connie Haines and the orchestra provide the musical portions.

title: New Press Agent (1945-03-08)

Connie Haines, the orchestra and a Merchant Marine appeal complete the broadcast.

Connie Haines supplies the final 'cure' with a kiss, while music and regular-cast routines connect the changing sketches.

title: Costellos Beauty Sh (1945-12-27)
plotSynopsis: Lou opens his own beauty shop and boasts about miracle hair restorers, facials and other treatments while Abbott questions whether he knows anything about the business. Lena enters the shop and their romance deteriorates amid beauty-treatment and language jokes; by the end she leaves for Brooklyn and Lou admits the shop has failed. The final 1945 broadcast closes with year-end wishes, music and bond reminders.

title: The Sheriff of North (1946-04-25)
plotSynopsis: Lou appears in cowboy clothes claiming to be a sheriff, so Abbott quizzes his courage, horsemanship and gun skills. Mrs. Niles then asks for help against cattle rustlers threatening her ranch. Lou confronts a supposed outlaw with great confidence, only to be tricked into handing over his gun and valuables; the crook escapes, leaving Abbott to ridicule Lou's claim that he knows how to handle rustlers.

title: Incorrigible (1946-10-03)
plotSynopsis: Abbott opens the new season determined to reform Lou, calling him crude, vulgar and a constant embarrassment and refusing to introduce him to guest Marilyn Maxwell until he improves his manners. Lou immediately proves Abbott's point during the introduction, while Maxwell sings 'I've Got the Sun in the Morning' and the regular cast add more behavior and etiquette comedy. By the close Abbott softens, says he wants to be Lou's pal again and gives him another chance to change.

title: Lou Goes to Racetrac (1947-03-13)
plotSynopsis: Still trying to unload money before income-tax time, Lou heads to the racetrack hoping to lose his winnings. Tipsters recommend supposedly hopeless horses, but every attempt to make a bad bet backfires and leaves him with even more money. By the close Abbott points out that Lou has failed completely at getting rid of the cash and must now pay the tax, while Lou remains cheerfully focused on springtime.

title: Nuts and Bolts (1947-04-10)
plotSynopsis: Dating and society jokes lead into Lou's attempt to sell a miracle spot remover around the studio. He tries the product on clothing and neckties, tangles with a comic sales prospect and flirts with Marilyn Maxwell while demonstrating the cleaner. The broadcast closes by looking ahead to the baseball-season opener and a promised Joe DiMaggio telegram, with the regular music and cast material around the sales routines.

title: Baseball Player (1947-04-17)
plotSynopsis: Lou again receives word from Joe DiMaggio while the star is recovering from a foot operation and imagines taking his place as a ballplayer. Abbott walks him through baseball names, positions and equipment, producing extended verbal confusion and the team's classic baseball routine, followed by a sporting-goods scene and a closing DiMaggio telegram teasing Lou's abilities.

title: Lou Builds a House (1947-04-24)
plotSynopsis: Lou decides he needs a better home and buys a lot that a salesman presents as prime property even though the pitch is plainly dubious. Abbott takes him to a contractor, where house plans, bungalows, lots, deeds and construction terms become verbal traps; by the close Lou has managed to end up without the house he expected and jokes about moving in with an uncle at Alcatraz.

title: Lou Joins the New York Yankees (1947-06-19)
plotSynopsis: Lou imagines replacing the injured Joe DiMaggio and joining the Yankees, giving Abbott another excuse to explain baseball names and positions. The conversation turns into extended Bob Feller and roster wordplay, followed by a sporting-goods-shop scene and the classic baseball routine. A closing telegram from DiMaggio jokes that Lou has spiked teeth, a club head and has been off his base for years.

title: Costello Pays Income Tax (1948-03-10)
plotSynopsis: Income-tax season has Lou trying to understand deductions, dependents and brackets, with Uncle Mike's absurd return and an accountant adding to the confusion. Lou becomes so desperate to reduce his taxable income that he tries giving money away, even handing cash to a robber who then decides he also needs to unload his own earnings before March 15. The final gag brings back a woman Lou earlier gave $1,000, who has turned the money into a large horse-racing payoff.

title: Babysitting Job (1948-04-28)
plotSynopsis: After racetrack and city-hall jokes, Lou and Abbott look for babysitting work and encounter a succession of comic situations involving babies, medicines and household chores. Lou refuses castor oil while trying to make a child take it, and the final job leaves Abbott with the baby while Lou is assigned to clean the chicken coops; Lou closes by promoting a child-welfare contest aimed at combating juvenile delinquency.

title: Tony's Home Permanent
plotSynopsis: Dating and marriage jokes open the show, followed by a musical number and more comedy about Lou's forgetfulness and Hollywood life. The featured Sam Shovel segment brings back Waterfront Lil in a smuggling case; Sam bluntly questions her, tries to arrest her and is shot during the struggle. He refuses an ambulance because Los Angeles traffic seems more dangerous than walking to the hospital, ending the detective parody on the same comic reversal.

title: Case of the Russian Diplomat
plotSynopsis: The broadcast introduces its Sam Shovel feature as 'the case of the Russian diplomat who took the 6 PM boat back to Russia, or Red Sails in a Sunset.' After the usual spoof sponsor and detective-office routines, the action centers on killer-burglar Lefty Lumphead, who comes after Sam, boasts that he robs houses while Abbott and Costello are on the air, and is shot in the shoulder during the confrontation. Lefty's girlfriend then turns the emergency into another romance gag while the cast closes by crediting the show's writers and band.

title: Case of a Boy Named Tony
plotSynopsis: Traffic, police and family-law jokes open the broadcast before Marilyn Williams supplies the musical feature. The later Sam Shovel detective sketch centers on Waterfront Lil and a smuggling case; Sam questions her with his usual blunt logic, the confrontation ends with Sam being shot, and he refuses an ambulance because Los Angeles traffic seems more dangerous than walking to the hospital. Hollywood and cast banter frame the detective parody.

title: Case of Two Gun Gertie
plotSynopsis: After Uncle Mike, romance and studio-sound-effects comedy, the featured Sam Shovel sketch brings Two-Gun Gertie into the detective's office while police are looking for her. Gertie claims the authorities think she is hiding something, mixes threats with flirtation and offers to become Sam's devoted companion if he helps her. The case dissolves into the show's usual romantic parody when Gertie kisses Sam so forcefully that he needs someone in the audience to sew the buttons back onto his vest.

title: The Murder at the Radio Quiz Show
sortKey: 0|9999-99-99|00024|the murder at the radio quiz show
plotSynopsis: The New Year's Eve broadcast opens with Lou receiving a threatening letter and joking about searching the audience for whoever sent it. The show moves through Hollywood, secretary and musical material into a Sam Shovel detective segment and a New Year's party, where the detective's 'entertainment' consists of destroying a borrowed watch during a magic trick, before the cast closes with wishes for 1949.

title: Sam Shovel-Moonshiner Zeke
plotSynopsis: After romance and cast banter, the featured Sam Shovel case sends the detective after moonshiner Zeke. Sam and Lieutenant Abbott locate Zeke's still, catch him making a lethal-sounding corn liquor from ingredients such as turpentine and bleach, and arrest him. Forced to taste the evidence, Sam immediately jokes that the moonshine has made chest hair grow so thick he can no longer see where he is going.

title: Sam Shovel-Reach for the Sky
plotSynopsis: House, family and dating jokes lead into another Sam Shovel detective parody. A man asks Sam to find his missing wife, whose disappearance from the breakfast stove is immediately undercut by absurd clues, and the case later becomes a stickup in which Sam and Lieutenant Abbott are ordered to hold up a ceiling while the crooks tear out a wall. The detectives realize the writers have trapped them in the gag, but keep holding the ceiling as the show moves to its closing announcements.

title: General Custers Last Hamburger
plotSynopsis: The show opens with comic stories about Uncle Mike's gold discovery, inventions and Lou's romance troubles with Viola. The featured Sam Shovel sketch then places a supposedly patriotic organization in the office next door, only for it to be exposed as a nest of foreign spies whose gunman rants about killing radio detectives and even recipe-program personalities. The cast closes by joking about the Sam Shovel series and the writing staff.

title: Case of the Curbstone Murder
plotSynopsis: The show opens with Lou training as a boxer and arguing about strength, cauliflower ears and prizefighting before moving through music and romance jokes with Viola. The featured Sam Shovel parody takes the detective to a hospital case, where he claims he once practiced medicine and offers to operate on a patient named Shirley. His 'surgical instruments' turn out to include a hammer, chisel and blowtorch, only for the final joke to reveal he merely needs them to open his medical satchel.

title: It Was Time for a Change
plotSynopsis: The program introduces new singer Hal Winters amid jokes about Lou's love life, movie stars and Hollywood acquaintances. Its featured Sam Shovel detective sketch has a frightened woman hiring Sam because Count Boris has pursued her for years; after she hides under the desk, Boris arrives and turns the situation into another absurd reversal rather than a conventional crime solution.

title: Im All Yours in Buttons and Bows
sortKey: 0|9999-99-99|00042|im all yours in buttons and bows
plotSynopsis: This Christmas-season show begins with Lou's money and romance jokes and moves into a department-store/Santa Claus sequence full of gift and escalator confusion. The later Sam Shovel-style dramatic sketch turns serious enough to center on a troubled boy, with Lou arguing that neglect and lack of understanding can push children wrong and helping persuade a policeman to show mercy on Christmas Eve before the cast closes with holiday wishes.

title: Playing the Piano with Janet Blair
plotSynopsis: Guest Janet Blair joins Abbott and Lou around a charity-entertainment setup, leading to jokes about club concerts and Lou's lack of musical ability. A professor attempts to teach Lou the piano through absurd technical instructions involving chords, melodies and counterpoint, while Janet Blair and the cast add music and performance comedy. The broadcast also includes a wartime tribute to a Navy serviceman before the signoff.

title: Sorrywrongrhumba
plotSynopsis: The broadcast mixes Uncle Mike and romance jokes with Lou's continuing troubles with women and a musical performance of 'Buttons and Bows.' In the featured Sam Shovel sketch, ex-convict Dora confronts the detective for having sent her to prison, alternately threatening revenge and admitting she is still attracted to him. Their encounter ends in another exaggerated kiss-and-collapse gag before the cast credits the writers and producer.

title: The Adventure Of The Hackensack Victory
plotSynopsis: Race investigates two vanished freighters and uncovers a deadly maritime insurance fraud tied to a prominent family's secrets.

title: The Adventure Of The Daring Debutante
plotSynopsis: The death of an English war bride sends Race after evidence that could clear an innocent man.

title: The Istanbul Adventure
plotSynopsis: Destroyed relief shipments lead Race into a black-market operation and a dangerous betrayal spanning postwar Europe.

title: The Adventure Of Seventeen Black
plotSynopsis: An apparent suicide and missing construction-company funds expose bribery, murder, and a carefully hidden conspiracy.

title: The Enoch Arden Adventure
plotSynopsis: A supposedly missing husband and a large life-insurance policy place Race inside a murderous domestic scheme.

title: The Adventure Of The Vanishing President
plotSynopsis: A string of missing ships reveals an arms-smuggling operation connected to plans for a political revolution.

title: The Adventure Of The Baradian Letters
plotSynopsis: A blackmail investigation quickly becomes murder as Race tries to identify the person behind the threats.

title: The Airborne Adventure
plotSynopsis: Courier duty involving advanced aircraft plans draws Race into murder and an international conspiracy.

title: The Adventure Of The Shanghai Incident
plotSynopsis: Race travels to Shanghai after another agent is murdered while investigating unexplained cargo losses.

title: The Adventure Of The Juvenile Passenger
plotSynopsis: A runaway orphan and a mysterious philanthropist pull Race into an unexpected murder investigation.

title: The Adventure Of The Reckless Daughter
plotSynopsis: Race uncovers a scheme to undermine a postwar European government by exploiting a statesman's rebellious daughter.

title: The Adventure Of The Silent Heart
plotSynopsis: A pattern of suspicious heart-attack deaths in New England leads Race to an elaborate insurance fraud.

title: The Adventure Of The Garrulous Bartender
plotSynopsis: A six-figure bank embezzlement sends Race into the criminal underworld of Juarez, Mexico.

title: The Adventure Of The Vanishing Favorite
plotSynopsis: Race is hired to protect a champion racehorse as sabotage and murder threaten an important match.

title: The Adventure Of The Embittered Secretary
plotSynopsis: A jewel theft opens onto a murdered secretary, a missing fortune, and dangerous organized-crime connections.

title: The Adventure Of The Talking Bullet
plotSynopsis: After a convicted killer escapes, a series of murders convinces Race that a larger conspiracy is operating.

title: The Adventure Of The Fat Mans Loot
sortKey: 1|1949-08-21|00017|the adventure of the fat mans loot
plotSynopsis: Race pursues a Nazi jewel hoarder across Europe and encounters a master of disguise living luxuriously in Monte Carlo.

title: The Adventure of The Generals Lady
plotSynopsis: In Tunis, Race uncovers a conspiracy involving political assassination, a beautiful woman, and a lucrative business plot.

title: The Adventure of The Violent Virtuoso
plotSynopsis: The murder of an old flame draws Race into jealousy, rivalry, and obsession among a circle of musicians.

title: The Adventure Of The Fourth Round Knockout
sortKey: 1|1949-09-11|00020|the adventure of the fourth round knockout
plotSynopsis: A boxer's death in the ring leads Race into gambling interests, murder, and betrayal.

title: The Adventure Of Three on a Match
sortKey: 1|1949-09-18|00021|the adventure of three on a match
plotSynopsis: Race tries to recover a stolen children's relief fund while navigating murder and repeated betrayals.

title: The Adventure Of The Roughnecks Will
plotSynopsis: A millionaire's will promises his fortune to the last surviving heir, turning potential beneficiaries into targets.

title: The Adventure Of The Green Doubloon
plotSynopsis: Race pursues an embezzler through Central America and winds up trapped with his quarry after a shipwreck.

title: The Adventure of The Sobbing Bodyguard
plotSynopsis: A friend's implication in a nightclub owner's death sends Race into insurance fraud and murder.

title: The Adventure Of The Divers Loot
plotSynopsis: Sunken gold off Cherbourg draws Race into a dangerous contest of deception and murder.

title: The Adventure of The Mormon Country
plotSynopsis: A kidnapping and large ransom demand lead Race through Mormon country as the case takes several unexpected turns.

title: The Adventure of The Brooklyn Accent
plotSynopsis: A life-insurance inquiry becomes a small-town murder case involving gambling, deceit, and a manipulated lynch mob.

title: The Adventure Of The Six Week Cure
sortKey: 1|1949-11-06|00028|the adventure of the six week cure
plotSynopsis: A stay at a Reno divorce ranch is disrupted by two murders and a web of hidden relationships.

title: The Adventure Of The Fairway Beauty
plotSynopsis: The murder of a champion golfer sends Race through jealousy, money, and secrets surrounding the sport.

title: The Adventure Of The Runway Queen
plotSynopsis: A radio singer's hidden burlesque career becomes leverage for blackmail, leading to prison escape and murder.

title: The Adventure Of The Lady in the Dark
sortKey: 1|1949-11-27|00031|the adventure of the lady in the dark
plotSynopsis: A doctor friend becomes the target of a hospital-centered murder plot, and Race works to identify who wants him dead.

title: The Adventure Of The Silent Tongue
plotSynopsis: A condemned man's final request points Race toward a concealed fortune and a clue hidden in bronze baby shoes.

title: The Adventure of The Candy Killing
plotSynopsis: Race returns home to help a friend accused of murder and discovers a broader conspiracy behind the killing.

title: The Adventure Of The Undecided Bride
plotSynopsis: A bride carrying a gun draws Race into murder, narcotics, and betrayal surrounding her wedding.

title: The Adventure Of The Gold Worshipper
plotSynopsis: A kidnapping in Macau leads Race into a dangerous gold-smuggling operation.

title: The Adventure Of The Pharaohs Staff
plotSynopsis: A priceless Egyptian artifact becomes the center of theft, deception, and murder.

title: The Adventure Of The House Divided
plotSynopsis: When an old friend is killed, Race finds blackmail and murder inside a wealthy but deeply divided family.

title: The Adventure Of The Count Trefanno Crest
sortKey: 1|1950-01-15|00038|the adventure of the count trefanno crest
plotSynopsis: A missing-person case opens onto blackmail, murder, and a scheme involving counterfeit jewelry.

title: The Adventure Of The Night Crawler
plotSynopsis: Dying worms at a commercial operation lead Race to gangsters and deliberate corporate sabotage.

title: The Adventure Of The Kettle Drum
plotSynopsis: An old flame, blackmail, and murder place suspicion on a husband while Race searches for the truth.

title: The Adventure Of The Loveable Character
plotSynopsis: An assassination attempt on an Indian prince reveals a dangerous conspiracy within the royal family.

title: The Adventure Of The Blackfriars Bridge
plotSynopsis: Suspicious insurance policies connect two American nightclub owners who die in London under mysterious circumstances.

title: The Adventure Of The Big Top
plotSynopsis: Threats against a wealthy woman lead Race into the dangerous world surrounding a traveling circus.

title: 460712 The Sam And Guiana Sovereign Caper
plotSynopsis: After Bernard Gilmore is reported murdered and robbed, Sam is hired by Gilmore's business partner to recover a stolen Guiana Sovereign. The search uncovers a web of suspects, blackmail and double-crosses, including the startling discovery that Gilmore survived the attack and has been hiding.

title: 460802 Sam and Psyche
plotSynopsis: Sam's investigation draws him into a case involving a psychoanalyst, blackmail and a trail of deaths. As he follows the evidence through conflicting stories and hidden motives, the mystery expands to include concealed microfilm and evidence connected with a grave.

title: 460809 The Death Dr Denhoff Caper
plotSynopsis: A surviving Sam Spade recording identified as “The Death Dr. Denhoff Caper.”

title: 470608 The Calcutta Trunk Caper
plotSynopsis: Constance Pendleton's sister hires Sam when Constance plans to marry Andreyev Brodnick, a Bulgarian with a sinister reputation. Sam's attempt to protect her sends the case toward India and into a dangerous tangle surrounding the prospective bridegroom.

title: 470615 The Convertible Caper
plotSynopsis: Miss Estrada hires Sam to recover a stolen convertible, then admits that she stole the car herself. The automobile's extraordinary value points Sam toward a much larger criminal scheme involving what is hidden in or connected with the vehicle.

title: 471005 The Adam Figg Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam is taken to a wealthy invalid's estate with a deceptively simple assignment: keep the old man alive. Gunshots, screams and suspicious people around the house quickly turn the bodyguard job into a full-scale mystery.

title: 480104 The One Hour Caper
plotSynopsis: A hit-and-run killing pulls Sam into a case involving a Dutch cigarette case, counterfeiting and a bullet apparently meant for him. With only a short window to work, he follows the clues toward the people behind the murder.

title: 480125 The Gold Key Caper
plotSynopsis: A mysterious gold key leads Sam into a case involving an old robbery, half a million dollars, murder and machine-gun violence. The key's real significance becomes central to finding the money and understanding who is willing to kill for it.

title: 480620 The Death Bed Caper
plotSynopsis: Dan Starbuck asks Sam to witness the statement of his dying brother, only for the dying man to accuse Dan of murder. A second deathbed statement complicates the case, forcing Sam to determine which declaration is false and why.

title: 480627 The Bail Bond Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam's former flame Vivian asks him to protect her husband, bail bondsman and ex-con Leo Scarlotti. Leo is being drawn into a dangerous criminal scheme connected with a fortune in bearer bonds, putting both his freedom and his life at risk.

title: 480704 The Rushlight Diamond Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam is hired to guard a valuable diamond intended for a wedding. When murder strikes the bride and groom's circle, the supposedly cursed gem becomes the center of a case filled with greed, deception and competing claims to the jewel.

title: 480711 The Wheel of Life Caper
plotSynopsis: An amnesiac woman named Poppy O'Farrell hires Sam while trying to recover her identity and understand the strange people around her. The trail leads to a bizarre object called the Wheel of Life and a murder involving a buzz saw.

title: 480718 The Missing Newshawk Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam is hired to find a missing crusading newspaper reporter who has been investigating organized crime. His search eventually points back toward the newspaper itself and raises disturbing questions about the publisher's connection to the disappearance.

title: 480725 The Mad Scientist Caper
plotSynopsis: Inventor Raymond Fox hires Sam to recover the formula for his creation, the Penatron. Fox's increasingly strange behavior and the people surrounding his invention send the investigation in an unexpected direction that ends with the inventor confined in a mental hospital.

title: 480801 The Dry Martini Caper
plotSynopsis: After a wealthy corporation chief is shot in broad daylight, Sam follows a carefully laid trail of clues. The investigation reveals that the victim had arranged an elaborate scheme of his own, turning the murder case into a calculated act of revenge.

title: 480808 The Bluebeard Caper
plotSynopsis: Ned Towers asks Sam to investigate his sister Sylvia's fiancé, a man whose previous wives have died under suspicious circumstances and whose finances benefited from their deaths. Sam must determine whether Sylvia is about to become the next victim of a modern Bluebeard.

title: 480815 The Critical Author Caper
plotSynopsis: After Gabrielle Leggitt disappears following her father's funeral, her stepmother hires Sam to find her. The investigation brings Sam into the orbit of a murder-mystery author and a family whose literary and personal secrets are closely entangled.

title: 480822 The Vafio Cup Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam is entrusted with transporting a priceless ancient Greek gold cup by train to a buyer in Los Angeles. With an enormous sum at stake, the trip becomes a contest of murder, deception and competing attempts to possess the Vaphio Cup.

title: 480919 The Hot Hundred Grand Caper
plotSynopsis: Lorraine Chilcourse hires Sam to follow her husband Leonard, whom she believes is being blackmailed. Leonard carries one hundred thousand dollars to a casino and loses it, leaving Sam to uncover why the money was taken there and who engineered the costly scheme.

title: 481003 The Sugar Kane Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam becomes involved with the wealthy Cavanaugh family as an impending marriage reopens an old scandal with ties to murder. Family secrets, greed and a suspicious death make the proposed union far more dangerous than it first appears.

title: 481031 The Fairley-Bright Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam is hired to provide security at a Halloween masquerade celebrating an engagement. The party's costumes and confusion provide cover for murder when Wilma is killed, leaving Sam to sort the real identities and motives behind the masks.

title: 481107 The SQP Caper
plotSynopsis: Patricia Pearce asks Sam to help manufacture evidence of adultery for a divorce. He refuses, but the attempted setup soon expands into blackmail, murder and an effort to place Sam himself in a dangerously compromising position.

title: 481128 The Quarter-Eagle Caper
plotSynopsis: The self-styled 'Gumball King' hires Sam to discover who is sabotaging his vending machines. When the businessman is murdered, the investigation shifts from petty vandalism to homicide, with a rare quarter-eagle gold coin providing an important clue.

title: 481212 The Bouncing Betty Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam goes undercover as a chauffeur at a wealthy estate after repeated attempts are made on Kathy McGraw's life. Protecting her means identifying which member of the household has a reason to turn the secluded estate into a murder trap.

title: 490116 The Betrayal in Bumpus Hell Caper
plotSynopsis: A neighbor's request for help pulls Sam into a domestic scandal in Bumpus Hell. What begins with suspicions inside a troubled household develops into a case of adultery, blackmail and murder.

title: 490410 The Stopped Watch Caper
plotSynopsis: Rowena Raven is receiving threatening letters at the gloomy Ravenswood estate, where poisonous plants and an unsettling habit of stopped watches add to the atmosphere. Sam's investigation of the threats leads into a death and a concealed family secret.

title: 490417 The Report On Edith Hamilton
plotSynopsis: A psychoanalyst brings Sam into the case of Mrs. Hamilton, whose trauma centers on the mysterious death of her son and her feelings toward his widow. Sam searches for the truth behind the death while trying to obtain a confession from someone close to the family.

title: 490501 The Battles of Belvedere
plotSynopsis: Sam visits Belvedere Island after eccentric artist Jonathan Battle expresses fear of an old enemy. A seemingly impossible locked-room murder follows, forcing Sam to untangle the relationships and deceptions surrounding Battle and his isolated household.

title: 490710 The Queen Bee Caper
plotSynopsis: Theft at an exclusive girls' school puts suspicion on student Glorie Thomas despite the lack of evidence against her. Sam's effort to clear her becomes a murder investigation when someone is killed with formic acid.

title: 490717 Cuttyhunk
plotSynopsis: Sam investigates the claim of an escaped prisoner convicted of a bludgeoning murder who insists he was framed. The surviving recording contains only the first half of the broadcast, so the available synopsis is limited to the setup of Sam's attempt to test the prisoner's story.

title: 490807 The Champion Caper
plotSynopsis: Wealthy Elliot Champion hires Sam as a bodyguard after receiving threats from former employee Joe Josephs, recently released from prison. Gunfire at Champion's office sends Sam after the shooter, but the case becomes a deeper story of old grudges, revenge and double-crosses.

title: 490828 The Prodical Daughter Caper
plotSynopsis: Multimillionaire Scully hires Sam because of trouble involving his rebellious daughter Helen and her connection to a gangster. The family dispute becomes a homicide case complicated by a corpse whose circumstances suggest the victim was, in effect, killed twice.

title: 490925 Chargogagog
plotSynopsis: Chief Black Cloud hires Sam to find a missing engineer connected with the chief's oil interests. The engineer is soon found dead, and the investigation turns toward a stolen, valuable wampum belt and the people willing to kill for it.

title: 491106 The Cheesecake Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam finds fifty dollars and a photograph of a blonde hidden in his sandwich, along with the instruction to find the woman. The bizarre delivery launches a missing-woman investigation, although surviving copies of this recording have been reported as containing material intermingled from other Sam Spade episodes.

title: 491204 The Flopsey Mopsey Cottontain Caper
plotSynopsis: Unlicensed detective Fritz Crockett tries to turn Sam into his partner, beginning with an unusual assignment at Mrs. Montague's costume party. Their white-rabbit disguises place them in the middle of a comic but dangerous case involving valuable jewels and a planned theft.

title: 500518 The Red Anapola Caper
plotSynopsis: Andrea Rios hires Sam to spend the night with her father so the older man will have an alibi. When Andrea is shot, the arrangement becomes part of a murder investigation involving revenge and a criminal operation connected with narcotics smuggling.

title: 500528 The Honest Thief Caper
plotSynopsis: Louise Miller asks Sam to help after her fiancé, Ben Comiskey, abruptly confesses to an armed robbery and breaks off their relationship. Sam investigates why an apparently decent man would claim responsibility for the crime and uncovers a family conflict involving two very different brothers.

title: 500903 The Farmers Daughter Caper
plotSynopsis: After taking a shortcut on the way back from bailing someone out, Sam becomes stranded near an isolated tourist court and farmhouse. A buried man, gunshots and a mysterious woman pull him into a dangerous rural mystery involving the people who control the property.

title: 501201 The Dog Bed Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam investigates murder and extortion after I. J. Barco is shot three times while pouring a drink. The killing opens a case in which apparently ordinary domestic details conceal the leverage being used against the people involved.

title: 501215 The 251235679 Caper
plotSynopsis: A sick Italian at Mama Pizza's starts Sam on a trail that takes him out onto San Francisco Bay and toward a mysterious postcard meant for Boris. The strange clues develop into a case involving espionage, violence and murder.

title: 501229 The Prodical Panda Caper
plotSynopsis: An eight-year-old boy hires Sam after his toy panda is stolen at gunpoint. What sounds like a child's problem quickly becomes an adult criminal case involving hidden money, poison, murder and a bomb.

title: 510105 The Biddle Riddle Caper
plotSynopsis: A radio producer hires Sam to revisit the three-year-old murder of Carol Stevens. A man named Jimmy Biddle is pursuing the reward, and the investigation eventually turns on recorded evidence capable of exposing the killer.

title: 510119 The Cloak and Dagger Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam becomes entangled in international intrigue involving a scarred man, a veiled woman and two corpses. The case reaches beyond an ordinary private investigation to a secretive political plot involving a visiting prime minister.

title: 510126 The Chateau McCloud Caper
plotSynopsis: What should have been a ski weekend at a wealthy man's winter home turns into another job for Sam when murder strikes on the slopes. The isolated setting and the victim's household leave Sam to work out who converted a holiday into a carefully planned killing.

title: 510209 The Sure Thing Caper
plotSynopsis: Small-time horseplayer Five Dollar Frankie has been cheated by Gentle Joe Higgins, a known horse doper. Sam's investigation of the supposedly unbeatable betting proposition exposes what is really behind the 'sure thing.'

title: 510216 The Soap Opera Caper
plotSynopsis: Soap-opera writer Agatha Pilbean hires Sam to find her missing husband, Dr. Martin Hawkes, after a mysterious telegram arrives from Mexico. The search takes on the melodramatic complications of one of her scripts, including blackmail, bigamy and murder.

title: 510223 The Shot in the Dark Caper
plotSynopsis: A newspaper hires Sam to solve a murder that was accidentally captured in a news photograph but apparently never reported to police. The image gives Sam a frozen piece of evidence from which he must reconstruct the crime.

title: 510302 The Crab Louie Caper
plotSynopsis: Bartholomew asks Sam to find out what happened to his son Louie, an Italian crab fisherman whose boat sank several days earlier. Louie's body was never recovered, and the fact that another man was aboard leads Sam to question whether the disappearance was an accident or murder.

title: 510309 The Spanish Prisoner Caper
plotSynopsis: Marjorie Loveland brings Sam a story that resembles the classic Spanish Prisoner confidence trick: an imprisoned relative, hidden jewels and money needed to secure access to the fortune. Sam's skepticism is justified when the apparent swindle grows into a case involving murder and counterfeiting.

title: 510316 The Sinister Siren Caper
plotSynopsis: A beautiful redhead marks six names in a telephone book, and the people on the list begin dying one by one. Sam tries to identify the link between the victims and the woman before the series of murders can be completed, with a large financial motive behind the killings.

title: 510323 The Kimberley Cross Caper
plotSynopsis: An insurance man hires Sam to guard the Kimberley Cross, a jewel valued at roughly a quarter of a million dollars, for twenty-four hours. The short security assignment becomes a deadly struggle over who intends to take the gem and how far they will go to get it.

title: 510330 The Vendetta Caper
plotSynopsis: Chandler Goston hires Sam to investigate wealthy Monty Cristoff, a man who appears to be systematically destroying Goston's life. The pattern points to an elaborate campaign of revenge in which old grievances are being repaid one by one.

title: 510406 The Denny Shane Caper
plotSynopsis: Sixteen-year-old Sally Joan Michaels hires Sam to locate her brother Denny Shane, a man with a criminal background. The search turns into a murder case after Sam identifies a victim and begins uncovering what Denny has become involved in.

title: 510413 The Civic Pride Caper
plotSynopsis: Architect Garrett Welsh hires Sam after a public auditorium collapses and suspicion falls on the people responsible for the building. When a building inspector is shot four times, the structural scandal becomes a murder investigation involving corruption and civic reputations.

title: 510420 The Rowdy Dowser Caper
plotSynopsis: Sam's banker friend Wendell Wisby asks him to recover fifty-three thousand dollars stolen from the North Takaloma bank. The missing money and a missing cashier lead Sam into a case where the bank's apparent robbery hides a more personal secret.

title: 510427 The Hail and Farewell Caper
plotSynopsis: A dying man tells Sam that condemned prisoner Willie Johnson is innocent and has been framed for murder, naming the real killer only by the strange phrase 'Hail and Farewell.' plotSynopsis: Jimmy Olsen follows a mysterious whistler into the ship's rigging and falls, while Clark Kent continues uncovering suspicious activity aboard the vessel.

title: Last of the Clipper (1941-03-14)
plotSynopsis: Clark Kent uncovers deliberate sabotage aboard a clipper ship and is drawn into a dangerous confrontation as a violent storm closes in.

title: Last of the Clipper (1941-03-17)
plotSynopsis: A violent storm pounds the clipper Clara M while its crew struggles to control a runaway anchor that threatens to tear open the ship's hull.

title: The Royal Purple Scooter (1955-01-23)
plotSynopsis: Pat Abbott is hired to investigate a fatal automobile wreck that the insurance company regards as an accident, but he becomes convinced the victim was murdered.

title: The Rickshaw Red Lipstick (1955-01-30)
plotSynopsis: A crewman aboard a ship carrying food supplies to Europe senses that something is wrong and asks Pat Abbott to investigate, drawing Pat and Jean into trouble surrounding the voyage.

title: The Yellow Chip (1955-02-20)
plotSynopsis: At the government's request, Pat Abbott travels to Las Vegas to recover a secret formula, turning the trip into a search for the people trying to obtain it.

title: The Burnt Copper Powder (1955-02-27)
plotSynopsis: A Hollywood starlet comes to Pat claiming that she committed murder and offers him $100,000 to cover it up, forcing him to determine what actually happened and why she wants the crime concealed.

title: The Blood Red Diamond (1955-03-06)
plotSynopsis: A catcher is murdered just before a major game, and Pat suspects the team's star pitcher holds the key; Jean goes undercover as a single woman to draw information from the flirtatious ballplayer.

title: The Dead White Flame (1955-03-13)
plotSynopsis: After a famous psychiatrist dies in a plane crash under suspicious circumstances, Pat fakes an injury so he can enter a British mental hospital and uncover the reason behind the killing.

title: The Canary Yellow Sack (1955-03-20)
plotSynopsis: A strange dispute over Zachary Taylor memorabilia catches Jean's attention; when a woman is murdered and Jean is kidnapped, Pat has to uncover what connects the seemingly minor transaction to the crimes.

title: The Clue Of The Ivory Thread (1955-03-27)
plotSynopsis: A man asks Pat to help rob a grave and then turns up dead, sending the Abbotts into an investigation in which a woman's dress becomes central to the killing.

title: Lux Radio Theatre 36-06-08 (84) the Thin Man (1936-06-08)
show: The Adventures of the Thin Man
plotSynopsis: Nick and Nora Charles are drawn into the disappearance of inventor Clyde Wynant after his secretary Julia Wolf is murdered. Nick discovers Wynant himself was killed and that lawyer McCaulay kept him 'alive' through forged communications while eliminating accomplices and witnesses, then exposes McCaulay by gathering the suspects and breaking Mimi's false story.

title: Lux Radio Theatre 40-06-17 (268) After the Thin Man (1940-06-17)
show: The Adventures of the Thin Man
sortKey: 0|1940-06-17|00268|lux radio theatre 40-06-17 (268) after the thin man (1940-06-17)

Evidence turns toward Selma and a web of blackmailers, but Nick uncovers a revenge plot by David Graham, who killed Pedro and Robert and tried to make Selma pay for rejecting him.

title: Strange Case of Professor Wainger (AFRS Front Line Theatre) (1943-04-12)
show: The Adventures of the Thin Man
sortKey: 0|1943-04-12|00005|strange case of professor wainger (afrs front line theatre) (1943-04-12)
