plotSynopsis: A gang plots to steal the famous Vandergraphed pink diamond during a society ball, with a woman posing as a French countess and using an unsuspecting Axford to carry the gem out in a vanity case. The Green Hornet follows the thieves to their hideout, breaks up their attempt to divide the loot and leaves the diamond and conspirators for police, while Axford discovers how completely he was used as their courier.

title: The Man Who Came Back (1943-12-11)
plotSynopsis: A Nazi operative named Weber is surgically altered and trained to impersonate American POW Lt. John Moore after a prisoner exchange. Britt catches the deception through the family dog's hostility and mismatched fingerprints, then as the Green Hornet follows the impostor to psychiatrist Dr. Gerber, obtains evidence of their sabotage and espionage work, and leaves both agents for police and the FBI.

title: Story of a Parrot (1943-12-18)
plotSynopsis: Marine Roy Conway brings home a clever parrot just before his father Samuel is murdered and a secret war report disappears from the house. Remembering the bird's habit of stealing and hiding objects, Britt realizes the report may never have left at all; the Hornet finds it hidden in the room, catches enemy agents searching for it, and leaves police the report and the murder weapon that ties the spies to Conway's death.

title: Obvious Clue (1944-01-01)
plotSynopsis: A black-market liquor organization pressures honest dealers while presenting civic leader Johnson as a respectable spokesman for independent merchants. Britt notices that Johnson knows details of a killing before the Sentinel could have published them; the Green Hornet follows that obvious clue to the gang's hideout, where Johnson is exposed as the racket's leader and left with his men for police.

title: The Way of a Woman (1944-01-08)
plotSynopsis: After rescuing a woman from an apartment fire, Britt becomes suspicious of the handkerchief she was desperate to save. Its knotted border conceals a Braille-like message leading to an ultraviolet-revealed map of coastal defenses, and the Green Hornet traces the clue to a Nazi spy cell, recovers the secret material and leaves the agents for police.

title: Lowrey's Big Moment (1944-01-15)
plotSynopsis: Reporter Ed Lowry thinks he has found the love of his life in Estelle Ritter, unaware that she is working with the gang behind a bank robbery. When Lowry grows suspicious and is taken prisoner, the Hornet follows red brick dust from Estelle's clothing to a deserted brickyard, breaks up the gang, recovers the stolen money and rescues the embarrassed reporter.

title: Pressure from Without (1944-01-29)
plotSynopsis: Lobbyist Jack Lunt and his allies cannot buy Senator Robert Bruce's vote against a contract-renegotiation bill, so they bribe Bruce's secretary to secretly deposit $15,000 in the senator's bank account and make him look corrupt. The Hornet traces the planted deposit to the conspirators and leaves police the deposit slip and signed proof that Bruce knew nothing about it, clearing the senator and wrecking the pressure campaign.

title: Bent Paper Matches (1944-02-05)
plotSynopsis: Lenore Case is hit by a car and befriended by its charming driver, only to discover he and his blonde companion are enemy agents who used her to collect a book containing chemically concealed plans. Bent paper matches link the pair to a murder, and after Lenore is captured and tears up the plans, the Green Hornet raids the hideout, rescues her and leaves the spies and evidence for police.

title: A Light in the Dark (1944-02-12)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet confronts a Nazi espionage scheme in which a scientist’s blind assistant is coerced into stealing vital secrets after a secret operation restores his sight.

title: Short Circuit (1944-02-19)
plotSynopsis: A civilian official's plane crashes just after takeoff, and the Green Hornet suspects sabotage when the accident coincides with a mysterious man in an officer's uniform. The method is a fine wire rigged to create a short circuit when the landing gear retracts. The Hornet catches the saboteur trying the same trick on a second diplomatic flight and leads police to both him and his Nazi handler.

title: Murder Will Out (1944-02-26)
plotSynopsis: Retired diplomat Gregory Stewart is murdered after bitter quarrels with his son Donald and Donald's fiancee Hazel make the young couple obvious suspects. Britt discovers Stewart had been recording his recollections of German atrocities, and a recording reveals that his secretary Gordon, a planted Nazi agent, killed him to stop those disclosures; the Hornet catches Gordon and clears Donald and Hazel.

title: A Case of Honor (1944-03-04)
plotSynopsis: When a small-time robber begins using a homemade Green Hornet mask for payroll holdups and murder, Britt decides the impostor has made the case personal. The real Hornet feeds police a tip about the crook's next job, overcomes him at the scene and leaves the fake mask, stolen money and evidence behind so the killer can be identified without confusing him with the real Hornet.

title: Fog in the Night (1944-03-11)
plotSynopsis: A series of supposedly accidental truck wrecks threatens deliveries of vital war materials on a dangerous mountain road. The Green Hornet discovers that Nazi saboteurs are releasing an artificial chemical fog at a hairpin turn, traces the residue to their equipment and leaves police the saboteurs and the fog-making device that caused the fatal crashes.

title: The State Versus Chester Canby (1944-03-18)
plotSynopsis: Chester Canby seems doomed for the murder of a respected physician after police find him alone with the body and the gun in his hand. Britt suspects the evidence is too neat, and the Green Hornet uncovers the doctor's hidden connection to a dope-peddling ring; a confession and records implicate Fingers, Chick Collins and even Canby's defense lawyer in the murder and frame-up, clearing Canby before conviction.

title: The Man Who Fooled the World (1944-03-25)
plotSynopsis: Wealthy international operator Albert Patton uses his respectable neutral-country standing as cover for espionage, with secret plans concealed inside medicine capsules. The Green Hornet uncovers the capsule system, breaks up the meeting around Patton and leaves the incriminating plans in Patton's possession for federal investigators to find.

title: Intrigue on the Waterfront (1944-04-08)
plotSynopsis: Disgraced naval officer Barry Linden appears to have turned against his country after a court-martial, but his betrayal is actually an undercover assignment to draw out a Nazi waterfront network. When the agents use him to guide a submarine through a minefield and land saboteurs, the Green Hornet intervenes, knocks out the landing party and forces the submarine ashore, after which Naval Intelligence reveals Linden's true role.

title: Death Wears a Mask (1944-04-11)
plotSynopsis: Banker Anton Wieckoff is murdered, and suspicion falls on several people around him while the real motive remains hidden. The Hornet breaks into Wieckoff's banking office and finds documents showing a $200,000 business-insurance policy benefiting associate Kendall; that financial motive and Kendall's actions expose him as Wieckoff's killer and would-be thief.

title: Lady of Intrigue (1944-04-18)
plotSynopsis: Celebrated actress Varnic Claire uses her patriotic camp appearances to gather military information for a Nazi spy organization. When Axford disappears while trying to interview her, Britt searches her apartment as the Green Hornet, uncovers the espionage operation and helps leave Claire and her associates with papers and other evidence that expose the spy ring to police.

title: The Orphan from St Armand (1944-04-25)
plotSynopsis: Young Pierre loses his parents after they defy the Gestapo in occupied France and later reaches America, where the Phelps family takes him in. When he learns enemy agents are threatening his new home, Pierre runs away to protect the Phelpses; the Hornet follows him to the spies' hideout, subdues them and leaves evidence that exposes their identities.

title: Paroled for Revenge (aka-Bret Reed a Target) (1944-05-16)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet stages his own kidnapping to draw a revenge-driven gangster into the open and force a final confrontation.

title: One for the Books (1944-05-23)
plotSynopsis: When a British diplomat vanishes and a German spy assumes his identity, the Green Hornet works to uncover the impersonation and the espionage plot behind it.

title: Racketeers in Gas Coupons (1944-05-30)
plotSynopsis: Counterfeit gasoline ration coupons lead the Green Hornet from street-level racketeers back to the very ration board that issued them.

title: Code for Sabotage (1944-06-06)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet races to stop foreign agents who kidnap Lowery as part of a plan to blow up a troop train.

title: Circumstances Alter Cases (1944-06-13)
plotSynopsis: A district attorney’s case against gangster Chuck Louis is compromised when the Green Hornet discovers the prosecutor’s own son is financially beholden to the criminal.

title: Dope Versus the War Effort (1944-06-20)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet targets dealers distributing marijuana to workers at a plant essential to the wartime effort.

title: Birds of a Feather (1944-06-27)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet uncovers a scheme that places ex-convicts inside an aircraft factory so criminals can sabotage the plant and steal a new plane.

title: The Make-Believe Sheriff (1944-07-04)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet moves to stop Slick Maynard and his gang from stealing the famous Blue India Diamond.

title: Madhouse Adventure (1944-07-11)
plotSynopsis: A supposed survivor of a German U-boat attack turns out to be a Nazi agent, drawing the Green Hornet into an espionage case that lands Axford inside an asylum.

title: Fireworks for Smitty (1944-07-18)
plotSynopsis: A cab driver’s observation supplies the Green Hornet with the clue he needs to close in on two Nazi spies.

title: The Road to Riches (1944-07-25)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet exposes a real-estate operator who stages accidents to frighten farmers into selling their land at bargain prices.

title: Gentleman Jerry Meets His Match (1944-08-01)
plotSynopsis: Recently released gangster Gentleman Jerry sets out to punish both the partner who betrayed him and the Green Hornet, forcing the masked crimefighter into the middle of his revenge scheme.

title: Mystery in the Dentist's Office (1944-08-08)
plotSynopsis: A fatal fire in a dentist's office raises doubts about whether Dr. Kane truly died, and the Green Hornet investigates the deception behind the supposed death.

title: The Female of the Species (1944-08-15)
plotSynopsis: A seductive operative is sent to extract military information from Captain Radnor before he leaves for France, drawing the Green Hornet into the espionage plot.

title: Flames of Wrath (1944-08-29)
plotSynopsis: A string of warehouse fires leads the Green Hornet to an arson racket tied to a wider wartime scheme involving weapons intended for enemy forces.

title: Ramona (1944-09-05)
plotSynopsis: A woman named Ramona uses charm and deception in an attempt to steal secret documents, prompting the Green Hornet to move against the espionage operation.

title: Payment in Full (1944-09-12)
plotSynopsis: Actress Jeanette Jeffers is being blackmailed by Grafton when she is murdered after a public quarrel makes another man appear responsible. Ed Lowry uncovers the shakedown, and the Hornet follows Grafton to a hideout where he is preparing to kill his accomplice Lucy; Britt subdues him and leaves both the murderer and a living witness for the police.

title: Murder in the Rain (1944-09-19)
plotSynopsis: A Nazi operative murders radioman Joe Lin so he can assume Lin's identity aboard the Chesapeake and make contact with a German submarine. The Green Hornet uncovers the impersonation aboard ship, captures the killer after a waterfront pursuit and uses him to lead police to the spy cell supporting the mission.

title: Story of a Dog (1944-09-26)
plotSynopsis: A heroic dog that once saved soldiers in battle becomes vital again when it helps identify a Nazi agent hiding among prisoners, aiding the Green Hornet's wartime investigation.

title: Murder Masquerade (1944-10-03)
plotSynopsis: A condemned killer escapes execution by exchanging clothes with the clergyman sent to comfort him, leaving the Green Hornet to track the fugitive created by the deadly masquerade.

title: Prelude to a Blood Bath (1944-10-10)
plotSynopsis: Two Nazi agents try to obtain a list of underground members, while the Green Hornet and a federal agent work with a blind ally to keep the names from enemy hands.

title: The Woman in the Picture (1944-10-17)
plotSynopsis: A glamorous stranger named Elsa Dorne engineers a meeting with Phil Kingsley and steals a private letter from his coat, feeding it into a blackmail operation. When John Kingsley pays to recover the letter, the gang tries to dispose of him, but the Green Hornet pursues their car, rescues Kingsley and recovers both the blackmail money and the letter. The kidnappers are left for police while the compromising letter is destroyed.

title: Halloween Adventure (1944-10-24)
plotSynopsis: Two crooks steal the Effingham father and son's costumes so they can impersonate them at the family's Halloween ball, including one dressed as the Green Hornet, and rob the guests. Britt Reid changes from his own costume into the real Hornet disguise when the holdup begins and helps stop the impostors until police arrive, while the real Effinghams are found tied up but unharmed.

title: Blackmail for Murder (1944-10-31)
plotSynopsis: Racketeer Chick Hanley stages a fake killing to blackmail drunken young Lewis Melville: henchman Rusty provokes a fight, pretends to die from Melville's blow, and Hanley offers to hide the 'murder' for a price. The Hornet disrupts the payoff, Rusty admits he was never dead, and police recover the blackmail evidence from Hanley, clearing Melville and arresting the gang.

title: A Lady in Distress (1944-11-07)
plotSynopsis: A gang forges and steals government allotment checks intended for servicemen's families, using mailboxes and false endorsements to cash them. Axford catches a thief at a mailbox and the trail leads to the gang; the Hornet breaks up the operation and leaves the check thieves unconscious with the evidence for police.

title: There's Many a Slip (1944-11-14)
plotSynopsis: Racketeer Joe Kane has witnesses killed to protect himself, but the widow of one victim tells Britt that her husband carried a dying man's note naming Kane as a murderer. The Green Hornet searches Kane's operation, survives a trap meant to kill him, recovers the incriminating note and turns Kane's attempt to identify the Hornet through a fingerprinted seal back on Kane himself, leaving police the evidence and the kidnapped widow's location.

title: Scrapper (1944-11-21)
plotSynopsis: Fourteen-year-old Scrapper McGuire keeps fighting classmates who taunt him about his ex-convict father, Lefty, who insists he was framed years earlier. The same crooks lure Scrapper to the warehouse where Lefty works so they can steal trucks and frame him again, but the Hornet breaks up the robbery and stages the capture so Lefty receives the credit, restoring Scrapper's faith and giving the boy a fresh start at school and the Sentinel.

title: The Train-Wreck (1944-11-28)
plotSynopsis: A train wreck lets convicted murderer Joe Hanley escape and steal the identity and uniform of wounded soldier Don Curry, whose burned hands and lost memory prevent immediate identification. Hanley plans to settle an old score before fleeing, but Britt follows the identity switch, the Hornet traps him, and Hanley's confession clears the injured soldier and reunites Don with his fiancee Betty.

title: Haunts of the Hunted (1944-12-05)
plotSynopsis: Miss Case's search for a rental house leads to a supposedly haunted suburban property where hidden noises and frightening effects have scared away tenants. Britt investigates as the Green Hornet and discovers secret panels, trap doors, a concealed cellar room and recorded sounds used to protect a spy hideout; police capture the occupants after the Hornet exposes the house's real secret.

title: Purely for Pleasure (1944-12-12)
plotSynopsis: Preston Parker's death is first treated as suicide until evidence points to murder and a woman known as Doll Baby claims special knowledge of the Green Hornet. Britt learns Parker had secretly spent his own money infiltrating a spy-and-sabotage ring; the Hornet follows Doll Baby to her confederates, exposes the gang, and leaves a note clearing Parker's name as a patriot who died trying to break it.

title: Heroes Are Born (1944-12-19)
plotSynopsis: Returned war hero Don Hartwell does not know that his father Joe Milton is alive, an ex-convict being pressured by Big Mike to take part in another crime. When Big Mike learns Joe's connection to Don and tries to use it against him, the Green Hornet turns the confrontation against the gang; Joe helps leave the crooks for police and is reunited with Don and the family that has been waiting for him.

title: The Great Detective (1944-12-26)
plotSynopsis: Famous detective Oliver Perry comes to town determined to collect the reward for capturing the Green Hornet and, through careful deduction, narrows his suspicion to Britt Reid. Britt and Kato stage an encounter in which Kato appears as the Hornet while Britt is visibly attacked, then leave a Hornet message in Perry's hotel room, convincing the detective that his theory was wrong and sending him back west.

title: A Bit of Doodling (1945-01-02)
plotSynopsis: A murder aboard a train leaves little evidence beyond a timetable marked with an odd bit of doodling. Britt later notices Professor Breslau make the same mark, leading the Green Hornet to a Nazi espionage ring developing plans for submarine-launched robot attacks; a counterspy has already infiltrated the group under the dead agent's identity, and the Hornet's intervention helps bring the spy cell down.

title: What a Life (1945-01-09)
plotSynopsis: Scientist Carl Ritman, a naturalized American whose parents were held in Germany, had been forced into German service during the war but secretly remained loyal to the United States. After Ritman is murdered and Army nurse Olivia Hollis is abducted because she knows his story, Britt deduces that Professor Lowell is the trusted killer Ritman would have admitted at close range; the Green Hornet rescues Hollis and leaves Lowell and his accomplices for the authorities.

title: Axford Cracks a Case (1945-01-16)
plotSynopsis: Axford notices that supposedly harmless pinball games are paying youngsters with tickets redeemable for cash and uncovers a larger gambling racket. When a small-time operator refuses to name the men above him, Britt lets the Sentinel print a headline claiming the man has already confessed; seeing armed-looking men waiting across the street, the frightened operator assumes his bosses believe the story and immediately gives Axford the real confession.

title: Alias Sandra Day (1945-01-23)
plotSynopsis: A woman calling herself Sandra Day approaches Britt with supposed blackmail information, but she knows details never released outside the investigation. Britt proves she is actually the former wife of imprisoned gangster Calera and has been blackmailing him and his cellmate for hidden holdup money, arranging several murders when they refuse to pay; the Hornet leaves evidence that sets her gang against itself and gives police the break they need.

title: Where There's a Will (1945-02-08)
plotSynopsis: When a safecracker using a fake Green Hornet seal steals only the accounting papers from Viola Vernon's inheritance, Britt suspects the robbery was meant to hide something in her father's will. He learns the estate should contain far more stock than the executors reported, and the Hornet plays the three trustees against one another until broker John Severe believes his partners have framed him and agrees to confess the theft of Viola's inheritance.

title: The Bigger They Are (1945-02-22)
plotSynopsis: Complaints about a dangerously shoddy war-workers housing project lead to a grand-jury probe, but building inspector Cutler is murdered before he can testify. The Green Hornet uncovers that contractor Danvers and Commissioner Harris forged Cutler's report to hide the graft, follows Harris to Danvers, rescues Mrs. Cutler and leaves the conspirators with the genuine evidence for police.

title: Scrapper Mc Guire's Hero (1945-03-15)
plotSynopsis: Curly Lambert appears to be a convicted thief when young Scrapper McGuire insists that the man once saved his life. Britt's investigation reveals that Lambert is actually a federal agent who entered prison undercover to penetrate a ring stealing and sabotaging war materials; the Hornet helps bring the warehouse operation and its leaders into the open without destroying Lambert's cover until the arrests are secure.

title: The Lost Key (1945-03-22)
plotSynopsis: A key found near a war-plant explosion leads Axford to a station locker and a cache connected with incendiary pencils and an enemy spy ring. Axford is captured after following the trail to a hidden room beneath a merchant's store, but the Green Hornet intervenes and leaves the spies, their equipment and the evidence for police while Axford takes much of the public credit.

title: Michael Axford - Movie Star (1945-03-29)
plotSynopsis: Axford is accidentally cast in a motion picture about escaped killer Smoothie Gorman, then notices the leading actor react exactly as Gorman would to a shotgun blast near his left side. Britt realizes plastic surgery has allowed Gorman to hide in the film under the name Douglas Gray and plans a real bank robbery during a staged robbery scene; the Hornet joins the getaway long enough to lead Gorman and his men into a warehouse police trap.

title: The Double Cross (1945-04-05)
plotSynopsis: After Joseph Landers is murdered before he can testify against two racketeers, the Green Hornet investigates the killing and the criminals who silenced a crucial witness.

title: Picture in the Dark (1945-04-19)
plotSynopsis: A racketeer secretly photographs Britt Reid without the Green Hornet's mask, creating dangerous evidence that could expose his identity and forcing Reid to recover the incriminating image.

title: San Francisco Adventure (1945-04-26)
plotSynopsis: Britt Reid travels to San Francisco to cover the emerging United Nations conference, where an old adversary again tries to prove that Reid is secretly the Green Hornet.

title: An Armastice from Death (1945-05-10)
plotSynopsis: In the aftermath of Germany's surrender, enemy agents continue their campaign by kidnapping Kato and plotting to unleash a deadly virus during American victory celebrations.

title: Biography Incorporated (1945-05-17)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet targets a racket selling fraudulent commemorative books to the families of war veterans, a scheme that even steals printing supplies from the Daily Sentinel.

title: Black Market for Profit (1945-05-31)
plotSynopsis: After a radio commentator is murdered, the Green Hornet moves against a black-market meat racket whose leader also threatens a publisher who refuses to cooperate.

title: Broken Cigarette Stubs (1945-06-07)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet pursues saboteurs attacking munitions and troop trains, using the clues left behind to uncover the wartime plot.

title: Not So Smart (1945-06-10)
plotSynopsis: A boastful con man attempts to frame the Green Hornet for murder while a spy gang prepares to flee by airplane, forcing the Hornet to unravel both schemes.

title: Appointments with Death (1945-06-21)
plotSynopsis: After a wealthy man takes his life under blackmail pressure, the Green Hornet traces the extortion to a scandal-sheet operator whose criminal activities also include murder.

title: The Hornet Keeps a Date (1945-06-21)
plotSynopsis: Police use Helen Duncan as bait in an effort to trap the Green Hornet, while the Hornet employs a tracking device to pursue a black-market gang.

title: Ladder of Fate (1945-07-05)
plotSynopsis: Britt Reid discovers that a newly elected district attorney owes his victory to criminal support, and the Green Hornet moves to expose the corruption behind the election.

title: Credit for Murder (1945-07-12)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet suspects Edgar Dayton of jewel smuggling, but Dayton is shot before the case can be broken, turning the investigation into a murder mystery.

title: The Fall Guy (1945-07-19)
plotSynopsis: A councilman involved with mobsters becomes the prime suspect when a political opponent is shot during a dispute over a proposed highway, leaving the Green Hornet to expose the setup.

title: The Numbers Racket (1945-07-26)
plotSynopsis: A murder tied to an illegal numbers operation triggers a newspaper crusade, and the gang retaliates by kidnapping Britt Reid, drawing the Green Hornet directly into the racket.

title: The Return of Oliver Perry (1945-08-02)
plotSynopsis: Oliver Perry asks Britt Reid to enlist the Green Hornet's help in recovering a stolen jewel, even as Perry continues to suspect that Reid and the masked vigilante are the same man.

title: The Imposter (1945-08-16)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet is blamed for a truck hijacking and jewelry-store robbery, forcing him to uncover the criminal impersonator using his reputation as cover.

title: Unexpected Meeting (1945-08-23)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet becomes entangled in an espionage case involving stolen government papers and a detective whose role in the affair is unclear.

title: Johnny Comes Home (1945-08-30)
plotSynopsis: A gangster learns that the son he believed dead has returned from war as a decorated hero and tries to leave crime behind, turning to the Green Hornet for help escaping his old associates.

title: Too Many Suspects (1945-09-06)
plotSynopsis: When a wealthy woman with many enemies is murdered, the Green Hornet faces a crowded field of plausible suspects while trying to identify the real killer.

title: The Black Feather (1945-09-13)
plotSynopsis: A doctor who continues speaking out against the Nazis receives a threatening black feather and is shot soon afterward, leading the Green Hornet to investigate the underground agents behind the warning.

title: Evidence on Hand (1945-09-20)
plotSynopsis: Blackie Doyle tries to neutralize the district attorney's case against him by putting pressure on the prosecutor's son and pushing the district attorney toward resignation. The Green Hornet intervenes at Doyle's place, saves the young man and leaves police the evidence they need against Doyle, convincing the prosecutor to remain in office.

title: The Stuffed Panda (aka-Treasury Fraud) (1945-10-04)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet uses a child’s stuffed toy as the key to exposing a businessman’s hidden profits and tax-evasion scheme.

title: Hot Money and Death (1945-10-11)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet lays a trap for a crime boss while trying to recover a large cache of money stolen from a bank.

title: Murder and the Dope Racket (1945-10-18)
plotSynopsis: After a doctor is murdered, Britt Reid’s investigation as the Green Hornet leads into a dangerous narcotics operation.

title: What Price Glamour (1945-10-25)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet uncovers an effort to silence a victim of fraudulent beauty products while criminals work to block legislation that could expose the scheme.

title: Ballots and Bluff (1945-11-01)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet intervenes in a crooked election, exposing political deception and clearing an honest man who has been falsely blamed.

title: The Hornet Drops a Hint (aka-Smoothy Lawrence) (1945-11-08)
plotSynopsis: Framed for murder, the Green Hornet must clear himself while navigating an espionage plot with international consequences.

title: Katz with Nine Lives (1945-11-15)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet investigates an extortion scheme built around staged hit-and-run incidents targeting one of Britt Reid’s former fraternity brothers.

title: Superhighway Robbery (1945-11-22)
plotSynopsis: When a newly built superhighway fails, the Green Hornet follows the evidence into a network of graft that a city official is trying to conceal.

title: Protection Incorporated (1945-11-29)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet moves against a protection racket terrorizing fruit-market merchants and its violent leader, Dynamite Fletcher.

title: The Voice (1945-12-06)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet investigates the bombing death of a newly elected district attorney and the mysterious method used to deliver the explosive.

title: Paid in Full (1945-12-13)
plotSynopsis: A suspicious killing and a series of automobile repossessions lead the Green Hornet to a corrupt loan company.

title: When Money Talks (1945-12-20)
plotSynopsis: The sudden prosperity of several supposedly needy families prompts the Green Hornet to uncover a criminal arrangement run by a known racketeer.

title: The Boathouse Mystery (1945-12-25)
plotSynopsis: Framed for the killing of a man connected to stolen atomic-bomb plans, the Green Hornet must identify the real murderer and clear his name.

title: Turban of Jarpur (1946-01-01)
plotSynopsis: A fraudulent fortune teller posing as an exotic prince charms prominent women into revealing private information, then uses their secrets for extortion until the Green Hornet intervenes.

title: George Haven's Secret (1946-01-22)
plotSynopsis: A corrupt city official who knows the Green Hornet’s true identity tries to frame him for murder, forcing Britt Reid to turn the situation back on his enemy.

title: Escape for Revenge (1946-01-29)
plotSynopsis: An escaped convict launches a revenge campaign and blames his crimes on the Green Hornet, leading to a confrontation with the real masked vigilante.

title: Washington Story (1946-02-05)
plotSynopsis: A reporter investigating a munitions scandal is murdered, but the killing is mysteriously reported before it happens, giving the Green Hornet a crucial clue to the conspiracy.

title: Woman in the Case (1946-02-12)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet investigates a grocery-store protection racket fronted by a woman whose respectable appearance helps conceal the criminal operation.

title: A Soldier and His Dog (1946-02-16)
plotSynopsis: A soldier’s loyal dog becomes crucial to exposing an impostor who is attempting to steal an inheritance.

title: The Last of Oliver Perry (1946-02-23)
plotSynopsis: Oliver Perry makes another attempt to prove Britt Reed is the Green Hornet, using blackmail material, a false identity and a homemade Hornet disguise to build a trap around him. Britt and Commissioner Callaway turn the scheme back on Perry, exposing his fake mask and gas gun and tying his story to the blackmail operation, leaving Perry discredited instead of unmasking the real Hornet.

title: A Question of Time (1946-03-02)
plotSynopsis: While investigating a scientist’s murdered assistant and a missing formula, the Green Hornet is framed for the killing and must prove the setup.

title: The Letter (aka-Clearing the Mayor of Graft) (1946-03-09)
plotSynopsis: A mayor accused of graft appears to be condemned by a damaging letter, but the Green Hornet uncovers a forged document and a murder behind the frame-up.

title: A Pair of Nylons (1946-03-16)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet investigates an illegal nylon-stocking racket after reporter Mike Axford disappears while pursuing the same story.

title: Youth Takes the Headlines (1946-03-23)
plotSynopsis: A teenager drawn into a criminal gang turns to the Green Hornet for help when he decides he wants out.

title: Classified Ads (1946-03-30)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet uses the criminals’ own plan against them to expose a fraudulent engagement-ring racket and the politician protecting it.

title: The Gas Pen (1946-04-06)
plotSynopsis: A former Nazi recruits two thieves to steal important papers from a train while disguised as the Green Hornet, forcing the real Hornet to expose both the theft and the impersonation.

title: Figure in the Photograph (1946-04-13)
plotSynopsis: After an arson fire at a clothing store kills the fire chief, the Green Hornet reopens the case when a photograph contains a figure that may identify the person behind the blaze.

title: Grand Larceny on Wheels (1946-04-20)
plotSynopsis: A body found in a submerged car and the return of Oliver Perry, this time disguised as the Green Hornet, draw Britt Reid into a case involving murder and impersonation.

title: Murder for Sale (1946-05-04)
plotSynopsis: A crooked automobile-sales operation preying on veterans escalates to murder, and the Green Hornet maneuvers around both the criminals and police to expose it.

title: Check and Double Check (1946-05-11)
plotSynopsis: Two forged payroll checks lead Britt Reid to a sophisticated check-fraud ring whose operation soon involves murder and a double-cross.

title: Dr Moylan's Patient (1946-05-18)
plotSynopsis: A young doctor is forced to treat a wounded robber, and the Green Hornet steps in to protect the physician and expose the criminals controlling him.

title: Polarized Glasses (1946-05-25)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet uncovers an espionage ring that uses polarized-light signals and a false aristocratic identity to collect information at society gatherings.

title: Accidents Will Happen (aka City Transportation, Bus Accidents) (1946-06-01)
sortKey: 0|1946-06-01|00758|accidents will happen (aka city transportation, bus accidents) (1946-06-01)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet takes on a gang deliberately engineering accidents in an effort to wreck the city's bus system.

title: The Hornet Does It (1946-06-08)
plotSynopsis: A gang masquerading as police officers hijacks equipment shipments, prompting the Green Hornet to expose the impostors and their theft operation.

title: Revenge for Melakim (1946-06-15)
plotSynopsis: A missing mummy and a trail of black cats lead the Green Hornet into an unusual criminal mystery involving the supposed revenge of Melakim.

title: A Man of Many Words (1946-06-29)
plotSynopsis: After a radio commentator is killed, Britt Reid confronts the organizer of a dangerous black-market meat operation.

title: Death in the Dark (1946-08-31)
plotSynopsis: The apparent suicide of a city-council candidate raises questions that bring the Green Hornet into the investigation of the politician's death.

title: Underwater Adventure (1946-09-14)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet stages an elaborate deception to trap a notorious bank robber who has returned to recover loot hidden beneath the bay.

title: The Wrapped Book (1946-10-05)
plotSynopsis: When a state senator receives a bribe consisting of cash in a wrapped package delivered by Britt Reid himself, the Green Hornet works to uncover who engineered the incriminating setup.

title: The Big Mr Corry (1946-10-13)
plotSynopsis: After the unseen Mr. Big tries to silence the Daily Sentinel, Britt Reid publicly leaves town while secretly continuing the Green Hornet's campaign against the Big Four protection racket. When Big Four enforcers terrorize a neighborhood druggist and a witness becomes a target, the Hornet turns the gang's pressure tactics against it, protects the witness long enough for the case to proceed, and leaves police the location of the Big Four meeting place so the organization can be raided.

title: The Prodigal Brother (1946-10-27)
plotSynopsis: A senator's long-missing brother-in-law returns from a troubled past only to become the target of blackmail, drawing the Green Hornet into the effort to free him from the scheme.

title: The Quiz Program Clue (1946-11-10)
plotSynopsis: After a truck carrying new automobiles is hijacked and its driver killed, a clue from a radio quiz program gives Britt Reid the idea he needs to break the case.

title: Guiseppe's Secret (1946-11-24)
plotSynopsis: Restaurant owner Giuseppe learns that gambler Doranda plans to have star football player Glenn White killed after using the game for a betting scheme. Giuseppe reveals to Britt that Glenn is actually the son he gave up as an infant, then risks his own life to protect him; the Green Hornet helps break Doranda's plot while preserving Giuseppe's secret relationship to the young athlete.

title: Death Comes to Dinner (1947-01-05)
plotSynopsis: Financier Finley gathers four prominent men in his locked penthouse and is stabbed with a table knife during a brief blackout. Britt Reid finds Warren's bloodstained monogrammed handkerchief and helps police stage a fingerprint bluff that makes Warren reveal knowledge only the murderer should possess, exposing him when he turns violent.

title: The Woman and Oliver Perry (1947-01-12)
plotSynopsis: Oliver Perry returns with a woman named Carol and sends a note claiming to know the Green Hornet's identity, ordering him to a merchandise warehouse where Perry has arranged for federal agents to make the arrest. Britt anticipates the trap and works with police on a counterplan that leaves both Britt and an apparent Hornet in play at the same time; Perry's accusation collapses because no one can prove Britt is the masked man, and he is driven out of town again.

title: The Rodin Statue (1947-01-19)
plotSynopsis: A valuable Rodin statue is due to be returned to France when collector Ralph Barry is murdered and his body is substituted into the packing case used for the artwork. Britt traces the missing statue to Barry's mausoleum, where rival thieves and a federal agent converge; the Hornet intervenes, the statue is recovered from the coffin, and the murder suspects are left for police.

title: A Shot in the Arm (1947-02-09)
plotSynopsis: A shipment of diamonds at Robbins and Brown is secretly replaced with cheap zircons and a Green Hornet seal is planted to frame the masked crime fighter. When Brown is murdered after learning too much, Britt sets a trap with anonymous notes; police arrive in time to hear Robbins trying to kill clerk Carl Johnson and confess enough of the robbery to expose him as the thief and murderer.

title: The State's Witness (1947-02-16)
plotSynopsis: A murder prosecution against a crooked stockbroker begins to collapse when the defense reveals that the key witness is legally unable to testify, forcing the Green Hornet to find another way to expose the truth.

title: The Findley Case (1947-03-02)
plotSynopsis: When wealthy widow Mrs. Warren Findley is shot in her study, secretary Charles Darwin appears protected by an airtight movie-theater alibi. Britt notices the alibi depends on Darwin merely preserving his seat and slipping away; the Green Hornet confronts him for the hidden payoff and murder weapon, while Lenore Case supplies the observation that proves he left the theater, collapsing the alibi and tying him to the killing.

title: The Big Deal (1947-03-11)
plotSynopsis: Public Buildings Commissioner Duncan secretly gives contractor Butler inside information so Butler can submit the lowest bids on city jobs in return for regular payoffs. When Senator Banning begins an investigation, the conspirators try to compromise him with a supposed campaign contribution; the Green Hornet gets the altered bids and payoff evidence into Banning's hands, allowing the senator to reopen the inquiry and expose Duncan and Butler.

title: Chickens Come Home to Roost (1947-03-18)
plotSynopsis: After financier James Hartford kills himself following a ruinous double-cross by former associates, his nephew Charles becomes the murderer known as the Claw, killing Cornwall and marking Murray and Britt Reid as future victims. The Green Hornet recognizes the claw-on-a-roost symbol and the three-o'clock pattern, prevents Charles from killing Murray and leaves him for police to arrest.

title: Rent in Advance (1947-03-25)
plotSynopsis: A pair of swindlers advertise furnished apartments they do not own, collect rent and large deposits in advance, then vanish, repeatedly cheating veterans and other tenants. Axford poses as a renter and is captured when the gang spots the trap, but the Hornet turns one of their associates and leads police to the waterfront hideout, where the racketeers are rounded up and their victims can identify them.

title: Political Strings (1947-04-01)
plotSynopsis: Political boss Jonathan Ward suddenly backs honest reform candidate Franklin Norwell, then after Norwell wins tries to control the new mayor by secretly imprisoning Norwell's father in Beasley's sanitarium. The Green Hornet learns the leverage through a staged phone call, traces the elder Norwell to the private jail and brings police down on Beasley and Ward's machine, freeing the mayor to govern without the political strings.

title: Stolen Identity (1947-04-08)
plotSynopsis: After a robber steals Andrew Blake's wallet and identity, Britt's investigation also uncovers Blake's own corrupt effort to profit from a city traffic-light contract. The Green Hornet intercepts Blake's payoff to Councilman Wiggins and arranges for police and reporters to find the councilman with the cash and Blake's signed check, exposing the bribery scheme despite the confusion created by the stolen identity.

title: Last of the Top Hat Gang (1947-04-15)
plotSynopsis: After Britt is shot and former Top Hat Gang witness Romel Azure is murdered, he deliberately lets suspicion fall on the Green Hornet so the real killer will keep moving instead of hiding. The trail leads to James Dunham, the last active member of the old gang; the Hornet secures Dunham's gloves and leaves police a forensic clue linking their powder traces to Azure, proving Dunham killed her as part of the gang's vendetta.

title: Cut Rate Crime (1947-05-06)
plotSynopsis: Paul Norton's cut-rate chain recruits large numbers of veterans with promises of management jobs, works most of them brutally for low pay and discards them, while Norton and Sanders also profit from crooked city supply contracts. When former trainee Joe Bennett starts exposing the system, the Green Hornet protects him, forces Norton and Sanders to reveal their connection to school-board fixer Potter and delivers Sanders's payoff notebook to police, collapsing the entire racket.

title: Camera Obscure (1947-05-13)
plotSynopsis: Nightclub owner Rex Tinsley repeatedly escapes police pressure with help from lawyer Phil Crane and a political connection. Using Clicker Benny's camera as the Green Hornet, Britt photographs Tinsley, Crane and their ally dividing money with gangsters and obtains a signed financial record; the Sentinel publishes the evidence, the district attorney moves in and Crane begins talking.

title: Merger Not Preferred (1947-05-20)
plotSynopsis: After city official Henry Marsden dies before he can expose a kickback scheme, Britt's suspicions turn toward businessman John Rollins and a pending merger with the Wendell Corporation. Rollins fakes his own kidnapping and uses the Green Hornet's seal to avoid the decisive vote, but the Hornet sees through the scheme, confronts Rollins at home and turns the bogus ransom plot against him until the merger goes through.

title: Cornered Steel (1947-06-03)
plotSynopsis: A postwar steel shortage is being worsened by Barnaby's black-market operation, and investigator Jennings is murdered after getting too close to the racket. Britt keeps an incriminating note out of corrupt hands and uses it as bait, then as the Green Hornet pits Barnaby and Martin against each other until police arrive in time to hear the admissions that connect them to the murder and illegal steel traffic.

title: Fodder for Headlines (1947-06-10)
plotSynopsis: Prosecutor James Conway returns from Chicago with evidence that can destroy Marty Sluckin's protected gambling empire, only to have Sluckin's men kidnap his daughter Polly and force him to back away publicly. The Green Hornet pretends to be part of the gang, infiltrates Sluckin's operation, blocks its escape route and gets Conway's evidence back to him while police rescue Polly and close in on the racket.

title: The Big Mouthpiece (1947-06-17)
plotSynopsis: Disbarred attorney Gerstman runs a parole racket that gets dangerous criminals such as Lefty Martin, Potter and Nolan out of prison and back into crime. After the Sentinel attacks the racket and Gerstman threatens Britt, the Green Hornet plays the parolees against their protector, obtains Gerstman's incriminating records and leaves police enough evidence to return the criminals to prison and charge Gerstman as an accessory.

title: Of Thee I Sing (1947-06-24)
plotSynopsis: Ward boss Joe Desmond exploits immigrants by charging them for supposed fast-track citizenship papers that are really insurance policies, while placing them in jobs and collecting more money. When Tony Russo and contractor Andrew Melvin become liabilities, Desmond has them silenced. The Green Hornet corners Desmond's lieutenant Nelson into naming the killers and the racket, giving police the confession that breaks the organization.

title: Almost Used Cars (1947-07-08)
plotSynopsis: Tip-Top Charlie's high-priced 'almost used' dealership is tied to a car-theft and resale operation working from a hidden underground garage. The Green Hornet uses an attempted theft of Michael Axford's car to trace the organization, then traps the gang long enough for police to raid the underground operation.

title: City Hall Shakeup (1947-07-15)
plotSynopsis: Public Works Commissioner John Anderson kills himself while under suspicion for missing public funds, but Britt learns that blacklisted newsman Clebourn and roadhouse operator Gorham have been controlling officials through a political machine. Their plan to seize Mrs. Anderson's insurance money to cover the shortage gives the Hornet the opening he needs to expose the coercion, free other officials from the machine's grip and restore the public projects Anderson's allies had been blocking.

title: The Man Who Forgot (1947-07-22)
plotSynopsis: Recently paroled racketeer Duke Finley finds wealthy Grant Wheeler wandering with amnesia, disguises his identity as 'John Murphy' and plans to collect ransom from Wheeler's family. Axford unknowingly gets the confused man released from jail, allowing Britt to identify him; the Hornet then turns Finley's ransom attempt into a police trap, Wheeler recovers his memory and Finley is sent back to prison.

title: The Leopard's Spots (1947-08-26)
plotSynopsis: Fixer Kester poses as a reformer against illegal betting while secretly taking over bookmakers and arranging to profit from a rigged handicap. He has jockey Skip Collins's sister hidden so Skip will think he must throw the race, but the Green Hornet finds her and gets word to Skip that she is safe. Skip rides Manitoba honestly to victory, leaving Kester's betting network exposed to police.

title: The Dock Robber Gang (1947-09-02)
plotSynopsis: A gang of river pirates has been stealing valuable shipments from waterfront warehouses, and a watchman is murdered during one robbery. Britt follows a stolen perfume shipment to Stanley Tim, the businessman publicly demanding police action while secretly directing the thieves from his yacht; the Hornet raids the yacht, exposes Tim and his men with the stolen goods aboard and leaves the gang for police.

title: Old Folks at Home (Reuse Script of 400111) (1947-09-09)
plotSynopsis: Persistent complaints about Green Tree Hospital suggest that patients who should have been released are being kept confined while receiving poor food and care. Britt finds superintendent Meagle has been hiding the truth behind favorable inspections; the Green Hornet penetrates the institution, forces the racket into the open and leaves the Sentinel and police with the evidence needed to free the improperly held patients and end Meagle's control.

title: Death on the Flying Trapeze (1947-09-23)
plotSynopsis: A gang recruits schoolboys to strip valuable parts from parked cars, and the Sentinel's campaign against the racket leads prosecutor Dalton to investigate. After Dalton is murdered and his death disguised, the Green Hornet frightens gym owner Moose Martin into trying to flee; police intercept him, his testimony cracks the murder conspiracy, and the racket's adult leaders are rounded up.

title: Cash Down the Drain (1 of 2) (1947-09-30)
plotSynopsis: Evidence of graft in a city sewer project points toward political fixer Wagstaff, while returning whistleblower John Bates disappears after the Hornet warns Bates's wife that he is in danger. Britt follows the trail to Wagstaff's home, where Bates and the evidence are recovered and the scheme begins to unravel; the episode ends with the Sentinel in position to expose the sewer-project corruption while the wider case continues.

title: The Ring of the Green Hornet (2 of 2) (1947-10-07)
sortKey: 0|1947-10-07|00827|the ring of the green hornet (2 of 2) (1947-10-07)
plotSynopsis: The second half of the story closes a parole racket in which influential John Jarvis and attorney Waters trade recommendation letters and influence for cash. The Hornet diverts a $10,000 payoff and brings the two men together until they accuse one another in front of witnesses, exposing the bribery arrangement and evidence connected with the attack on Doris Melvin, whose investigation threatened them.

title: High Pressure (1947-10-14)
plotSynopsis: After a tunnel collapse kills workers, the Sentinel suspects contractor Gorman used inferior materials and bribed city inspectors to approve the job. The Green Hornet pushes Gorman into a confrontation where the contractor can no longer hide behind officials or threats. With police closing in, Gorman signs a confession naming the inspectors he paid, giving authorities proof of the deadly construction fraud.

title: Marked Money (1947-10-21)
plotSynopsis: Rod Pomeroy and Jerry Jerome extort $20,000 from Talbot, only to discover the bills have been recorded; Jerome murders Talbot with a gun registered to Pomeroy and then blackmails his former partner with the weapon. After Pomeroy shoots Jerome, the Green Hornet follows the dying man's clues, recovers the marked money and murder gun, and leaves police an open-and-shut case that also clears two crimes previously blamed on the Hornet.

title: Exposed (1947-10-28)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet attacks a counterfeiting ring, clears himself of a murder accusation, and faces the added danger of having his identity discovered by a persistent reporter.

title: Graft Crosses a Bridge (1947-11-04)
plotSynopsis: The Daily Sentinel challenges a corrupt highway commissioner pushing a new bridge project, and the murder of a ferry operator sends the Green Hornet into action while a woman who knows his identity becomes involved.

title: Too Hot to Handle (1947-11-11)
plotSynopsis: Larry Larson uses compromising photographs of Commissioner Higgins's son, taken after the young man was drugged at Larson's roadhouse, to keep Higgins from testifying against a narcotics gang. Britt reveals his Green Hornet identity to his visiting father, then feeds Larson chemically treated fake letters suggesting Higgins is corrupt; after Larson hides them with his own files, the Hornet destroys the planted letters, recovers the real evidence and leaves Higgins free of Larson's leverage.

title: The Man on the Top (1947-11-18)
plotSynopsis: After Britt Reid's worried father comes east, Britt finally reveals that he is the Green Hornet and explains why the masquerade is necessary. Father and son then turn their attention to John Grailing, the man at the top of a narcotics racket; with Linda Travis used as bait to get inside Grailing's operation, the Hornet obtains the key evidence from Grailing's vault and breaks the organization wide open.

title: The Plan That Backfired (1947-11-25)
plotSynopsis: Two attorneys arrange partner Thorndike's death as a drunken automobile accident, expecting the crash to hide their murder scheme. As inconsistencies mount, the Green Hornet pressures the conspirators into turning on each other; Fletcher shoots Gramercy and hopes to blame the Hornet, only to be trapped by Gramercy's written account of the original plot and forced into a confession.

title: Number Man (1947-12-02)
plotSynopsis: Repeated police raids on the city's numbers racket fail because someone is leaking advance warning, then Sergeant Burke is framed with a fake payoff. Britt traces the operation to Jay Dryden and Gilpin, confronts them and gets police to the evidence that clears Burke and exposes the racket's leaders, but the victory ends on a new crisis when their accomplices kidnap Linda and demand Dryden and Gilpin's release.

title: Girl in Peril (1947-12-09)
plotSynopsis: After Dryden and Gilpin are captured as leaders of the numbers racket, their partners kidnap Sentinel reporter Linda Travis and threaten to kill her unless the charges are dropped. Linda secretly marks a breakfast plate to reveal her location, and the Green Hornet uses smoke and gas to drive out the kidnappers, rescue her and leave the gang for police, along with the link to the Limpy Ryan murder.

title: Dead Man's Topcoat (1947-12-23)
plotSynopsis: More than $20,000 collected for a Christmas charity is stolen by a masked insider using a dead man's coat and hat as a disguise. The Hornet sends identical extortion notes to the four office workers and identifies the one who does not report hers; 'Elmo Larkin' is exposed as fugitive Mavis Driscoll, who stole another woman's identity, robbed the charity and then tries to kill Miss Case before the case closes in on her.

title: Tickets to the Rosebowl (1947-12-30)
plotSynopsis: While visiting his father on the West Coast, Britt finds that scarce Rose Bowl tickets are feeding a lucrative scalping racket tied to racketeer Nick Marvin and former detective Oliver Perry. The Green Hornet turns Perry's effort to exploit the racket against him, leaving Perry and Marvin in police hands and ending their ticket scheme.

title: Diplomatically Done (1948-01-06)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet uncovers a racket that exploits immigrants by falsely promising to recover money trapped overseas, then follows the scheme into an embassy where diplomatic immunity shields one of the conspirators.

title: Perfect Alibi (1948-01-13)
plotSynopsis: When a $50,000 shortage appears in the controller's office, clerk Madge Hartman is found shot beside a forged confession and part of the missing cash. The real thief, Barton, has arranged a seemingly perfect out-of-town alibi, but the Green Hornet moves the body, gun and money to Barton's Millville property. Confronted with evidence placing the crime inside his own alibi, Barton confesses to the embezzlement and murder.

title: A Matter of Evidence (1948-01-20)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet uses a carefully planned deception to expose a corrupt political boss and the illegal gambling network he controls.

title: Hit and Run (1948-01-27)
plotSynopsis: A murder investigation leads the Green Hornet to a liquor-smuggling operation protected by corrupt officials.

title: Miss Case Meets the Hornet (1948-02-03)
plotSynopsis: Damage to Britt Reid's new car leads to a broader racket involving parking-lot operator Phil Brick and corrupt councilman Grayson. Britt recruits Miss Case to cooperate directly with the Green Hornet, and her role draws out an attempted bribe and murder in front of witnesses; police get the evidence while the Hornet escapes, leaving Miss Case eager to work with him again.

title: The Mysterious Mr Jones (1948-02-10)
plotSynopsis: A routine wage dispute at the Empire Company explodes into violence because professional agitators are secretly being paid to turn labor trouble into national unrest. After witness Rodney Franklin and his wife are killed before Franklin can testify, Britt traces the provocateurs to Darryn Steele, the mysterious Mr. Jones directing the foreign-backed campaign, and the Green Hornet maneuvers Steele's own men into exposing the organization to police.

title: Miss Case Keeps a Secret (1948-02-17)
plotSynopsis: At a society ball, jewels vanish during a blackout and private detective Palmerston claims the Green Hornet is responsible. Palmerston is actually the thief and plans to frame ex-convict Wardell with a fake Hornet mask, but the real Hornet exposes the setup and leaves Palmerston to be caught with the stolen jewelry; afterward Lenore Case reveals she has secretly discovered Britt's double identity and insists she can handle knowing the truth.

title: Rule of Three (1948-02-24)
plotSynopsis: John DeMargo recruits young men for South American jobs and secretly insures them, then arranges fatal plane disasters so he can collect. After two crashes he plans a third under cover of the 'rule of three'; the Hornet turns one accomplice, removes the bomb and puts DeMargo aboard the intended flight, where the scheme collapses and police are waiting.

title: Find the Woman (1948-03-02)
plotSynopsis: The Sentinel's investigation of school-board kickbacks focuses on purchasing official Jane Bixby, who resigns and disappears before she can be questioned. Lenore Case discovers that Bixby is secretly married to councilman Henry Altman, who helped put her on the board and covered the corruption; when Altman tries to silence Lenore, the Green Hornet intervenes and leaves evidence that points police toward the hidden partnership.

title: One for the Senator (1948-03-09)
plotSynopsis: Dog-racing interests try to force Senator Gurom to reverse his public opposition to gambling by threatening to publish a doctored composite photograph that appears to show him taking money while gambling with criminals. Lenore learns the truth, and the Hornet helps set a police trap that catches Skillman with the blackmail scheme and frees the senator to maintain his position.

title: Two Minus Two (1948-03-16)
plotSynopsis: Gangster Big Jim Devlin is found shot on Steve Manning's boat, leaving Manning as the obvious surviving power in their old partnership. The Hornet pressures Devlin's widow into admitting Manning killed him, then races to save her and witness Tony Marino after Manning's men seize them; Miss Case follows the kidnappers, and the rescue gives police the testimony and prisoners needed to break the case.

title: Stone Wall Alibi (Same Plot as 390214) (1948-03-23)
plotSynopsis: The murder of grand-jury witness Andrews blocks an investigation into state graft until prison trustee Joe Finnerty secretly calls Britt and reveals that a powerful convict was released long enough to do the killing. Assistant warden Sinclair kills Finnerty and stages self-defense, but the Hornet uses Finnerty's widow as bait to connect Sinclair with Boss Barton and lure their prison accomplice Webster into a trap witnessed by police, reopening the graft case and earning Finnerty's family the reward.

title: The Funeral Spray (1948-03-30)
plotSynopsis: Paroled gangster Sonny Braggio terrorizes Ted Roberts, the citizen whose testimony sent him to prison, by sending ominous funeral sprays and keeping the Roberts family in fear. Britt also suspects parole-board official Everett Dean accepted a payoff; the Hornet engineers a meeting that puts Braggio, Dean and a jailed gang member together, exposes Dean with Braggio's marked bribe money and sends Braggio back to custody.

title: Pink Wonderland (1948-04-06)
plotSynopsis: Pink Wonderland is an amusement park whose legitimate attractions mask crooked gambling controlled by Sneed and political boss Marshkey. Britt uses Miss Case, Axford and the Hornet to pressure the operators, and a gas-bomb visit convinces Sneed to confess; his statement names the people behind the gambling network and gives police the leverage to make arrests.

title: Process X (1948-04-20)
plotSynopsis: When blueprints for Channing Products' important new Process X disappear from a locked safe, suspicion falls on longtime employee Amos Jones after a fake Green Hornet threatens to expose his old prison record. Britt learns assistant William Elliott had secretly investigated Jones and used that past to create the perfect diversion while stealing the plans for foreign agent Rudo; the real Hornet then uses a false newspaper story to bring buyer and thief together so the plans can be recovered.

title: Double Play (1948-04-27)
plotSynopsis: Commissioner Higgins cannot hold hoodlum Marty Thurber because intimidated witnesses keep collapsing the cases against him. The Green Hornet engineers a double play by steering Thurber into crooked Bixby's office, where stolen money and Bixby's records put both men on the spot; police are tipped in time to catch Thurber with the evidence and finally make a case that intimidation cannot erase.

title: Career at Stake (1948-05-04)
plotSynopsis: The apparent suicide of actress Hazel Paul leads Britt to a blackmail operation that has been draining victims for years. The same gang targets young actress Audrey Johnson by threatening her new film contract with secret facts about her birth and age; the Green Hornet traces the scheme to Fraser, breaks the blackmail ring and preserves Audrey's career while police connect Fraser to the earlier victims.

title: The Woman in Black (1948-05-11)
plotSynopsis: Dr. Rupert's refusal to answer espionage accusations conceals a deeper case involving a murdered courier and film proving his contact with enemy agents. A woman from Rupert's yacht secretly preserves the real film and agrees to testify, while the Green Hornet keeps her alive long enough for the evidence to reach the Sentinel and federal authorities.

title: The Travis Case (1948-05-18)
plotSynopsis: Imprisoned detective Oliver Perry sends racketeer Jack Bartow after Linda Travis in hopes of forcing her to reveal the Green Hornet's identity. Linda is killed during the botched abduction and the gang arranges a false hit-and-run confession, then seizes Lenore Case when she follows the cover-up; the Hornet breaks the gang's trap, rescues Lenore and exposes Perry's role behind the plot.

title: A Cable from England (1948-05-25)
plotSynopsis: Society welcomes 'Colonel Ashton Burleigh' as a distinguished retired British officer while a series of jewel robberies spreads through the city. A cable from England reveals that Burleigh is an impostor, and when his gang moves against Britt Reid and a charity cash box, the Green Hornet turns the trap around. Police recover loot linking Burleigh to the robberies and arrest the gang.

title: The Hornet Bats for a Pitcher (1948-06-01)
plotSynopsis: Promising pitcher Frank Dennon's sudden losing streak makes it look as if he has sold out to gamblers. Britt discovers that Louis Gordon's ring has been coercing Dennon through Phyllis Waring's indebted brother and then trying to frame the pitcher; as the Green Hornet he turns a showdown with Gordon and Ziggy Fagan into the evidence needed to break the gambling operation and clear Dennon.

title: Taxi Dance to Murder (1948-06-08)
plotSynopsis: Waxy Lucas uses his taxi-dance hall as the center of a marijuana distribution racket, and undercover investigator Betty Jennings is killed after getting too close to the operation. The Green Hornet forces evidence into the open and brings pressure on the peddlers until they identify Lucas and his confederates as the people behind both the drug traffic and Jennings's murder.

title: Murder at Lighthouse Mary's (1948-06-15)
plotSynopsis: A government agent investigating international jewel smuggling is murdered after tracing the traffic to Lighthouse Mary's waterfront club. Britt discovers that staged fights at the club conceal the transfer of gems from incoming ships, with derelicts unknowingly carrying the contraband out past police; the Hornet breaks the system, identifies the killers and exposes the smugglers behind the operation.

title: The Curtin Money Plot (1948-06-22)
plotSynopsis: Guard Archie Gluck is murdered on his way to tell the Sentinel that millionaire Galen Curtin has been confined in Dr. Gordale's sanitarium through a fraud. Britt discovers that Gordale has been drugging Curtin into apparent incompetence while the men controlling his estate siphon off his money and plan to recover the rest through Curtin's niece; the Green Hornet frees Curtin and exposes the sanitarium, the financial conspiracy and Gluck's killers.

title: Song Racket (1948-10-28)
plotSynopsis: A music-publishing partnership solicits amateur songs nationwide, collecting money from hopeful writers while technically fulfilling contracts by submitting material that is almost certain to be discarded. The Green Hornet forces the surviving operators to issue refund checks to their victims and warns them that another such racket could make their own crimes the subject of his next case.

title: Road to Ruin (1948-12-30)
plotSynopsis: After a judge sentences his own son to jail, criminals manipulate the young man into helping frame his father, leaving the Green Hornet to unravel the setup.

title: Poor Substitutes for a Prison (1949-02-01)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet uncovers a racket that pays desperate men’s families while the men serve prison terms for crimes committed by others.

title: Face in the Television (1949-02-10)
plotSynopsis: Judy Madigan sees her supposedly retired gangster husband Mickey on a televised prizefight broadcast, and enlarged photographs confirm that several old racketeers were secretly at the arena. Britt follows the clue to political boss Big Tom Morton's plan to organize the returning gangs into a syndicate; the Hornet crashes their meeting, forces Morton to write a confession and secures signed criminal agreements that trigger further confessions and clear the Hornet of Pop Gandy's murder.

title: Hot Car Center (1949-04-28)
plotSynopsis: A stolen-car organization headed by Coleman murders one of its own men, Eddie Ricks, and uses a network of altered cars and hidden parts to keep the operation moving. The Green Hornet's pursuit brings the racket into the open, and Coleman's wife ultimately gives police the murder evidence and information tying stolen vehicles to Coleman's shop, allowing the authorities to break the ring.

title: Catspaw (1950-01-24)
plotSynopsis: A museum's newly arrived black-cat figure is surrounded by threats of an ancient curse as people connected with the exhibit are attacked and killed. Britt discovers that curator Norwick is manufacturing the supernatural scare, has hidden Dr. Kingston inside a mummy case and used an archaeological chisel as the murder weapon; the Hornet exposes the trick, frees Kingston and leaves the physical evidence for police.

title: The Baiter Baited (aka-Bait for a Two Timer) (1950-06-06)
sortKey: 0|1950-06-06|00038|the baiter baited (aka-bait for a two timer) (1950-06-06)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet investigates a fatal building collapse and follows the evidence to corruption inside the city government.

title: Political Crossfire (1952-10-01)
plotSynopsis: Political boss Jim Courtney pretends to retire while secretly betting on candidate Bruce Gifford and arranging a manufactured scandal to destroy rival Joseph Mitchell. The Green Hornet reverses Courtney's scheme, records the conspirators and exposes the hired false accusations, after which Gifford repudiates the corrupt machine rather than benefit from Courtney's manipulation.

title: Spy Master (1952-10-03)
plotSynopsis: Scientist Leonard Fulton and his wife Sarah are working for a foreign spy ring and have stolen information on a vital new American defense project. When loyal scientist Chauncey Gardner is killed and then framed as the traitor, the Green Hornet follows the evidence to the Fultons, recovers the incriminating documents and leaves federal authorities the courier, spy-contact information and proof that clears Gardner.

title: The Changing Alibi (1952-10-08)
plotSynopsis: Racketeer Dan Mendon murders his rebellious lieutenant Joe Annacosta and uses a second killing and a shifting set of alibis to confuse the investigation. Matching bullets and inconsistent witness stories let Britt unravel the deception; the Hornet exposes Mendon's false alibis, while police protect the widow of one victim and catch Mendon's men when they try to silence her.

title: Keys to a Robbery (1952-10-10)
plotSynopsis: A crooked money-route dispatcher sells Floyd Hammond's gang the schedule for a million-dollar armored-truck haul, then is murdered and staged as a suicide after the robbery. Tracking the gang from Cuba to Hammond's yacht, the Green Hornet stows aboard the Quicksilver, gases the thieves, disables the vessel and signals the Coast Guard, leading to recovery of the stolen money and the evidence tying the gang to the killings.

title: Election Boomerang (1952-10-15)
plotSynopsis: Political operator Craig Redland plans to elect his corrupt candidate McLean by staging fake Green Hornet attacks, creating public sympathy for McLean and making honest opponent Gilmer appear allied with a criminal. The real Hornet captures the impostor and his gang, exposes Redland's manipulation and leaves the conspirators to police before the manufactured persecution can decide the election.

title: The Proof of Treason (1952-10-17)
plotSynopsis: Professor Henry Baldwin survives a grenade attack while concealing his past involvement with a subversive party and evidence that can implicate political figure Sherman in espionage. The Hornet takes Baldwin and Sherman aboard a cruiser long enough for Baldwin's full confession and proof to reach Washington, then strands the pair where authorities can recover them; Baldwin agrees to testify, destroying Sherman's political future.

title: Jeff Warren's Safe (1952-10-22)
plotSynopsis: When nightclub racketeer Jeff Warren discovers manager Danny Rivera has been skimming, he has Gats Norton murder Rivera while Warren creates a public alibi among civic officials. The Green Hornet reaches Warren's safe and sends Commissioner Higgins to it, while the murder gun is found in Norton's car; the combined evidence breaks Warren's protection network and ties his organization to the killing.

title: Unknown Assassin (1952-10-24)
plotSynopsis: Scientist Lamar Kazan is murdered after secretly deciding to turn information on a communist network over to the FBI. Britt discovers that Kazan's mentor Professor Barton actually headed the cell and killed him after learning of the betrayal; the Hornet maneuvers Barton's fellow agents into revealing the truth, subdues them and leaves a rescued witness and the incriminating evidence for police.

title: The Microfilm of Death (1952-10-29)
plotSynopsis: A South American diplomat carries vital plans on microfilm, but his daughter's handbag is accidentally switched with photographer Clicker Binney's at an embassy reception. Communist agents kidnap Clicker and the diplomat's daughter while hunting the film; the Hornet rescues them, and the missing microfilm turns out to have been carried unknowingly by Axford after he pocketed a lipstick-shaped cylinder from the switched bag.

title: The Hawkridge Gems (1952-10-31)
plotSynopsis: Nightclub owner Jimmy Edmonds has hidden microphones wired to every table so he can identify wealthy patrons and valuable jewelry. His staff drugs selected guests, steals hotel-room information and sends an ex-bellhop with a passkey after the gems; when the Hawkridge emeralds become the next target, the Green Hornet turns Edmonds's own surveillance system and confederates into the evidence that exposes the whole theft-and-fencing ring.

title: A Friday Night in the Mountains (1952-11-05)
plotSynopsis: Britt Reid, Axford and Commissioner Higgins stop at Professor Mannheim's mountain home after the scientist, who is doing confidential government research, telephones them. They discover hostile agents have taken over the house and are after Mannheim's papers; the Hornet slips inside, helps defeat the spies and leaves the documents secure, escaping from the attic before Higgins can catch him.

title: The Simple Clue (1952-11-07)
plotSynopsis: Counterspy Ken Benson kills enemy agent Leon Barker during a train confrontation and assumes his identity to penetrate Dr. Gorky's spy ring. A simple marking on a timetable links the murder trail to Gorky, and the Green Hornet's separate investigation converges with Benson's as they uncover plans for guiding submarine-launched missiles toward the American coast and break up the cell.

title: The Triple-Cross (1952-11-12)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet investigates a bootleg-liquor operation hidden inside an apartment building after manager Martin Keysby drives tenants out with extreme rent increases. The empty apartments conceal illegal stills and filters, while Keysby works with veteran bootlegger Schmiggy Milton. After Axford is captured while investigating, the Green Hornet uses the gang rivalry to keep the operation moving until police arrive, arrest Milton and Keysby's men, and seize the trucks and stills.

title: Ceiling on Crime (1952-11-14)
plotSynopsis: Facing deportation, crime boss Tommy Barra orders his organization to raise a million-dollar cash farewell while lieutenant Django Kimmons gathers money and detailed records of rackets and corrupt officials. Willie McLean and Joe Rucker plan to murder Barra and Django and steal control of the syndicate, while indebted bookkeeper Pop Selden is pulled into the scheme. The Green Hornet turns the competing criminals against one another, alerts Commissioner Higgins, and leaves police with the money, the syndicate records, and the men behind the triple-cross.

title: The Cigarette Filters (1952-11-19)
plotSynopsis: After Lenore Case is struck by a car, the seemingly helpful driver draws her into running an errand that unknowingly retrieves material for a communist sabotage cell. A clue from cigarette filters helps Britt connect the driver and his blonde partner to the spies. When Lenore is captured, the Green Hornet infiltrates their hideout, rescues her and leaves police the plans for coordinated attacks on major utilities.

title: Shipment for Korea (1952-11-21)
plotSynopsis: A shipment of vital drugs and antibiotics bound for Korea is hijacked after an insider at the Valley Drug Company leaks shipment information to a criminal network. Britt traces the conspiracy through Glen Damon and the hijackers, and the Hornet maneuvers the thieves into exposing one another; the stolen medicine is recovered in time to be sent on to Korea and Damon's confession reveals the inside sabotage.

title: Gas House Ending (1952-11-26)
plotSynopsis: Foundation secretary Joseph Dryden secretly feeds defense research to a spy ring, allowing Julian Kerry and gunman Pete McCone to steal Dr. Haywood's completed plans while shooting a guard and Haywood. The Green Hornet recovers the plans, traps Dryden, Kerry and McCone, then catches the spy-ring leaders when they arrive with $50,000 to buy the secrets.

title: Murder and Espionage (1952-11-28)
plotSynopsis: After secret atomic-device plans vanish, Hart is murdered in Van Port's boathouse and an anonymous tip is designed to frame the Green Hornet for both crimes. Van Port's suspiciously precise knowledge of the killing gives Britt his lead; the Hornet uses a false trail to draw Van Port and the espionage ring together so police can recover the stolen plans and expose Hart's killer.

title: Pretenders to the Throne (1952-12-03)
plotSynopsis: The Green Hornet plays rival crime bosses against one another during a violent gang war, using their conflict to expose both organizations.

title: Axford's Romantic Disaster (1952-12-05)
plotSynopsis: At an international scientific conference, spies Alita Carlisle and Raymond LaMere use Axford's infatuation with Alita to gain access to Professor Wembley's secret supersonic-weapon plans. They shoot Wembley, steal the plans and frame Axford, but Lenore recognizes the lingering smell of his cigar in Alita's room, leading the Green Hornet to the hideout where he frees Axford, subdues the spies and reveals where the stolen plans were hidden.

title: Al Hodge Interview (Played Green Hornet) (1975-00-00)
plotSynopsis: Richard Lamparski interviews actor Al Hodge about originating Britt Reid, the Green Hornet, at Detroit's WXYZ, his years on the radio series and his return to the role after military service.
