plotSynopsis: An astronaut vanishes during a mission and then inexplicably materializes back in the control room carrying a mysterious message from somewhere beyond ordinary space and time.

title: The Fix (1964-09-02)
plotSynopsis: A desperate drug addict in severe withdrawal threatens a physician in an attempt to obtain the narcotics he needs, pushing both men toward a potentially violent confrontation.

title: The Trouble with Alphie (1964-09-03)
plotSynopsis: A boy known for an overactive imagination claims that his uncle keeps human body parts in boxes and records his victims in a black book, but his family dismisses the warning as another fantasy.

title: Cry in the Night (1964-09-04)
plotSynopsis: An older Brooklyn couple hears a woman being attacked outside; while one wants to intervene, the other urges him not to get involved, forcing them to confront the cost of standing by during violence.

title: Sorry to Let You Go (1964-09-07)
plotSynopsis: A middle-aged records-system manager is dismissed after a computer makes his job unnecessary, but he hides the loss from his wife and friends while desperately searching for comparable work. As savings and prospects disappear, he pays his life-insurance premium and begins thinking that his family may be better off if he is dead. After finally confessing that he has been unemployed for two months and feels like a failure, he is seriously injured in a car crash. He survives to discover that the people around him still value him, and during his recovery he finds a new use for the same skills that seemed obsolete: programming filing and record systems for computers. The story ends as he prepares to return to work, having learned that machines can replace tasks without replacing the value of people.

title: Incident at Shadow Valley (1964-09-08)
plotSynopsis: At a lonely roadside diner, owner Pop worries about his dangerously ill grandson while police search for a black truck that forced another vehicle off the road. A strange driver named Janus arrives, talks coldly about death and seems to bring fear wherever he goes. Pop finally pulls a gun and forces Janus to drive west, after which the boy suddenly begins improving. Police soon report that no such truck passed them in either direction. Pop concludes that he has faced the Angel of Death itself and, by driving the visitor away, won his grandson another chance to live.

title: The Decoration (1964-09-09)
plotSynopsis: A young Soviet woman has been rewarded with a red-star decoration for proving her loyalty by informing on her own father for listening to forbidden broadcasts. Later she travels abroad on a covert mission with her small daughter Ella, carrying concealed instructions while trying to appear harmless. At an American checkpoint, Ella sees a Christmas-tree star and innocently says she wants a decoration like her mother's. In exchange for the promise of one, the child explains how her mother earned the first medal and reveals that the supposedly innocent doll and wrapping conceal a secret, repeating against her mother the same kind of betrayal her mother once committed against her grandfather.

title: First Encounter (1964-09-10)
plotSynopsis: The first human expedition to the Moon discovers an advanced native civilization whose people are invisible and inaudible to ordinary human senses because their colors and speech lie outside Earth's perceptual range. The lunar society has become one peaceful nation after surviving a nuclear war and wants no contact with a divided, violent Earth. The astronauts are eventually allowed to return, only to discover lunar representatives have secretly come aboard. The visitors believe Earth may need the same catastrophic lesson the Moon endured, while the astronauts plead for time to prove humanity can learn peace without destroying itself first.

title: To Whom It May Concern (1964-09-11)
plotSynopsis: After a company suspects that valuable designs are leaking, one of its owners begins secretly bugging employees' telephones. The surveillance finds personal weaknesses rather than proof, yet suspicion spreads until he bugs his own brother and family members begin spying on one another in return. Every new recording produces another secret and another reason to distrust somebody, while outsiders exploit the same techniques for their own advantage. By the end, the original security investigation has become a self-feeding system of blackmail, threats and armed paranoia in which nobody can trust anybody else.

title: The Noon Stars (1964-09-14)
plotSynopsis: A rigid, joyless town becomes disturbed by a strange, happy boy who claims he can see stars even in daylight. Reverend Samuel and other leaders turn the child's difference into evidence of sin and encourage the townspeople to fear him, while a few residents try to protect him. After violence drives the boy away, the real stars disappear from the night sky, then even the moon begins fading. The frightened townspeople finally decide they must find and bring him back, only to discover that the road leading out of town has become overgrown and impassable, trapping them in the darkness their intolerance created.

title: My Brother's Keeper (1964-09-15)
plotSynopsis: A woman asks a young doctor to leave the hospital and secretly treat his estranged brother Joe, a criminal who has been shot and cannot seek legitimate care without being arrested. The doctor overcomes years of anger and saves Joe's life, but then explains that medical ethics also require him to report a gunshot wound. Joe threatens him for choosing duty over family. The woman who brought the doctor realizes that his work and integrity matter more than protecting their criminal world, and she makes the police call herself, accepting that helping Joe survive does not mean helping him escape responsibility.

title: The Big Freeze (1964-09-16)
plotSynopsis: Businessman Joe learns that an incurable heart condition will kill him within months and agrees to become the first human subject of an experimental deep-freeze technique, hoping doctors can revive him after a cure is developed. Before treatment he becomes obsessed with securing his wife Dottie's future and violently confronts his business partner Rico. Two years later doctors have perfected the needed heart surgery and revive Joe successfully. They also reveal that the critically wounded Rico was preserved by the same method and has survived as well, confronting Joe with the man he expected never to see again while the life he left behind has changed permanently.

title: The Understudy (1964-09-17)
plotSynopsis: Actor Carl has spent months understudying the lead in a successful play, studying every scene while watching someone else receive the applause. Even after the production moves uptown, his chance never comes, and by the show's final days he is drinking and talking as though his acting life has reached a dead end. Then, only minutes before curtain, the star calls in with laryngitis. Carl initially recoils from the chance he has wanted for so long, but realizes that refusing would end his career. He finally goes onstage, embracing the actor's creed that the show must go on.

title: The Group (1964-09-18)
plotSynopsis: After an elderly woman in an apartment building is beaten to death, police suspect that the killer may be one of the emotionally disturbed patients in a psychiatrist's therapy group. During a tense group session, suspicion first focuses on one member, but the doctor uses the patients' reactions and a psychological reconstruction of the murder to expose Stephen as the real killer. Stephen pulls a gun and threatens the doctor, who keeps talking to the frightened, abused child beneath the violence until Stephen breaks down and surrenders the weapon. The doctor insists that the task is to destroy the murderous behavior while still trying to save the human being behind it.

title: The Kiss Off (1964-09-21)
plotSynopsis: After serving thirty years, aging gangster Big Dolly Palakka returns to Chicago determined to kill former associate Frankie for the life he imagines Frankie enjoyed while Dolly was in prison. Instead he finds old underworld figures diminished by age and Frankie preoccupied with his daughter's respectable wedding and family troubles. Dolly arrives armed for the long-promised showdown, but Frankie's household punctures both men's old gangster posturing. Confronted with how ordinary and troubled Frankie's life actually became, Dolly's fantasy of revenge collapses along with the criminal identity he has carried for three decades.

title: The Odyssey of Number Fourteen (1964-09-22)
plotSynopsis: A reporter investigates the secret disappearance of astronaut Ted Shaw after an unexplained launch. Officials finally reveal that Shaw was sent through the Plickin radiation field, whose strange sound effects produced a kind of audio hypnosis that made him desperate to remain in orbit. Ground controllers had secretly locked him out of manual control and forced the capsule back to Earth, after which he withdrew into near-catatonia. Shaw's wife joins his rehabilitation and patiently uses familiar speech and coordination exercises until he begins responding again.

title: We Are All Alone (1964-09-23)
plotSynopsis: Scientists at Stellar Observatory receive an extraordinarily powerful repeating radio signal and initially believe an intelligent civilization, or even some higher intelligence, may be trying to contact Earth. The public and press wait while researchers decode the transmission. Its frequency eventually reveals that the source is not alien at all but one of humanity's own lost satellites, swept into a distant solar orbit and re-energized by powerful planetary magnetic fields. The signal still contains valuable scientific data, but the hoped-for proof that humanity is not alone disappears.

title: The Evil That Men Do (1964-09-24)
plotSynopsis: Scientist Alexander Kiran develops Benefactral, a drug that suppresses criminal impulses for forty-eight hours, and proposes putting it into the city water supply. The apparent cure for crime immediately threatens politicians, police, security businesses and others whose livelihoods depend on the existing system, and Kiran is pressured to abandon it. He plans a secret reservoir treatment with an ally whose own dose has worn off, only to discover that the human impulses he hoped to eliminate return as soon as the drug does. The experiment ends as a dark satire on both engineered virtue and the interests built around crime.

title: A Genuine Grenotte (1964-09-25)
plotSynopsis: Blind collector Mr. Blair has reached financial desperation and offers what he believes is his last valuable possession, a painting by Grenotte. Prospective buyers discover that the frame is empty: Blair's devoted grandson Eddie secretly sold the original months earlier to support him and left the frame so his grandfather could continue believing the treasured picture was still there. Rather than expose the boy and devastate the old man, the visitors preserve the illusion and pay for the 'painting,' allowing grandfather and grandson to keep their dignity and affection intact.

title: Look Who's Talking (1964-09-28)
plotSynopsis: Researcher Alan becomes convinced he can understand the dolphins in his laboratory, while Dr. Hughes insists their behavior is only animal response and pushes increasingly clinical experiments. One dolphin dies during Hughes's work, deepening Alan's conviction that the animals are intelligent and communicating. When Alan finally opens the way to the sea, Hughes tries to stop the escape and falls into the pool. The dolphins rescue the very man who denied their humanity and then swim away, leaving Alan with the proof of intelligence and compassion that Hughes refused to recognize.

title: The Wrong Arm of Justice (1964-09-29)
plotSynopsis: District Attorney Jay is drawn into a secret vigilante court formed to retry gangster William Reed after a legal acquittal. The group insists it is acting for justice, but Jay demonstrates the danger by presenting an entirely fabricated case and watching the men accept it as readily as real evidence. He then reveals the deception, leaves Reed a way to escape and tells the group that law and order cannot be preserved by violating the law. Jay returns to the legitimate task of building another lawful case against Reed instead of joining the mob's private execution.

title: A Very Private Phone Call (1964-09-30)
plotSynopsis: Wealthy Howard Williams believes the men in his family sometimes revive after apparent death and arranges a red telephone so his wife Laura can be alerted if it happens to him. After his funeral, Laura is instructed to remain near the phone, but her fear of loneliness quickly gives way to the attentions of a bachelor business representative who promises to escort her around the world. As she becomes absorbed in plans for travel and companionship, the red telephone begins ringing in the next room. Laura ignores it and leaves, never realizing the call may be the one Howard warned her to answer.

title: John Hansen, Hermit (1964-10-01)
plotSynopsis: Television producer Chandler discovers recluse John Hansen living quietly in a city park and sees him as perfect material for a human-interest program. John reluctantly agrees to appear only because the publicity and prizes might help a young boy he has befriended. The broadcast turns Hansen into a curiosity and surrounds him with unwanted possessions, attention and strangers, destroying the solitude that gave his life meaning. When he retreats to the park, the boy condemns Chandler for exploiting a man who asked for nothing except to be left alone.

title: Subject Number 428 A (1964-10-02)
plotSynopsis: Computer scientist Philo Benton claims that human beings have no free will and that a sufficiently complete computer record can predict every choice they will make. He proves his point with an astonishingly detailed forecast of Adam Gates's angry attempt to confound the machine, a confrontation that ends in Adam's death. Max Wilhite cannot accept a world in which every action is predetermined. He kills Benton, helps conceal what really happened and records a confession insisting that his unpredictable act was a blow for human freedom, even as the story leaves open whether that choice too might have been predictable.

title: The Arithmetic of Honor (1964-10-05)
plotSynopsis: East German escapee Hans returns to East Berlin a year after reaching the West, accompanied by a young West German woman who trusts and loves him. His real purpose is to steal her identity card and give it to another woman in East Berlin whom he has long promised to rescue. The deception succeeds in getting his intended companion safely across the border, but the innocent woman he used is left behind without papers and is arrested for possessing an identity that authorities now treat as stolen. Hans gains the freedom he promised one person by sacrificing another person's freedom and trust.

title: The Last Land Rush (1964-10-06)
plotSynopsis: In an overcrowded future, the government opens highway divider land to private homesteading, triggering a deadly modern land rush. A young couple crosses the highway, stakes a claim and spends the night defending it from other desperate people, including a mother with a sick baby who also wants a place of her own. By the noon deadline the couple manages to remain on the claim and is declared among the new landowners. Their victory feels hollow after the violence, fear and selfishness required to secure a tiny patch of ground in a society that has run out of room.

title: Echo of Madness (1964-10-07)
plotSynopsis: A frightened woman named Judy arrives at an isolated hotel where the staff and a man named Bruce seem to be conspiring against her, forcing her to remain while recreating disturbing sights, sounds and sensations. The apparent persecution is actually a carefully staged psychiatric treatment. Judy is Bruce's wife, and a train crash at the beginning of their honeymoon caused traumatic amnesia that erased him and the event from her memory. Re-experiencing the champagne, cold room, army blanket and passing train finally breaks through the block, restores her identity and reunites the newlyweds.

title: Justice Is an Uncertain Thing (1964-10-08)
plotSynopsis: Fugitive Joe Hahn has escaped to a country where American authorities cannot extradite him, and investigator Dixon can only wait while a new extradition law works its way toward approval. Hahn's local lawyer finds a technical escape route that requires him to spend a few days on a small offshore island before the law can reach him. Hahn abandons even the woman who wants to accompany him rather than risk his freedom. Just as Dixon concedes the legal maneuver may succeed, a sudden hurricane threatens to sweep over the low islands, leaving nature to deliver the justice the courts could not guarantee.

title: I'm Sorry, Mom (1964-10-09)
plotSynopsis: Resentful rich kid Jerry arranges his own fake kidnapping with a group of criminals, expecting his mother to pay a $100,000 ransom that he and the gang can divide. The supposed accomplices turn the scheme real: they assault Jerry's mother when she brings the money, set her adrift and decide to keep the entire ransom. Jerry finally understands that his mother risked herself because she loves him and tries to back out, but the gang has no reason to leave a witness. His mother survives long enough to alert authorities, while Jerry's attempt to punish her ends with his own death.

title: All the Bright Young Ones (1964-10-12)
plotSynopsis: In a society ruled by the young, citizens over forty are forced into retirement, but the forty-one-year-old father of the teenage mayor refuses to be pushed aside.

title: The Autocrat (1964-10-13)
plotSynopsis: A domineering matriarch uses claims of a terminal heart condition to keep her family under control even though her doctor says her heart is sound.

title: The Dog Killer (1964-10-14)
plotSynopsis: A group of delinquents terrorizes the elderly Winstead women, treating them as witches and escalating the harassment around their home.

title: The Good Samaritians (1964-10-15)
plotSynopsis: Travelers reluctantly stop for a badly beaten man left naked on a dark road and discover that their decision to help him may also have saved their own lives.

title: The Captive Spirit (1964-10-16)
plotSynopsis: A private detective locates a wealthy man's runaway daughter, but she refuses to return because escaping her isolated home has given her a freedom she has never known.

title: An Honorable Way (1964-10-19)
plotSynopsis: A nervous airline passenger finds herself seated beside a man who hopes the troubled flight will crash because an accident would let him die without the shame of suicide.

title: The Man Who Loved Jellyroll (1964-10-20)
plotSynopsis: After a head injury gives him the ability to read minds, a hospitalized man realizes that his wife and business partner may be plotting to kill him, even through his favorite dessert.

title: Captain Gamble's Uniform (1964-10-21)
plotSynopsis: A rigid sea captain survives a torpedoing and receives an unusual orange replacement uniform that seems to transform him into a far kinder and more compassionate commander.

title: Including Murder (1964-10-22)
plotSynopsis: A suspicious wife hires a private detective to learn whether her husband is having an affair and instead hears the more frightening possibility that he may be planning her murder.

title: The Sacrifice (1964-10-23)
plotSynopsis: A businessman faces a modern version of a biblical test when he is asked to sacrifice his son's life for the good of the company.

title: Sirens in the Night (1964-10-26)
plotSynopsis: A husband longs to leave the frightening city while his wife feels more alive there, and a tense night of sirens forces their conflicting desires toward a breaking point.

title: The Prodigal Son (1964-10-27)
plotSynopsis: A man is hired to impersonate another family's dead son, drawing four people into an elaborate deception built on grief and mistaken identity.

title: Odds on the Tower (1964-10-28)
plotSynopsis: An air-traffic controller deeply in debt to organized crime is pressured to use his position to engineer an airplane crash.

title: A Nightmare (1964-10-29)
plotSynopsis: A history teacher who stops to help a distressed student finds his life turning into a waking nightmare when the girl suddenly accuses him of assault.

title: The Second Chance (1964-10-30)
plotSynopsis: An aging man discovers a spell that promises renewed youth after he removes the source of his misery, but the bargain ultimately gives him exactly what he deserves.

title: June 17Th, Where Are You (1964-11-02)
plotSynopsis: A woman returns from a purchased ninety-day trip around the world complaining that her itinerary somehow delivered only eighty-seven days, setting off an absurd dispute over the missing time.

title: Why Can't Life Be More Like in the Movies (1964-11-03)
sortKey: 0|1964-11-03|00067|why can't life be more like in the movies (1964-11-03)
plotSynopsis: Three unemployed actors whose careers consisted of playing kidnappers decide to apply what the movies taught them and stage a real abduction for profit.

title: Body Without the Crime (1964-11-04)
plotSynopsis: After angrily telling his wife he hopes she breaks her neck, a man is overwhelmed by guilt when she dies in exactly that way and comes to believe he has committed murder in his mind.

title: Twenty Minutes in the Life of Melinda Madison (1964-11-05)
sortKey: 0|1964-11-05|00069|twenty minutes in the life of melinda madison (1964-11-05)
plotSynopsis: A fading movie star desperate for attention agrees to fake a suicide as a publicity stunt, mixing alcohol, sleeping pills and professional desperation into a dangerous performance.

title: Living Credit (1964-11-06)
plotSynopsis: In a society where every stage of life is governed by credit records, a person's very identity and ability to function depend on the financial system until something goes terribly wrong.

title: The Nameless Day (1964-11-09)
plotSynopsis: A man finds a watch inscribed specifically for him even though its date predates his birth by ten years, drawing him toward an eerie old house and a mysterious young woman.

title: World Enough and Time (1964-11-10)
plotSynopsis: A man who has avoided aging by continually traveling west ahead of the calendar faces disaster when an automobile accident threatens to interrupt the journey that keeps time from catching him.

title: The Gift (1964-11-11)
plotSynopsis: A poor Mexican couple receives a wedding gift from a celebrated artist that may be worth a fortune, yet its value conflicts with the simple home they built for themselves.

title: A Brand New Life (1964-11-12)
plotSynopsis: A prosperous businessman abandons his comfortable suburban identity completely, and twenty years later the lawyer who helped erase his old life begins wondering whether he should do the same.

title: Deedle Deedle Dumpling My Son X-1 (1964-11-13)
plotSynopsis: An alien invasion begins not with spaceships in the sky but through the body of an ordinary teenage boy.

title: The City Manager (1964-11-16)
plotSynopsis: Felicity's technocratic city manager pursues efficiency by automating jobs, cutting welfare, forcing much of the population underground, and centralizing transportation, elevators, refrigeration and ventilation under a single master control system. Councilman Jed Hornsby repeatedly warns that the city has been engineered without regard for people. Hornsby finally demonstrates the system's fatal weakness by pulling its single power plug. The manager attacks him, the plug falls down an elevator shaft, and the manager is left trapped in the dark, airless city he designed, unable to restart anything without the plug he cannot reach.

title: The Contract Maker (1964-11-17)
plotSynopsis: A young professional killer accepts a contract on an elderly judge, only to discover that his intended victim has plans of his own for how the confrontation will end.

title: A Little Piece of Candle (1964-11-18)
plotSynopsis: Four miners trapped underground after a cave-in cling to survival with only a small piece of candle and an unexpected source of help.

title: To Be or Not to Be Maybe! (1964-11-19)
plotSynopsis: After a woman stages a suicidal gesture to win her husband's sympathy, he decides to turn her manipulation into a real death and carefully plans to make the next attempt fatal.

title: A Nothin' Place (1964-11-20)
plotSynopsis: A man and woman rob an armored payroll truck and hide in a decrepit hotel they think nobody cares about, only to learn there is a reason the place seems to exist outside normal notice.

title: Dark Appointment (1964-11-23)
plotSynopsis: A man hunts down an old friend with murder in mind, but his pursuit forces him to confront the fact that killing offers no escape from guilt or fear.

title: The Talkers (1964-11-24)
plotSynopsis: In a radioactive underground world, two survivors struggle toward each other simply for the chance to speak and briefly reclaim the human connection their ruined civilization has lost.

title: A Little Knowledge (1964-11-25)
plotSynopsis: Police trying to identify a dead man are confronted by two women who each claim the body belongs to her husband, turning a routine identification into a dangerous mystery.

title: The Neighbor (1964-11-26)
plotSynopsis: Residents become alarmed when a solitary man moves into a huge house, never seems to eat or drive anywhere, and is finally glimpsed at a window without a face.

title: The Lesson (1964-11-27)
plotSynopsis: A woman awakens in unfamiliar surroundings and gradually realizes that everyone knows her by another name, leaving her convinced she somehow inhabits another woman's life and body.

title: To Helen with Love (1964-11-30)
plotSynopsis: A wealthy traveler brings her schoolteacher friend Helen to Paris, but Helen's romance with a valet threatens old social ties and reveals that the supposedly aristocratic couple they visit have secrets of their own.

title: Finders Can Be Losers (1964-12-01)
plotSynopsis: A young woman using the name Jane Melton urgently seeks a lawyer, claiming that even her own identity may be false and that she knows disturbing facts about the man she is trying to reach.

title: Found Money (1964-12-02)
plotSynopsis: A pair of con men turn on one another after cheating an innocent victim, only for each swindle to trigger another until the tricksters themselves become the marks.

title: Fog (1964-12-03)
plotSynopsis: A mother impaired by alcohol and sleeping pills panics after realizing she accidentally sent her migraine-prone daughter away carrying the wrong medication and must find the child before it is too late.

title: Sound Track of a Happy Family (1964-12-04)
plotSynopsis: A family lovingly restores an old house into what they expect will be their dream home, but their happiness is shattered when tragedy strikes inside the place they worked to save.

title: Bug Off (1964-12-07)
plotSynopsis: A babysitter invents a prowler story to clear a shared telephone line, then faces a real emergency when the child becomes seriously ill and the person on the line refuses to believe her.

title: Congratulations, Mr Mayor (1964-12-08)
plotSynopsis: A seemingly perfect town boasts no crime, alcoholism or public problems, but its unusual elections reveal that becoming mayor carries a disturbing price.

title: The Weapons at Hand (1964-12-09)
plotSynopsis: A wounded journalist and his photographer companion are aided by a Vietnamese woman who has lost her family to the war, leading them to reflect on the weapons ordinary people can use in a fight for freedom.

title: I Love You (1964-12-10)
plotSynopsis: At a strict reform school for wealthy girls, an authoritarian headmistress treats one rebellious student as a threat while a colleague argues that the girl may need compassion more than punishment.

title: Bang Bang You're Dead (1964-12-11)
plotSynopsis: Children left at home turn pretend law-and-order games dangerously real when one boy begins firing a gun, forcing a stranger to play along as the sheriff in hopes of calming him down.

title: Now Listen to the Tiger (1964-12-14)
plotSynopsis: An American airman and an enemy soldier meet wounded and unarmed in the jungle, where their hostility gives way to a shared struggle against the greater danger of a stalking tiger.

title: The Victim (1964-12-15)
plotSynopsis: A woman fascinated by a series of murders begins relying on a seemingly kind man to walk her home, even as police question whether she may be drawing herself toward the same danger that claimed the other victims.

title: An Average American Murder (1964-12-16)
plotSynopsis: Hardworking factory employee Sam Crawford comes home after an exhausting Friday of overtime, humiliation, drinking and a speeding arrest, already angry that the simple evening he planned with his wife Millie has been spoiled. Millie criticizes his temper and the way he makes life harder for himself, and their argument escalates over burned pork chops. Feeling mocked by everyone, Sam loses control and attacks her with a butcher knife. In prison he becomes a model inmate, but every Friday night he cries over the ordinary domestic life he destroyed in a moment of rage.

title: Just Call Me Lucky (1964-12-17)
plotSynopsis: Ambitious operator Lucky Landers is determined to hurry to Fairbanks for a business deal despite repeated warnings from old Alaskans and a bush pilot that bad weather cannot be rushed. After the flight leaves them stranded in the wilderness, the pilot decides their only chance is to build a signal fire. Lucky pulls a gun rather than let him burn the papers in his briefcase, revealing that the papers are actually all the money he has made in Alaska. The pilot burns the cash anyway, a rescue plane spots the fire, and Lucky survives only by losing the fortune he was so desperate to protect.

title: Nuptial Flight (1964-12-18)
plotSynopsis: A newlywed couple crossing a vast, empty stretch of highway are terrorized by three young men in a faster car who repeatedly cut them off and threaten them. The harassment exposes strains in the marriage and the bride's previously unrecognized terror of open country; even a remote service-station owner refuses to let them use his phone because he fears the local men. With nowhere to hide or get help, the couple finally turns the chase around and forces the pursuing car off the road. It overturns and burns, and the newlyweds choose to drive on rather than stop, grimly rationalizing what has happened.

title: Six-Foot Flower Box (1964-12-21)
plotSynopsis: A couple determined not to meddle in their neighbors' affairs hears disturbing nighttime noises next door, then unknowingly helps move a suspicious six-foot flower box.

title: Finders Keepers (1964-12-22)
plotSynopsis: A busy executive finds a briefcase in a phone booth and later learns it may contain thirty thousand dollars from a robbery, forcing him to decide what to do with the apparent windfall.

title: The Flea Circus (1964-12-23)
plotSynopsis: A circus performer and her lover arrange for her husband to die in an apparent shooting-gallery accident so they can collect the insurance, but the dying man turns their scheme against them.

title: The Wish Fulfillment Machine (1964-12-24)
plotSynopsis: In a distant future where machines grant every desire without effort or emotion, a centuries-old man is judged mentally ill because the only thing he truly wants is to die.

title: Look at My Record (1964-12-25)
plotSynopsis: A battered journeyman boxer is told his final opponent will take a dive and wagers his savings on himself, only to discover that winning the bout does not mean winning the gamble.

title: Five Strangers (1964-12-28)
plotSynopsis: Four travelers stranded by heavy fog accept a freight pilot's offer to fly them to Chicago, but their improvised flight carries the strangers toward an unexpected final destination.

title: Charlie, the Beautiful Machine (1964-12-29)
plotSynopsis: A mild-mannered worker threatened by automation discovers that the new machine depends on his special touch, creating an unlikely partnership that may save his job.

title: The Blue Eyed People (1964-12-30)
plotSynopsis: A doctor's attention to a hereditary trait exposes a couple who are posing as the parents of a kidnapped infant.

title: Presence of Mind (1964-12-31)
plotSynopsis: An American couple purchases an old hacienda and dismisses the housekeeper's warning that a long-dead member of the family still haunts the estate.

title: Discotheque (1965-01-01)
plotSynopsis: A respectable man exhausted from searching for his missing wife is led by a seductive stranger into a notorious nightclub where the search takes a darker turn.

title: The Blank Check (1965-01-04)
plotSynopsis: A struggling garment businessman refuses a blank check from his former partner and father figure, determined to prove he can rescue his company without accepting help.

title: Devil Dust (1965-01-05)
plotSynopsis: A traveler crossing the Southwest becomes fascinated by an extremely rare vintage automobile kept beside a remote desert shack by an elderly Navajo owner.

title: The Corporation (1965-01-06)
plotSynopsis: An office employee receives an anonymous warning ordering her to resign from the corporation or face terrible consequences, but management appears strangely unconcerned.

title: Don't Call Me, I'll Call You (1965-01-07)
plotSynopsis: A Russian operative with a photographic memory and an urgent toothache attempts to penetrate a top-secret American installation.

title: The Deliquents (1965-01-08)
plotSynopsis: A couple returning for an annual weekend celebration run into a police crackdown and discover that their insistence on acting like rebellious youths no longer fits their age.

title: The Button Stealers (1965-01-11)
plotSynopsis: A former intelligence officer is pulled back into a confusing game of espionage and realizes someone is trying to manipulate him after years away from the service.

title: Bravo, Bravo (1965-01-12)
plotSynopsis: An elderly former dancer retreats into memories of herself at twenty-three, still beautiful and applauded, because she cannot accept that age has taken away her career.

title: Man on the Canyon Wall (1965-01-13)
plotSynopsis: A mob enforcer survives a car crash only because the very fugitive he was sent to capture rescues him from a canyon wall, leaving both men trapped by the mob's orders.

title: The Wandering Spaceman (1965-01-14)
plotSynopsis: A future lunar station becomes the setting for a new version of the Flying Dutchman legend when an endless traveler pauses before continuing his lonely journey into space.

title: The Trophy (1965-01-15)
plotSynopsis: After an elderly man dies in the hospital, a reporter and a policeman are told the cause was a broken heart and begin to question whether the explanation is as simple as it sounds.

title: The Wheel (1965-01-18)
plotSynopsis: A mother devastated by her son's death resents the neglected friend who keeps visiting the family, until grief forces her to confront what the unwanted boy represents.

title: Across the River from Grandma's House (1965-01-19)
plotSynopsis: A girl discovers an escaped killer in the woods and leads him to her grandmother's isolated home, where the two women offer help for reasons the fugitive does not understand.

title: A Dream of a Scheme (1965-01-20)
plotSynopsis: Evidence appears to prove that a man strangled his wife and buried her body, yet the elaborate murder may be part of a scheme in which even the police unknowingly assist him.

title: The Imposters (1965-01-21)
plotSynopsis: A butler recruits a maid who resembles his wealthy employer's wife so the pair can murder the couple and assume their identities, only to learn their idea is not original.

title: The First Weekend (1965-01-22)
plotSynopsis: A teenager returning from a reform-center weekend clashes with her father over the boy he blames for her trouble, forcing the adults to confront the anger and mistrust dividing the generations.

title: Where Art Thou, Romeo (1965-01-25)
plotSynopsis: A gangster unable to flee while on bail plans to fake his death using a drug that induces suspended animation so he can be smuggled out in a coffin.

title: Mr Horn's Holiday (1965-01-26)
plotSynopsis: A struggling artist makes a bargain for success and finds the devil, calling himself Mr. Horn, installed in his home to demonstrate the chaos that follows a world without temptation.

title: Tomorrow 6-1212 (1965-01-27)
plotSynopsis: A woman calling for a routine weather forecast is inexplicably connected by telephone to someone living in the year 2035.

title: The Hostage (1965-01-28)
plotSynopsis: After a robbery leaves him cornered by police, gunman Ernie Johnson takes delicatessen owner Sam Schwartz and his wife hostage, using Sam as a human shield while he tries to arrange an escape car. Sam keeps talking to the younger man and finally refuses to cooperate any longer, deliberately walking toward the door even though Ernie threatens to shoot him. Faced with either killing Sam or surrendering, Ernie hesitates long enough for police to rush in, and the standoff ends with Ernie killed and Sam alive.

title: I've Got Your Number (1965-01-29)
plotSynopsis: A married couple's sleep is shattered by repeated late-night calls from an anonymous woman who tells the wife she hates her and intends to kill her.

title: The Boy (1965-02-01)
plotSynopsis: At a lonely diner on a foggy night, a man hears news reports from decades earlier and begins to suspect he has somehow slipped backward through time.

title: The Time, the Place, and the Death (1965-02-02)
sortKey: 0|1965-02-02|00132|the time, the place, and the death (1965-02-02)
plotSynopsis: A cheerful man announces that he expects to die soon, giving two acquaintances a tempting opportunity to hasten the prediction and profit from his estate.

title: The Hunters (1965-02-03)
plotSynopsis: An alcoholic father takes his son hunting in the woods, bringing his drinking problem along on a trip that should have been about the two of them.

title: Greater Love Hath No Man (1965-02-04)
plotSynopsis: With only one artificial kidney machine available, doctors face an agonizing choice between an eleven-year-old girl and the elderly scientist whose work helped create the treatment.

title: The Underveloped Nation (1965-02-05)
plotSynopsis: An Air Force colonel crash-lands in unfamiliar territory inhabited by tiny, seemingly primitive people and tries to understand the strange underdeveloped society around him.

title: Cold Storage (1965-02-08)
plotSynopsis: A group chosen for suspended animation learns they will be frozen for a thousand years without the option to refuse and wonders whether the experiment is preservation or a kind of death.

title: The Eye of the Storm (1965-02-09)
plotSynopsis: While organizing an emergency hospital during a hurricane, a doctor is confronted by an escaped mental patient who blames him for being committed.

title: Lovely Boy (1965-02-10)
plotSynopsis: A charming young suitor appears perfect to a girl's family until conflicting stories about his life suggest that his polished image may conceal a dangerous fraud.

title: The Sybil of Sycamore Lane (1965-02-11)
plotSynopsis: Suburban housewife Kate begins to believe she is clairvoyant after a series of accurate hunches, including calling her children away just before a dangerous object crashes where they were playing and tipping a friend to a profitable stock. Her skeptical husband Adam grows uneasy when the gift intrudes into his work and their marriage. A deliberately confident weather prediction finally fails during a picnic, and Adam discovers that the stock tip could have come from information Kate overheard. Their tension eases, though Kate ends the story still convinced she has at least a little intuition left.

title: The Chain (1965-02-12)
plotSynopsis: A trivial incident involving a dog and a New York taxicab sets off a sequence of consequences that expands far beyond the people directly involved and threatens international peace.

title: The Forgotten (1965-02-15)
plotSynopsis: Two strangers meet on a bridge while each is considering suicide and begin talking about the loneliness and disappointments that brought them there.

title: A Little Game on Saturday Mornings (1965-02-16)
plotSynopsis: Two boys, Jeff and David, spend Saturday morning playing soldier under the command of their General, whom they also call Dad, as he reenacts heroic battlefield stories and dies gloriously in their game. The fantasy gradually breaks apart when attendants in white uniforms arrive to return the General to his chair at a veterans' home. The boys are revealed not as real children but as the family the permanently disabled veteran never had, imagined every Saturday as he relives a war that destroyed the life he might have lived.

title: Post Time (1965-02-17)
plotSynopsis: A celebrated horse-race announcer whose voice brings the track vividly to millions faces a crisis after one fateful race changes his career.

title: It's a Work of Art (1965-02-18)
plotSynopsis: A mysterious Dr. Lazarus recruits scientists for Project Adam, a six-day construction effort whose purpose hints at recreating something far more ambitious than an ordinary machine.

title: Listen, Mother (1965-02-19)
plotSynopsis: During a long drive home, a mother talks endlessly without listening to her son and becomes so distracted by criticizing another motorist that the trip nearly ends in disaster.

title: A Tale for the Nursery (1965-02-22)
plotSynopsis: A tiny, elderly nursery-school teacher fights back when a powerful bank refuses to renew her lease because it wants the space for a new branch.

title: The Elevator (1965-02-23)
plotSynopsis: Returning home at two in the morning, a woman enters her apartment elevator with the man she assumes is the night operator, unaware that he has already killed the real attendant.

title: The Man Who Heard Everything (1965-02-24)
plotSynopsis: A mind reader exploits his gift for advancement and tries to sell his abilities to the government, only to find the power becoming unbearable as he begins hearing thoughts from everyone around him.

title: Toby's Wonderful Egg (1965-02-25)
plotSynopsis: In a weather-beaten Outer Banks clubhouse where old sailors trade stories of the sea, an extraordinary arrival revives the region's tradition of fantastic maritime tales.

title: Little Girl, Little Girl (1965-02-26)
plotSynopsis: A candy-store owner is puzzled when a sweet young girl enters alone at midnight, then discovers that his innocent-looking visitor is something far more sinister.

title: You Bet Your Life (1965-03-01)
plotSynopsis: A compulsive gambler keeps raising the stakes until betting ceases to be about money and begins threatening his very survival.

title: French Quarter (1965-03-02)
plotSynopsis: Desperate to pay a two-thousand-dollar debt by midnight, a young man decides to steal from his cousin and turns a bad situation into disaster.

title: Annie Is Watching (1965-03-03)
plotSynopsis: An ominous nocturnal presence begins intruding into an ordinary workplace, creating the unsettling sense that someone or something is always watching.

title: The Land of Milk and Honey (1965-03-04)
plotSynopsis: A former criminal who finally went straight is executed for murder and awakens in the heaven his mother promised him, only to discover that paradise is not what he imagined.

title: April Snowfall (1965-03-05)
plotSynopsis: A fortune teller predicts a chain of strange events ending in a woman's death and demands payment to reveal how to prevent it; her skeptical husband becomes alarmed as each prophecy comes true.

title: Last Ride on the Merry-Go-Round (1965-03-08)
plotSynopsis: A welfare investigator interviewing a condemned man about support for his wife begins to suspect that the bitter prisoner may have been framed for the crime that put him on death row.

title: Just for Kicks (1965-03-09)
plotSynopsis: Bored teenagers looking for excitement kidnap a popular radio performer and demand a huge ransom, turning a reckless prank into a serious crime.

title: Broken Image (1965-03-10)
plotSynopsis: A celebrated doctor tries to reconnect with his estranged, self-destructive son and is tested when the young man claims he killed his girlfriend during an argument.

title: Publish or Perish (1965-03-11)
plotSynopsis: A professor living on his father's academic reputation pressures a brilliant ex-convict assistant to ghostwrite a paper, but the exploited researcher decides to strike back.

title: The Janitor (1965-03-12)
plotSynopsis: A kindly school janitor repairing a girl's bag in the basement becomes the target of a terrible accusation after adults misinterpret an innocent remark.

title: Divorce American Style (1965-03-15)
plotSynopsis: A successful department-store buyer refuses to surrender the career she loves, but as her marriage collapses both parents must face the damage the divorce is doing to their son.

title: Any Port in a Storm (1965-03-16)
plotSynopsis: A young married couple survives a storm at sea only to be stranded on Eniwetok, an island marked by its history as a hydrogen-bomb test site.

title: Across the River to Grandfather's House (1965-03-17)
plotSynopsis: Three cousins have remained together in their grandfather's house since his unsolved murder, and the arrival of another relative revives the question of which heir killed him.

title: If the Spirit Moves You (1965-03-18)
plotSynopsis: An architect is repeatedly visited by the ghost of his late employer, whose nighttime interference begins ruining the man's work and threatening his career.

title: They Call Me Howie (1965-03-19)
plotSynopsis: After moving into an old Boston house, a young boy begins recalling remarkably specific details of colonial life as though he had lived there before.

title: Bad News for Mrs Bristol (1965-03-22)
plotSynopsis: Police tell a newlywed that her husband is really an escaped mental patient who murdered his first wife, forcing her to decide whether the man she loves is who he claims to be.

title: The Hazelton Story (1965-03-23)
plotSynopsis: When the elderly head of a wealthy corporation suffers a stroke, her relatives' scramble for control reveals just how far their greed is willing to go.

title: Point of Impact (1965-03-24)
plotSynopsis: A military base learns that a nuclear-armed missile from another world will strike nearby within minutes, yet its unusual target and years of attempted contact make immediate retaliation dangerously uncertain.

title: There's One Born Every Minute (1965-03-25)
plotSynopsis: A lifelong confidence man crosses the line from persuasion to outright theft when he takes a large sum from a trusting elderly woman and discovers his conscience may not be as flexible as his salesmanship.

title: The Widow (1965-03-26)
plotSynopsis: A drifter sheltering from a snowstorm at a rural home suddenly finds himself beside a corpse with a gun in his hand as a widow and her daughter close a trap around him.

title: The Avenger (1965-03-29)
plotSynopsis: A shortwave engineer claims the dead speak through him and begins carrying out supernatural death sentences against people they supposedly want punished.

title: Bright House, New House (1965-03-30)
plotSynopsis: An unhappy married couple's home life is disrupted by the arrival of a mysterious woman who appears distraught yet refuses to explain who she is or why she has come.

title: Eye of Kali (1965-03-31)
plotSynopsis: Two thieves plan to steal the world's largest ruby from a museum, unaware that the gem's defenses may extend far beyond the guards stationed beside it.

title: Three on a Death (1965-04-01)
plotSynopsis: A cruel, manipulative man has made at least three people want him dead, but even in death he manages to frustrate those who hoped to take revenge.

title: Get Away with Murder (1965-04-02)
plotSynopsis: Two teenagers steal cash and a car for a reckless trip to Las Vegas, and a crash followed by more irresponsible choices turns their adventure into a flight from police.

title: The Welcome Lady (1965-04-05)
plotSynopsis: A neighborhood welcome visit to a newly arrived couple takes an uncanny turn when Mrs. Wilson's hospitality proves strangely bewitching.

title: Till Death Do Us (1965-04-06)
plotSynopsis: Two lovers unable to be together while the woman remains married arrange a joint suicide at an isolated motel, but their pact raises doubts about whether both truly intend to die.

title: Mirror, Mirror on the Wall (1965-04-07)
plotSynopsis: A woman spends decades resisting the signs of age that arrive with each birthday until, late in life, she finally understands that time has not been the enemy she imagined.

title: A Million Miles to Nowhere (1965-04-08)
plotSynopsis: A bank director steals half a million dollars and abandons his family for a planned escape by sea with his mistress, only to watch his carefully arranged new life unravel.

title: It's My Funeral (1965-04-09)
plotSynopsis: An elderly hospital patient with no surviving family refuses the operation that could save her, leaving her doctor to convince her that an isolated life can still have purpose.

title: A Matter of Pride (1965-04-12)
plotSynopsis: A husband forced to remain at home while his wife earns the family's income sinks into depression as wounded pride makes him question his role in the marriage.

title: The Lion Who Wasn't There (1965-04-13)
plotSynopsis: A woman and the man she loves use an African safari assignment as cover for a scheme involving a supposed man-eating lion and a rebel shipment of gold.

title: Come Home Daughter, All Is Forbidden (1965-04-14)
plotSynopsis: Traveling anonymously in Europe, a U.S. senator's daughter becomes involved with a fugitive gambler who later uses her letters to blackmail her father.

title: Panic (1965-04-15)
plotSynopsis: A woman begins to believe her fiancé is deliberately making her appear unstable so he can have her committed after marriage and gain control of her inheritance.

title: He Was a Good Boy (1965-04-16)
plotSynopsis: A grandmother's faith in her teenage grandson is shattered when his friends carry him upstairs from the basement and a doctor confirms he has died from a drug overdose.

title: Incident in Ceylon (1965-04-19)
plotSynopsis: On a Ceylon tea plantation, a supposed curse surrounding the owner's wife raises the question of whether supernatural forces or human motives are really at work.

title: You Gotta Cry Sometime (1965-04-20)
plotSynopsis: A highly accomplished female athlete who excels at nearly everything discovers that there is one part of life her competitive ability cannot master.

title: The Wonderful Stamps from El Dorado (1965-04-21)
plotSynopsis: An unusual set of El Dorado postage stamps draws its owner into an adventure in which the prized airmail issues prove extraordinary in a very literal way.

title: Said the Spider (1965-04-22)
plotSynopsis: Three generations of women traveling through snowy country learn a killer is loose on the highway, then become increasingly suspicious of a charming stranger who has crossed their path.

title: Poor Little Greek Girl (1965-04-23)
plotSynopsis: Police recover a young Greek woman's body and strongly suspect a suburban family man of the murder, but lack the evidence needed to bring him to trial.

title: Greener Pastures (1965-04-26)
plotSynopsis: A married man who has fallen out of love with his wife becomes consumed by feelings for a woman from his past and begins imagining another life.

title: Lorna Is a Strange Child (1965-04-27)
plotSynopsis: A sheltered college student has always been told she is abnormal, but a concerned teacher's visit to her isolated home suggests the real strangeness lies with her parents.

title: The Beneficiary (1965-04-28)
plotSynopsis: A baffled man inherits three and a half million dollars from a stranger, but the will requires him to spend the fortune entirely on selfish pleasures or lose everything.

title: Junior (1965-04-29)
plotSynopsis: A young man returns home after his former girlfriend is found murdered, and his controlling mother's attempts to protect him create evidence that makes him look increasingly guilty.

title: Make My Name Clean (1965-04-30)
plotSynopsis: A dying gangster offers a press agent an enormous retainer for a final scheme intended to rehabilitate his reputation by deceiving the public on a grand scale.

title: Driver's Seat (1965-05-03)
plotSynopsis: A yacht captain dependent on a wealthy patron longs to make his own decisions for once, and a day on the water gives him a chance to find out what being in control really costs.

title: Incident on Us 1 (1965-05-04)
plotSynopsis: A young armed robber holds up a roadside diner, but when the clerk gains the upper hand he chooses an unexpected response that may offer the boy a final chance to change.

title: The Name Game (1965-05-05)
plotSynopsis: A cabdriver finds a passenger's wallet and borrows the cash for a Las Vegas gambling scheme, only to blunder into danger when the wallet's owner appears under his name.

title: Reunion (1965-05-06)
plotSynopsis: A successful public figure returns to his hometown after a decade and nervously seeks out the woman he once loved, unsure what the years have made of either of them.

title: The Ten-Year-Old Car (1965-05-07)
plotSynopsis: Six months after her husband's murder, a widow offers his old car for an absurdly high price because she believes the vehicle can lure the killer back into reach.

title: Lift to Beyond (1965-05-10)
plotSynopsis: On the final day before retirement, an elderly elevator operator cannot bear to see the antique lift he has run for forty years dismantled and makes one last stand inside it.

title: Nightmare at 26,000 Feet (1965-05-11)
plotSynopsis: After a mentally unstable airline executive shoots the pilots in flight and barricades himself in the cockpit, the passengers and crew can only hope he will somehow land the plane.

title: Around the Corner from Nowhere (1965-05-12)
plotSynopsis: A heartbroken newspaper photographer headed to photograph a murdered woman instead meets a mysterious stranger whose outlook forces him to notice the life he has been ignoring.

title: Wrong Turning (1965-05-13)
plotSynopsis: Two married lovers who meet secretly each week insist they will never hurt their spouses, until one encounter threatens to expose the affair and wreck both households.

title: A Birthday Present (1965-05-14)
plotSynopsis: An honest man's criminal brother unexpectedly leaves a woman and her child in his care, forcing him into the consequences of a life very different from his own.

title: The Gandy Walker (1965-05-17)
plotSynopsis: A successful musician reacts badly to his wife's pregnancy, prompting her to seek psychiatric help from an old friend and uncover the painful secret behind his fear of having children.

title: Will Integrity Ruin Clint Marble (1965-05-18)
plotSynopsis: A celebrated film actor shocks Hollywood by refusing an Academy Award after deciding that accepting it would make him a hypocrite.

title: Blind Man's Bluff (1965-05-19)
plotSynopsis: Police suspect a blind newsstand operator helped identify a man for assassination, and his refusal to talk becomes more dangerous when the syndicate marks him for death.

title: Death of an Old Flame (1965-05-20)
plotSynopsis: A piano player is reunited with the woman he once loved and is drawn into one final fur robbery with her gangster husband, only to discover the scheme is not what it seemed.

title: Two Birds, One Stone (1965-05-21)
plotSynopsis: A dying ex-convict visits the man he blames for sending him to prison and reveals that he intends to make his old enemy share his fate.

title: Rocky Loves Julie (1965-05-24)
plotSynopsis: A series of obscene phone calls escalates into a home invasion when the obsessed caller attacks one roommate and confronts the woman he believes he loves.

title: The Dance Hall (1965-05-25)
plotSynopsis: A man on death row for killing his wife and her lover clings to hopes of an appeal while another prisoner describes what it is like to be led toward execution.

title: Incident at Phong Trang (1965-05-26)
