title: Barefoot in Athens (1965-05-27)
plotSynopsis: A young woman expecting to marry a newly graduated engineer is furious when he chooses philosophy instead, until her grandmother challenges her belief that money is the measure of a future.

title: The Protective Circle (1965-05-28)
plotSynopsis: A hard-driving businesswoman begins receiving threats after a rival's suicide and takes a Caribbean vacation while an anonymous caller promises that guilt will be punished with a life.

title: Lake Toplitz (1965-05-31)
plotSynopsis: Memories of Nazi trucks sinking mysterious trunks in an Austrian lake inspire yet another dangerous hunt for the treasure believed to lie on the bottom.

title: Mama's Girl (1965-06-01)
plotSynopsis: A woman returning to her husband becomes convinced he and a neighbor are plotting her death, and pours her mounting fear into a desperate telephone call to her mother.

title: Noose of Pearls (1965-06-02)
plotSynopsis: After fourteen years caring for a cruel elderly aunt in hopes of inheriting her valuable pearls, a woman realizes how much of her life she has sacrificed to the promise of wealth.

title: Untrue Confession (1965-06-04)
plotSynopsis: After a drunken college student flees a hit-and-run, his father confesses in his place to protect the boy's scholarship, but the father's sacrifice conceals another motive.

title: Two Came Back (1965-06-07)
plotSynopsis: A gold-seeking expedition into headhunter country turns poisonous when a married woman tries to draw her husband's best friend into both an affair and a murder plot.

title: Skeletons (1965-06-08)
plotSynopsis: A man who believed a shameful episode in his past was buried finds himself cornered by a blackmailer prepared to expose the secret.

title: The Wishing Stone (1965-06-10)
plotSynopsis: A boy's little sister finds a glittering stone she believes can grant wishes, and what seems like harmless fool's gold begins to frighten her with apparently real results.

title: The Manor House (1965-06-14)
plotSynopsis: A wealthy self-made businessman returns to buy the mansion he admired as a poor boy and surprises its former owner's daughter by asking for more than the house.

title: A Bad Day's Work (1965-06-15)
plotSynopsis: A rookie policeman in Harlem accidentally kills a fleeing teenage purse thief, triggering public outrage and a crisis of conscience that forces him to reconsider his duty.

title: Incident at Simbarundi (1965-06-16)
plotSynopsis: Two reporters pursuing a dangerous story in a volatile jungle setting become caught in a situation where armed violence threatens to overtake the assignment.

title: Country Boy (1965-06-17)
plotSynopsis: A northern college student stranded by a broken-down car in the rural South accepts help from an outwardly friendly local man who may be far more dangerous than he appears.

title: The Banana Ball (1965-06-18)
plotSynopsis: A struggling tournament golfer follows risky advice from a stranger, and the unexpected success of the shot leads to a larger lesson about the choices shaping his future.

title: The Roper (1965-06-21)
plotSynopsis: After a longtime city treasurer dies and an audit reveals missing money, investigators use an unconventional psychological approach to learn whether his daughter knows where the funds went.

title: The Pigeon (1965-06-22)
plotSynopsis: A practiced confidence man selects an unsuspecting mark and persuades him that he has untapped potential, setting up the victim for a carefully engineered swindle.

title: Goodbye Matt (1965-06-23)
plotSynopsis: A debt-ridden opportunist caught dining with his mistress scrambles to invent a story before word reaches his wealthy wife, only to expose his character to everyone around him.

title: Ride with Death (1965-06-25)
plotSynopsis: An amnesiac rescued after a fall becomes convinced he is a long-reclusive race driver, but his return home produces another man claiming the same identity.

title: Custody of the Mother (1965-06-28)
plotSynopsis: A daughter facing a family crisis reconnects with the father she has not truly known for seventeen years and discovers an unexpected source of understanding.

title: You Can't Fight City Hall (1965-06-29)
plotSynopsis: When his delicatessen building is condemned, an aging proprietor turns to his lawyer son in hopes of preserving something tangible to leave him.

title: Method in the Madness (1965-06-30)
plotSynopsis: A woman in an asylum plans a mass poisoning aimed at national leaders, while the men deciding whether she is sane enough for release unwittingly hold the key to whether the scheme can proceed.

title: Teacher, Teacher (1965-07-01)
plotSynopsis: A new teacher confronts a bright but disruptive student who is leading the class toward failure and tries to convince the teenagers that rejecting education only harms themselves.

title: Children of Death (1965-07-02)
plotSynopsis: A domineering wife, a passive husband, an ambitious psychiatrist and a frustrated lawyer form a volatile group whose personal conflicts mirror the aggression of fighting fish.

title: Devotion (1965-07-05)
plotSynopsis: A western drifter risks being shot and left in the desert to save an accused murderer from a lynch mob, raising the question of why he is so determined to deliver the man alive.

title: Jailbreak (1965-07-06)
plotSynopsis: A sheriff who believes a traveling salesman should not hang for an accidental barroom killing searches for another way to prevent the execution.

title: Don't Hesitate to Call (1965-07-07)
plotSynopsis: A young producer lands a lucrative television special but finds the pressure of directing a difficult star may be more than the money is worth.

title: A Matter of Appearances (1965-07-08)
plotSynopsis: A newlywed wife leaves after seeing her husband with another woman, only to encounter a string of innocent-looking circumstances that make her understand how deceptive appearances can be.

title: Ed's War (1965-07-09)
plotSynopsis: An embittered older man convinces himself that younger people have pushed his generation aside and begins planning violence against a young couple near his rural home.

title: Casuality of a Small War (1965-07-12)
plotSynopsis: Frustrated by the war in Vietnam, a farmer and his wife kidnap a U.S. senator in an attempt to force the government to bring their son and other Marines home.

title: The Marked Man (1965-07-13)
plotSynopsis: An acclaimed college football star wants to quit after repeated injuries threaten permanent disability, but his coach's control over his athletic and academic life makes leaving difficult.

title: The Walls of Poison Ivy (1965-07-14)
plotSynopsis: At a twenty-fifth college reunion, three old friends confront the secrets that shaped their lives, including one man's fear that violence runs through his family.

title: The Big Waves (1965-07-15)
plotSynopsis: With witness descriptions offering little help in a jewelry-store robbery, police reluctantly test a stenographer's claim that ESP has put her on the suspected thief's mental wavelength.

title: Flies with Honey (1965-07-16)
plotSynopsis: An insurance administrator visits the widow of an old acquaintance who supposedly killed himself, but her personal knowledge of the dead man makes the suicide explanation difficult to accept.

title: Summer's End (1965-07-19)
plotSynopsis: A teacher expects her Malibu romance with a carefree surfer to continue beyond summer, then learns she may only be the latest in a pattern of seasonal affairs.

title: Flights of Angels (1965-07-20)
plotSynopsis: A gifted but alcoholic Shakespearean actor spirals toward tragedy while his daughter struggles to rescue him from the life that is destroying him.

title: In Time of Trouble (1965-07-21)
plotSynopsis: After witnessing a fatal attack from her apartment, a woman is haunted by guilt and fear when she and her husband refuse to identify the killer to police.

title: Jazz Festival (1965-07-22)
plotSynopsis: A woman becomes attracted to a muscular boxer, then mistakes his refusal to fight her jealous boyfriend for cowardice without understanding why he avoids violence.

title: Whatever Happened to the 5 -25 (1965-07-23)
plotSynopsis: A longtime commuter misses his usual train and meets an exciting young woman, briefly tempting him to reclaim the youth he feels has slipped away.

title: In Absence of All Intelligent Life (1965-07-26)
plotSynopsis: A military reconnaissance crew lands on a seemingly lifeless planet and discovers evidence that a humanlike civilization destroyed itself in nuclear war a thousand years earlier.

title: I Spy Sister Sarri (1965-07-27)
plotSynopsis: A woman accused of murder remembers nothing of the crime, and a psychologist searching for an explanation uncovers a destructive alternate personality within her.

title: Death Watch (1965-07-28)
plotSynopsis: A desperate boy from a poor neighborhood forces a hospital surgeon at gunpoint to come home with him and treat his gravely ill mother.

title: Big Deal on Sutton East (1965-07-29)
plotSynopsis: A kidnapping scheme on New York's Upper East Side unfolds in a comic pattern closely resembling O. Henry's story The Ransom of Red Chief.

title: Joey (1965-07-30)
plotSynopsis: An adopted boy faces being removed from the foster parents who have become his family, forcing the adults around him to confront what truly serves the child.

title: Old Time Radio Researchers Group Information
plotSynopsis: A narrated introduction to the Old Time Radio Researchers Group and its preservation work. It explains how volunteers collect broadcasts from transcription discs, reel-to-reel tapes and cassettes, digitize them, correct widespread title/date and encoding errors, prepare broadcast logs and audio histories, and certify researched series for accuracy and completeness. The feature also describes the group's research, Project OTR and distribution activities and emphasizes that its prepared collections are intended for free distribution.

title: Theater Five
plotSynopsis: A narrated introduction to Theater Five, ABC's weekday radio-drama revival that aired at 5 p.m. from August 3, 1964 through July 30, 1965. The feature describes its roughly twenty-minute anthology stories within a half-hour slot, its 260-show run, use of veteran and newer radio performers, frequent science-fiction and contemporary themes, and Fred Foy's announcing, presenting the series as a late tribute to classic network radio drama.

title: Queen of Spades (1953-10-04)
plotSynopsis: Hermann becomes obsessed with an old countess's secret of three winning cards and uses her companion to gain access to the house. His confrontation frightens the countess to death, but her ghost later names the cards on condition he gamble only once; after two wins, the final card betrays him, and the ruined Hermann ends in an asylum haunted by the queen.

title: The Overcoat (1953-10-11)
plotSynopsis: Poor copying clerk Akaky Akakyevich saves painfully for a new overcoat, only to have it stolen on the first night he wears it. Officials brush aside his pleas, exposure and despair bring on his death, and afterward reports spread of a ghost in St. Petersburg stripping overcoats from passersby, including the important official who had dismissed him.

title: The Tale (1953-10-18)
plotSynopsis: A wartime naval commander suspects a neutral Scandinavian ship of secretly supplying a German U-boat but cannot prove it. He deliberately gives the captain a course that leads onto the rocks; afterward he is left unable to decide whether he carried out justified wartime retribution or committed murder against an innocent man.

title: The Happy Hypocrite (1953-10-25)
plotSynopsis: Dissolute Lord George Hell falls in love with a virtuous young woman who rejects him because his face reflects his wicked life. He hides behind a saintly wax mask and genuinely reforms; when a former lover tears the mask away, his real face has changed to match it, revealing that the goodness he pretended has become genuine.

title: The Sire De Maletroits Door (1953-11-01)
plotSynopsis: Young Denis de Beaulieu takes refuge through a mysterious door and is trapped by the formidable Sire de Malétroit, who assumes he is the secret lover of his niece Blanche. Given a choice between marrying her and death at sunrise, Denis learns Blanche had actually been corresponding with another man, yet mutual respect turns to love and he freely chooses the marriage.

title: The Judgement (1953-11-07)
plotSynopsis: Psychiatrist John Farrington shoots his best friend Jim Foster and claims to remember nothing of the act. He uses his professional knowledge to present himself as mentally ill, receives treatment instead of ordinary punishment, and looks forward to freedom and Jim's widow Carol; the closing encounter exposes that his story of recovery and sanity is far less secure than he believes.

title: The Purse (1953-11-14)
plotSynopsis: Young painter Hippolyte Schinner is nursed after a fall by an impoverished baroness and her daughter Adelaide, then suspects them when his purse disappears. Returning ashamed, he learns Adelaide had made him a new purse and that the family's frequent card-playing visitor deliberately loses money to support the proud widow without humiliating her, clearing the women of any theft.

title: La Grande Breteche (1953-11-21)
plotSynopsis: A jealous husband discovers that his wife's Spanish lover is hiding in a closet and forces her to swear on a crucifix that no one is there. Holding her to that oath, he has the doorway bricked up with the man still inside and makes her endure the sounds of his death; afterward she abandons the house, burns its furnishings and leaves La Grande Bretèche to decay around the secret.

title: Markheim (1953-11-28)
plotSynopsis: Markheim murders an antique dealer on Christmas Day and searches the shop for money while a mysterious visitor calmly confronts him with the pattern of his corrupt life. When the visitor urges him to kill the returning maid as well, Markheim finally rejects the path he has chosen, opens the door to her and gives himself up rather than commit another murder.

title: Zodomirskys Duel (1953-12-19)
plotSynopsis: Captain Zodomirsky is drawn into an affair of honor that ends in a pistol duel watched anxiously by the woman who loves him. He survives the encounter because the opposing weapon is not truly lethal, but when his rival rides back alone she assumes Zodomirsky has been killed and dies from the shock before he can reach her with the truth.

title: A Christmas Carol (1953-12-24)
plotSynopsis: Miserly Ebenezer Scrooge rejects Christmas charity until Marley's ghost and three spirits force him to confront his lonely past, the suffering around him and the death that awaits him if he does not change. Waking on Christmas morning, he embraces generosity, sends a feast to the Cratchits and becomes a kinder employer, friend and protector of Tiny Tim.

title: The Canterville Ghost (1953-12-26)
plotSynopsis: The practical American Otis family moves into Canterville Chase and responds to its resident ghost with remedies, jokes and relentless teasing rather than terror. Only young Virginia takes his misery seriously; she helps him seek forgiveness and eternal rest, disappears with him into the supernatural realm, and returns after his long haunting has finally ended.

title: The Country of the Blind (1954-01-02)
plotSynopsis: Mountaineer Nunez falls into an isolated valley whose inhabitants have been blind for generations and assumes his sight will make him their natural ruler. Instead they regard vision as a delusion; after falling in love with Medina and agreeing to have his eyes removed so they can marry, he cannot surrender sight and escapes into the mountains rather than submit to the operation.

title: Little Louise (1954-01-16)
plotSynopsis: A respected landowner secretly murders the village girl Louise and helps direct suspicion elsewhere while guilt steadily destroys his peace. Months later he writes a confession and plans suicide, then changes his mind and desperately tries to recover the posted letter; the honest postman refuses every bribe and threat, leaving the murderer's own confession beyond his control.

title: Lord Savilles Crime (1954-01-23)
plotSynopsis: A palm reader tells Lord Arthur Savile that murder lies in his future, and Arthur postpones his marriage until he can fulfill what he believes is fate. After failed attempts to kill relatives, he finally kills the fortune-teller himself and marries Sybil, only to learn later that the man's predictions were fraudulent, making the crime entirely unnecessary.

title: Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde (1954-01-30)
plotSynopsis: Dr. Henry Jekyll's experiment separates his respectable self from the brutal Edward Hyde, but each transformation strengthens Hyde's hold. Hyde's violence escalates to murder, Dr. Lanyon dies after witnessing the transformation, and Jekyll's increasingly involuntary changes leave him trapped by the creature he created and facing destruction through his own confession.

title: The Case of Bardell Vs Pickwick (1954-02-06)
plotSynopsis: A badly phrased conversation leads Mrs. Bardell to believe Mr. Pickwick has proposed marriage, and she later sues him for breach of promise. In court, sentimental advocacy and confused testimony overwhelm Pickwick's defense; even Sam Weller's efforts cannot rescue the case, and the jury finds for Mrs. Bardell.

title: Bartleby (1954-02-13)
plotSynopsis: A mild Wall Street lawyer hires the quiet copyist Bartleby, who gradually answers every request with 'I would prefer not to' until he refuses work, refuses to leave the office and finally refuses ordinary life itself. Removed to prison, Bartleby stops eating and dies in the yard; afterward the lawyer learns he once worked among undeliverable letters, a job that seems to explain his hopeless withdrawal.

title: The Inspector General (1954-02-20)
plotSynopsis: Penniless traveler Khlestakov is mistaken by corrupt provincial officials for a powerful inspector traveling incognito. He accepts their money, boasts outrageously and enjoys the mayor's household before slipping away, leaving behind a letter that exposes how thoroughly he fooled them just as news arrives that the real inspector has come.

title: The Suicide Club (1954-02-27)
plotSynopsis: A prince and his companion follow an eccentric cream-tart seller into a secret club whose members gamble with cards to determine who must die and who must kill. They witness the society's murderous machinery firsthand and escape shaken, while the next morning's newspaper confirms that the club's supposedly voluntary game has already claimed more victims.

title: The Outcasts of Poker Flats (1954-03-06)
plotSynopsis: Gambler John Oakhurst and several other unwanted residents are expelled from Poker Flat and become trapped by a mountain snowstorm with the innocent Tom Simson and Piney Woods. Supplies fail, Tom is sent for help and one by one the stranded party dies; Oakhurst is ultimately found dead after choosing his own end, leaving the harsh judgment of the town contrasted with the loyalty shown among the outcasts.

title: Mr Micawbers Difficulties (1954-03-13)
plotSynopsis: Young David Copperfield is sent to work in London and lodges with the irrepressibly hopeful Mr. Micawber, whose debts lead to pawned possessions and imprisonment. David shares the family's humiliations and resilience, and when Micawber is released he parts with the boy after delivering his famous warning that even a tiny excess of spending over income leads to misery.

title: The Luck of Roaring Camp (1954-03-20)
plotSynopsis: When Cherokee Sal dies giving birth in a rough mining camp, the men adopt her baby and name him Tommy Luck. Caring for him transforms the settlement into a cleaner and gentler place, but a catastrophic flood destroys the camp; the child and the men who protected him are swept away, ending the brief period in which the baby had changed them all.

title: A Tale of Two Cities (1954-03-27)
plotSynopsis: Charles Darnay is drawn back into revolutionary France and condemned by the forces punishing his aristocratic family, while Sydney Carton recognizes that the resemblance between them gives him one final chance to make his wasted life meaningful. Carton changes places with Darnay in prison, sends him away with Lucie and her family, and goes calmly to the guillotine in his stead.

title: When Greek Meets Greek (1954-04-11)
plotSynopsis: Two older confidence men separately invent respectable identities, one posing as the president of a nonexistent Oxford college and the other as an aristocratic father, each hoping to profit from the other. Their younger relatives quickly recognize the fraud on both sides, fall in love anyway and let the two schemers negotiate an elaborate marriage settlement while privately laughing at how completely each has been fooled.

title: The Snow Goose (1954-04-18)
plotSynopsis: Reclusive painter Philip Rhayader nurses an injured snow goose brought to him by the frightened girl Fritha, and the bird becomes the bond that slowly draws them together. When Dunkirk is evacuated, Rhayader sails his small boat repeatedly into danger to rescue soldiers and is killed; the snow goose returns alone to Fritha, who finally understands her love for him as the bird circles the lighthouse in farewell.

title: The Colonels Lady (1954-04-25)
plotSynopsis: Country gentleman George Peregrine is embarrassed when a book of passionate poetry published by his quiet wife Evie becomes a sensation and seems to reveal a long-secret affair. Confronting her at last, he learns the lover in the poems was George himself as a young husband, and that she wrote from memories of the tenderness their marriage had gradually lost.

title: The Black Mate (1954-05-02)
plotSynopsis: An aging but highly capable sailor dyes his white hair and beard black so that employers who prefer younger men will still hire him. When a storm destroys his supply of dye and his true age can no longer be hidden, an accident and the captain's own assumptions allow him to pass the sudden whitening off as a supernatural shock; years later the captain finally learns the practical truth behind the famous 'black mate.'

title: Half an Hour (1954-05-09)
plotSynopsis: After another bitter quarrel with her wealthy husband, Lady Lillian uses the half hour before their dinner guests arrive to flee to the man she loves and plan a new life. Her lover is killed before they can escape, forcing her back to the house in time to receive the guests; she burns his final letter and resumes her place beside her husband while concealing everything that has happened.

title: Dr Knock (1954-05-16)
plotSynopsis: Dr. Knock buys a sleepy rural medical practice and sets out to teach the entire district that health is merely an illness not yet diagnosed. Free consultations, ominous examinations and carefully cultivated fear turn healthy villagers into paying patients until beds, hotels and households are organized around his treatments, astonishing the former doctor with Knock's ambition to put virtually the whole town under medical care.

title: The Aspern Papers (1954-05-23)
plotSynopsis: A literary scholar rents rooms from the aged Juliana Bordereau in Venice because he believes she still possesses private papers from the dead poet Jeffrey Aspern. His deception and snooping alienate Juliana, and after her death her niece Tina makes clear that marriage would make the papers his; unable to pay that price, he leaves, and Tina destroys the entire collection rather than let him return for it.

title: My Adventure in Norfolk (1954-05-30)
plotSynopsis: A man visiting an isolated Norfolk bungalow becomes involved with a mysterious woman, a disabled car and evidence of a violent crime that seems to have happened around him that very night. When he later takes his clues to Scotland Yard, the police identify the woman and her criminal associates from old records and reveal that the fatal crash and deaths he encountered actually occurred four years earlier, leaving his experience unexplained except as a haunting.

title: Private Rooms (1954-06-06)
plotSynopsis: An aging actor's attempt at a private romantic supper in Vienna goes badly and sends him into memories of his theatrical youth. By the end of the evening, chance brings him together with a woman from those earlier days, and their shared recollections of touring, quarrels, performances and old affection replace the shallow romance he had been pursuing with something warmer and more enduring.

title: The Man Who Could Work Miracles (1954-06-16)
plotSynopsis: Ordinary clerk George Fotheringay discovers that whatever he commands can miraculously become true. Encouraged to use the gift for sweeping reforms, he and the Reverend Maydig reshape their town and finally attempt to halt the motion of the heavens, producing catastrophe; Fotheringay is forced to undo the disaster and return the world to the moment before his miraculous power began.

title: The Liar (1954-06-23)
plotSynopsis: An artist becomes fascinated by Colonel Capadose, a charming adventurer whose effortless lies are accepted as truth by nearly everyone around him, including his devoted wife. The artist paints him in a revealing portrait, but the canvas is later slashed and the couple supplies another convenient story about a troublesome woman; the artist realizes that the marriage itself survives through the wife's willingness to protect and participate in Capadose's fabrications.

title: My Uncle Toby (1954-06-30)
plotSynopsis: Gentle Uncle Toby, retired after a war wound, spends his life happily recreating military sieges with Corporal Trim until the determined Widow Wadman turns her attention to marrying him. Her courtship becomes entangled with anxious curiosity about the location and consequences of Toby's old groin wound, while Toby remains almost comically innocent of the romantic campaign that the entire neighborhood can already see developing around him.

title: Four Meetings (1954-07-07)
plotSynopsis: Over four encounters, an American narrator watches the hopeful Caroline Spencer pursue her dream of Europe and gradually lose the independence and romance she imagined finding there. Her money and loyalty are absorbed by a selfish cousin and his dubious continental companion, and at the final meeting she is trapped in their shabby household, still clinging to the European ideal that has brought her disappointment rather than freedom.

title: A Sentimental Journey (1954-07-14)
plotSynopsis: Yorick travels through France determined to be a 'sentimental traveler,' measuring the journey less by landmarks than by fleeting human encounters. Through flirtations, acts of courtesy, comic misunderstandings and his attraction to women he meets along the road, he turns ordinary travel into a series of reflections on sympathy, desire and the small gestures that make strangers briefly intimate.

title: Becky Sharpe-Vanity Fair (1954-07-21)
plotSynopsis: On the eve of Waterloo, Becky Sharp moves through the frightened British society in Brussels with the same cool opportunism that has carried her upward, while Amelia anxiously waits on George Osborne and Rawdon Crawley prepares to fight. Battle shatters the fashionable revelry and George is killed, yet Becky immediately adapts to the new circumstances, bargaining and maneuvering for her own security amid the panic.

title: Queen of Spades (1954-07-28)
plotSynopsis: Hermann becomes obsessed with an old countess's secret of three winning cards and uses her companion to gain access to the house. His confrontation frightens the countess to death, but her ghost later names the cards on condition he gamble only once; after two wins, the final card betrays him, and the ruined Hermann ends in an asylum haunted by the queen.

title: The Overcoat (1954-08-04)
plotSynopsis: Poor copying clerk Akaky Akakyevich saves painfully for a new overcoat, only to have it stolen on the first night he wears it. Officials brush aside his pleas, exposure and despair bring on his death, and afterward reports spread of a ghost in St. Petersburg stripping overcoats from passersby, including the important official who had dismissed him.

title: The Happy Hypocrite (1954-08-11)
plotSynopsis: Dissolute Lord George Hell falls in love with a virtuous young woman who rejects him because his face reflects his wicked life. He hides behind a saintly wax mask and genuinely reforms; when a former lover tears the mask away, his real face has changed to match it, revealing that the goodness he pretended has become genuine.

title: The Sire De Maletroits Door (1954-08-18)
plotSynopsis: Young Denis de Beaulieu takes refuge through a mysterious door and is trapped by the formidable Sire de Malétroit, who assumes he is the secret lover of his niece Blanche. Given a choice between marrying her and death at sunrise, Denis learns Blanche had actually been corresponding with another man, yet mutual respect turns to love and he freely chooses the marriage.

title: The Judgement (1954-08-25)
plotSynopsis: Psychiatrist John Farrington shoots his best friend Jim Foster and claims to remember nothing of the act. He uses his professional knowledge to present himself as mentally ill, receives treatment instead of ordinary punishment, and looks forward to freedom and Jim's widow Carol; the closing encounter exposes that his story of recovery and sanity is far less secure than he believes.

title: Country of the Blind (1954-09-01)
plotSynopsis: Mountaineer Nunez falls into an isolated valley whose inhabitants have been blind for generations and assumes his sight will make him their natural ruler. Instead they regard vision as a delusion; after falling in love with Medina and agreeing to have his eyes removed so they can marry, he cannot surrender sight and escapes into the mountains rather than submit to the operation.

title: The House on 92nd Street (1945-10-12)
plotSynopsis: An FBI operative infiltrates a Nazi espionage cell to stop its attempt to obtain secrets connected with the atomic bomb.

title: The Marriage Racket (1945-10-19)
plotSynopsis: Agents investigate a lethal lonely-hearts scheme after a newly married farmer's suspicious death points to a marriage racket.

title: The Serviceman's Fraud (1945-10-26)
plotSynopsis: A supposedly patriotic veterans organization comes under FBI scrutiny, exposing fraud, internal betrayal and murder.

title: The Desert Dictator (1945-11-02)
plotSynopsis: A wounded bank robber seizes an archaeological party in the desert, triggering an FBI pursuit through hostile country.

title: The Bogus Bankruptcy (1945-11-09)
plotSynopsis: The Bureau probes a fraudulent bankruptcy at a fur company after a key credit employee disappears under suspicious circumstances.

title: The Allotment Swindle (1945-11-16)
plotSynopsis: A returning serviceman discovers that a fraudulent allotment wife and her partner are plotting to profit from his GI insurance.

title: The Bobby Sox Bandit (1945-11-23)
plotSynopsis: Two teenage girls turn a fantasy of easy money and Hollywood excitement into a reckless interstate crime spree.

title: The Big Breakout (1945-11-30)
plotSynopsis: A boastful escape expert puts his elaborate prison-break plan to the test, convinced he can stay ahead of federal investigators.

title: Pearl Harbor (1945-12-07)
plotSynopsis: The program follows the FBI's preparations before Pearl Harbor and its rapid wartime response to threats of sabotage and espionage.

title: The Highway Hi-Jacker (1945-12-14)
plotSynopsis: A string of highway robberies leads agents to two criminals operating around a desert tourist camp, where the proprietor's wife carries a secret of her own.

title: The Sorrowful Swindler (1945-12-21)
plotSynopsis: A Christmas confidence trick aimed at an elderly woman becomes a trap for a seasoned swindler when the FBI closes in.

title: Murder on the High Seas (1945-12-28)
plotSynopsis: A killing aboard a freighter draws the FBI into an international scheme involving Nazi agents, stolen art and concealed identities.

title: Crime in the Roaring 20'S (1946-01-04)
plotSynopsis: A ruthless young hood rises through the post-World War I underworld, drawing increasingly serious attention from federal law enforcement.

title: The Innocent Killer (1946-01-11)
plotSynopsis: The murder of an Alaskan assayer opens into a wider conspiracy involving another killing and an attempt to frame an innocent person.

title: The Cold Blooded Kidnapper (1946-01-18)
plotSynopsis: Federal agents race to rescue an abducted high-school girl and capture the kidnapper before he can escape with her.

title: The Unwelcome Guest (1946-01-25)
plotSynopsis: An escaped convict pressures a former associate and his family while an FBI bank-robbery investigation tightens around him.

title: The Sinister Souvenir (1946-02-01)
plotSynopsis: A veteran's wartime Luger becomes evidence in a murder after a relative steals the souvenir weapon for a deadly purpose.

title: The Cautious Killer (1946-02-08)
plotSynopsis: An FBI agent goes undercover in a coal mine to obtain proof against a man suspected of murdering his wife and hiding the crime with a fire.

title: The Corrupt City (1946-02-15)
plotSynopsis: After an honest detective is framed and shot while exposing a protected theft ring, the FBI takes on the corrupt network behind it.

title: The Pan American Patriots (1946-02-22)
plotSynopsis: Agents penetrate a Nazi intelligence operation in South America while also trying to solve a murder tied to the spy ring.

title: The Castaway Killer (1946-03-01)
plotSynopsis: A deported criminal stages his own death at sea and hides with a fishing captain and his wife, setting off a federal manhunt.

title: The Skyway Swindle (1946-03-08)
plotSynopsis: Two confidence men lure returning veterans into investing in a fake airport and flying-school venture until the Bureau moves against them.

title: The Paroled Killer (1946-03-15)
plotSynopsis: A newly paroled criminal engineers a bank robbery, eliminates accomplices and constructs a cover story that the FBI must dismantle.

title: The Wasteland Hideout (1946-03-22)
plotSynopsis: Two escaped convicts kidnap a pair of teenagers and hide in an isolated wilderness cabin as federal agents search the area.

title: The Bogus War Bride (1946-03-29)
plotSynopsis: A pair of swindlers exploit servicemen desperate to reunite with overseas brides, bringing the fraudulent war-bride operation under FBI investigation.

title: The Delinquent Parents (1946-04-05)
plotSynopsis: Neglected teenagers drift into increasingly serious crime, forcing investigators to confront both the offenses and the failures at home behind them.

title: The Nylon Hijacker (1946-04-12)
plotSynopsis: A woman seeking revenge on an unfaithful relative devises a scheme to frame him for hijacking and murder, but federal investigators begin pulling it apart.

title: The Swampland Kidnapping (1946-04-19)
plotSynopsis: A ransom kidnapping takes agents deep into the Florida Everglades as they race to locate the captive before time runs out.

title: Salesman of Espionage (1946-04-26)
plotSynopsis: An undercover agent penetrates a Nazi espionage organization whose activities have already become entangled with murder.

title: The Singing Swindler (1946-05-03)
plotSynopsis: An older con artist and her musical partner sell a Texas oilman worthless leases in a ten-thousand-dollar confidence game.

title: The Carnival Killing (1946-05-10)
plotSynopsis: A murder at a traveling carnival reveals a volatile love triangle and sends a fugitive fleeing from the FBI.

title: The Fugitive Horse Player (1946-05-17)
plotSynopsis: A bank embezzler and a confidence-man associate head for the racetrack, where greed and a double-cross help federal agents close the net.

title: The Homicide Hideout (1946-05-24)
plotSynopsis: A wounded bank robber seeks refuge at a remote farmhouse, where lies and violence turn the hideout into another murder case.

title: The Slaughterhouse Swindlers (1946-05-31)
plotSynopsis: Two thieves pose as agricultural inspectors to steal livestock from farmers until their interstate racket attracts FBI attention.

title: The Sinister Lighthouse (1946-06-07)
plotSynopsis: A veteran and his wife encounter a kidnapping during a second honeymoon near a lighthouse and become unexpected pieces in the Bureau's case.

title: Flowers for the Corpse (1946-06-14)
plotSynopsis: Held by violent jewel fences, an FBI agent uses his knowledge of flowers to leave colleagues a subtle clue to his location.

title: The Friendly Killers (1946-06-21)
plotSynopsis: A respectable-looking married couple marks an anniversary with a major bond theft, only for betrayal and murder to fracture their criminal partnership.

title: The Surplus Swindle (1946-06-28)
plotSynopsis: Federal agents pursue a versatile pair of con artists whose surplus-property swindles rely on uniforms and false official identities.

title: The Sinister Shakedown (1946-07-05)
plotSynopsis: A blackmail threat against a prominent family escalates into murder and leads the FBI into a carefully organized shakedown scheme.

title: Death in the Tropics (1946-07-12)
plotSynopsis: A criminal tries to fake his own death and dispose of his partners, but a chain of double-crosses in the tropics brings the Bureau into the case.

title: The Walkie-Talkie Stick-Up (1946-07-19)
plotSynopsis: Two young robbers coordinate crimes with walkie-talkies while an unsuspecting technically minded brother unknowingly helps their operation.

title: The Sinister Witness (1946-07-26)
plotSynopsis: A department-store executive convinced he caused a fatal hit-and-run becomes prey for a blackmailer, and the FBI must separate guilt from deception.

title: The Would Be Movie Star (1946-08-02)
plotSynopsis: A mother's obsession with making her baby a movie star pushes her and her sister into a supermarket robbery and an FBI investigation.

title: Lady of Larceny (1946-08-09)
plotSynopsis: A mother-and-son criminal team expands from a prison break into check forgery, leaving federal agents to track their increasingly reckless crimes.

title: The Friendly Hitchhiker (1946-08-16)
plotSynopsis: A parolee posing as a friendly hitchhiker pulls an unsuspecting traveler into a jewel-related criminal plot that turns deadly.

title: The Careless Kidnapper (1946-08-23)
plotSynopsis: Three kidnappers seize a well-known trumpeter for ransom, and the FBI races to find the celebrity before the gang can disappear.

title: The Return of the Mob (1946-08-30)
plotSynopsis: A newly released mob boss returns to reclaim his old territory, touching off renewed organized crime and a violent struggle for power.

title: Murder on the Range (1946-09-06)
plotSynopsis: A struggling roadside-diner owner is drawn into cattle rustling by his wife and an ex-convict, and the scheme collapses into betrayal and murder.

title: Death for a Draft Dodger (1946-09-13)
plotSynopsis: The FBI pursues a bogus doctor whose dangerous treatments are sold to young men trying to evade military service.

title: The Diamond Studded Double-Cross (1946-09-20)
plotSynopsis: A jewel robbery leads to a murder frame-up in which a criminal son and his mother try to pin the killing on a victim suffering from amnesia.

title: The Night of Terror (1946-09-27)
plotSynopsis: A vacation romance with a racketeer turns into a terrifying night of revenge and flight, drawing the FBI into the pursuit.

title: The Curious Coin Collector (1946-10-04)
plotSynopsis: An escaped Nazi prisoner tries to revive an old American spy network, leaving murder and betrayal in his wake as the Bureau investigates.

title: The Sugar Swindler (1946-10-11)
plotSynopsis: A young couple is drawn into a phony sugar investment by a polished confidence man, and the deal ends in betrayal and an interstate chase.

title: The Big Shakedown (1946-10-18)
plotSynopsis: A politician is blackmailed over a hidden piece of his past, leading the FBI to a sophisticated extortion operation.

title: The Honest Embezzler (1946-10-25)
plotSynopsis: An agent goes undercover at a carnival to investigate the suspicious death of a quiet former embezzler that local authorities had treated as suicide.

title: Blueprint for Murder (1946-11-01)
plotSynopsis: A civic-minded man challenging corruption is kidnapped by a ruthless contractor, forcing the FBI to race to uncover the scheme and save him.

title: The Frightened Fugitive (1946-11-08)
plotSynopsis: Two high-school boys panic after a hit-and-run and flee, allowing one bad decision to grow into a broader interstate delinquency case.

title: Murder by Accident (1946-11-15)
plotSynopsis: A hijacking investigation uncovers a deadly double-cross centered on an elderly farm couple and a fortune in stolen liquor.

title: The Return of the Killer (1946-11-22)
plotSynopsis: An escaped criminal launches a revenge campaign while trying to recover hidden loot, producing a violent FBI manhunt.

title: Danger in the Jury Box (1946-11-29)
plotSynopsis: A juror and his family are threatened by criminals determined to influence the outcome of a major trial.

title: Operation Rhumba (1946-12-06)
plotSynopsis: Axis agents target an American chemist working on a secret wartime project in South America, forcing the FBI into a counterespionage operation.

title: The Swampland Killer (1946-12-13)
plotSynopsis: Federal agents chase a killer and his sister through dangerous swampland after a salvage venture ends in murder.

title: The Swindling Swami (1946-12-20)
plotSynopsis: A fortune-telling confidence man plans to marry a wealthy widow for her money, but the FBI begins exposing the fraud behind his spiritual act.

title: Little Tough Guy (1946-12-27)
plotSynopsis: A warehouse robbery reveals a juvenile helper trapped between professional thieves and the law.

title: The Fugitive Guest (1947-01-03)
plotSynopsis: An escaped convict takes refuge with an isolated farmer and his ailing wife, creating a tense standoff as FBI agents approach.

title: The Souvenir Gun (1947-01-10)
plotSynopsis: A criminal uses a German wartime pistol in a succession of robberies, leaving a distinctive trail for federal investigators.

title: The Sunshine Swindlers (1947-01-17)
plotSynopsis: A jewel-theft gang splinters over an internal double-cross, sending the FBI on a nationwide hunt for the surviving thieves.

title: The Bow Tie Murders (1947-01-24)
plotSynopsis: The FBI races to stop a serial murderer responsible for a disturbing series of killings marked by bow ties.

title: The Baby Big Shot (1947-01-31)
plotSynopsis: An ambitious teenager stages his own kidnapping to impress a gang leader, accidentally turning his stunt into a real federal case.

title: Hijackers Incorporated (1947-02-07)
plotSynopsis: Agents investigate a large hijacking organization run by a ruthless businessman, uncovering stolen merchandise, betrayal and murder.

title: Death in the Desert (1947-02-14)
plotSynopsis: Bank robbers strand an innocent couple as hostages in the desert, where a small clue helps the FBI trace the fugitives.

title: Old Lady Larceny (1947-02-21)
plotSynopsis: An elderly couple turns to crime after a job loss and becomes entangled with a notorious check forger before the FBI catches up.

title: The Innocent Thief (1947-02-28)
plotSynopsis: A comedian is framed for both jewel theft and murder, and federal agents must clear him before the real thieves escape.

title: The Divorced Child (1947-03-07)
plotSynopsis: A girl's parents' divorce pushes her toward a reckless crowd, stolen cars and a gas-station holdup that draws federal attention.

title: The Fugitive Pirate (1947-03-14)
plotSynopsis: A jewel thief takes a sponge diver and his wife hostage to recover loot hidden underwater, sending agents through Florida's coastal and swamp country.

title: The Vicious Shakedown (1947-03-21)
plotSynopsis: A man's drunken blackout is exploited in a fake-marriage blackmail scheme, and his attempt to handle the extortion alone brings in the FBI.

title: The Henpecked Thief (1947-03-28)
plotSynopsis: A thief planning one major score is betrayed by his partner, sending his family and federal agents toward a racetrack showdown.

title: The Used Baby Racket (1947-04-04)
plotSynopsis: A mother and her brother repeatedly sell the same infant and reclaim the child through impersonation, creating a cruel interstate baby racket.

title: The Curious Patient (1947-04-11)
plotSynopsis: A wounded fugitive and his partners abduct a doctor to recover buried loot, but mistrust inside the gang and the FBI both close in.

title: The Juvenile Shakedown (1947-04-18)
plotSynopsis: A freight-train robbery leads agents to an adult criminal who has been recruiting teenage boys to carry out his schemes.

title: The Unfortunate Daughter (1947-04-25)
plotSynopsis: A socialite's secret connection to her gangster father becomes leverage for criminals who blackmail her into aiding their escape.

title: The Henpecked Swindler (1947-05-02)
plotSynopsis: Two swindling couples target each other at the same time, and their competing confidence games draw the Bureau into the confusion.

title: The Wayward Brothers (1947-05-09)
plotSynopsis: After a young couple survives a desert plane crash, two criminal brothers seize them and turn the accident into a kidnapping and extortion plot.

title: The Professional Killer (1947-05-16)
plotSynopsis: A bank robber and his associates turn on one another over stolen money, giving the FBI a path into a deadly criminal partnership.

title: The Reluctant Thief (1947-05-23)
plotSynopsis: A domineering criminal mother forces both of her sons into a major robbery, including one son who wants no part of the family trade.

title: The Frustrated Mice (1947-05-30)
plotSynopsis: The FBI races to rescue a kidnapped socialite as her increasingly unstable captors struggle with panic, greed and the ransom money.

title: The Fugitive Traveler (1947-06-06)
plotSynopsis: A restless farm girl shelters a wounded federal fugitive and becomes caught up in his plans to keep running from the law.

title: The Curious Cameraman (1947-06-13)
plotSynopsis: A carefully planned payroll robbery unravels after an unexpected accident, leaving federal agents to reconstruct the heist and pursue the gang.

title: The Horoscope Homicide (1947-06-20)
