plotSynopsis: Joe and his partners sabotage a mountain logging flume with a heavy iron brake that throws valuable logs into the gorge so they can steal from old man Moller's operation, shooting at anyone who gets too close, but Cisco and Pancho expose the sabotage, capture the gang, and remove the brake so the logs can run normally again.

title: The Mummy of the Desert (1953-04-21)
plotSynopsis: A Chicago archaeologist and his daughter travel to the Mojave Desert to examine a supposedly Egyptian mummy planted by con men, but when jewels are discovered in the mummy case the swindlers try to seize the treasure and Cisco and Pancho become caught in the scheme.

title: The Tenderfoot (1953-04-28)
plotSynopsis: Cisco fulfills a promise to old prospector Shag Miller by leading his spoiled city-bred grandson Morgan and sister Daisy through a riddle pointing to Shag's lost gold mine; when two crooks kidnap and beat Morgan for the secret, Cisco and Pancho rescue him, locate the mine, and decide the gold should wait while Morgan proves himself by taking ranch work.

title: Wreck of Old 13 (1953-04-30)
plotSynopsis: A gang plots to kidnap a railroad executive for ransom aboard the supposedly unlucky Old 13, and when his daughter mistakes Cisco and Pancho for the outlaws, the rescue becomes even more dangerous as Pancho winds up at the controls of the runaway train.

title: The Dude (1953-05-12)
plotSynopsis: Cisco and Pancho defend a soft-spoken newcomer who finally strikes gold, then face a theft frame-up and a lynch-minded mining camp while the greedy claim jumpers move to seize his land.

title: Night Before the Fair (1953-05-14)
plotSynopsis: Rancher Will Strong hires Jarvis and Parks to sabotage the county fair and assault manager Lou Appleton, but after the thugs knock Cisco and Pancho unconscious and cut loose the fair balloon, Cisco uses the balloon's gas and ballast to survive, returns to the grounds, saves Appleton from being dragged by a rope, and forces the saboteurs to help make the fair a success.

title: The Cattlemans War (1953-05-26)
plotSynopsis: A feud between rival cattlemen escalates as both sides hire gunmen, drawing Cisco and Pancho into the conflict and forcing Cisco to act as sheriff while trying to prevent the dispute from turning into open war.

title: Contraband (1953-05-28)
plotSynopsis: Smugglers Jack Horner, Moses Mill, and storekeeper John Riddland use muzzled burros to move contraband across the border and murder old Cottonwood Brown when he interferes, framing Cisco and Pancho; Cisco follows the burro tracks, proves the smuggling route to the sheriff, captures Horner and Mill, and tricks one criminal into exposing the murder.

title: The Rustlers (1953-06-02)
plotSynopsis: Cattleman Jake Sandoval orders the murder of young Indian Mato and tries to blame local tribes for a rustling operation, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the frame-up, bring the skeptical sheriff to witness the thefts, and capture Sandoval's gang.

title: The Golden Slugs of Rainbow Falls (1953-06-04)
plotSynopsis: Cisco and Pancho arrive at a mining camp already simmering with trouble, where robbery and murder force Cisco to follow the clues behind the violence.

title: The Trail of the Blood Red Sun (1953-06-09)
sortKey: 0|1953-06-09|99999|the trail of the blood red sun (1953-06-09)
plotSynopsis: As a vast locust swarm threatens a frontier community, bitter farmer Frank blames Dr. Anderson for his troubles and becomes violently delusional, shooting the doctor and setting fire to the house; Cisco and Pancho subdue him, and an extraordinary flock of seagulls arrives to devour the locusts, saving the crops and helping restore Frank's perspective.

title: The Duel (1953-06-11)
plotSynopsis: With George Wayne facing execution for a bank-guard murder he did not commit, Cisco traces the real criminals to a storekeeper called the Duke, deliberately accepts the Duke's rapier challenge before young Joe Austin can fight him, defeats him in the duel, forces the truth about the robbery and killing into the open, and gets word to the governor in time for Wayne to be reprieved.

title: The Saga of Morbid Jones (1953-06-16)
plotSynopsis: A new law will cost Morbid Jones his mineral-rich mountain claim unless it is reopened and worked by midnight, so Dan Ryan and an accomplice wait through a blizzard to seize it and shoot anyone who interferes; Cisco and Pancho survive the ambush, rescue Morbid from the plot, and get him back to the claim in time to preserve his ownership.

title: Blazing Guns at Lone Bend (1953-06-18)
plotSynopsis: Hotheaded cattleman Bud Cushman tries to turn the Long Bend dispute between cattlemen and nesters into open war, murdering nester Bob Black and pushing both sides toward bloodshed; after Cisco and Pancho are captured and nearly hanged, Cisco defeats Cushman and the dead man's diamond ring found in Cushman's pocket exposes him as the killer, allowing the two factions to agree to settle their differences peacefully.

Released outlaw Gus Benz returns to Lucifer to murder the jurors who convicted him, leaving 3-7-77 grave-dimension tags on his victims and targeting crippled Larry Lincoln as well as Cisco, but Cisco escapes Benz's trap, runs him down on Diablo, prevents a lynching, and turns him over to the law.

title: Devil Town (1953-06-25)
plotSynopsis: Outlaw boss Sawyer Benson terrorizes the aptly named Devil Town and tries to force Prudence Kerry off her ranch, but Cisco and Pancho break his hold on the settlement, force Benson to confess, and help the marshal arrest his gang so Prudence can keep her property in peace.

title: Dynamite in the Blue Chip Mine (1953-06-30)
plotSynopsis: Crooked gambler Braley alters Grayson's IOUs, cheats him out of the Blue Chip Mine, and kills him when the fraud is challenged, but Cisco proves the notes were changed, links the deception to Braley, and wins a confession that restores the mine to Grayson's daughter.

title: Hoodoo Driver (1953-07-02)
plotSynopsis: Rancher Blake Lee ambushes a mountain stage in an attempt to kill Cisco and stage driver Bo Whip, then leaves Cisco under suspicion for Whip's murder, but Cisco traces the gun evidence to Lee and his accomplice, captures them, and clears his own name.

title: Prophet of Boot Hill (1953-07-07)
plotSynopsis: Two bank robbers hide their stolen gold beneath the floor of the eccentric old 'prophet' who lives near Boot Hill, then return and kill him when they fear he can expose them, leaving Cisco and Pancho briefly under suspicion until Cisco recovers the loot and the criminals betray one another and reveal the truth.

title: The Golden Bullet (1953-07-09)
plotSynopsis: Recently released outlaw Rex hunts the lost gold of a massacred forty-niner wagon train after learning his foster father, Colonel Benson, has found it, murdering Benson and later turning on his own accomplice, but Cisco survives Rex's attempts to eliminate him, recovers the treasure, and sends Rex back to justice.

title: Gun War at Oak Pass (1953-07-14)
plotSynopsis: Escaped killer Chuck Madrone has driven the Daggett family from its ranch and terrorized the town around Oak Pass, then returns with his gang to kill Joe Daggett and Cisco; Cisco and Pancho organize a handful of riders, trap the outlaws at the pass, capture Madrone for the law, and restore the Daggetts to their home.

title: The Seven Devils (1953-07-16)
plotSynopsis: Lawyer Brad Kellman and ranch foreman Rick Corson plan to kill Stella's elderly relative during a cowboy masquerade, using identical devil costumes and a staged fire to conceal their movements so they can profit from his will, but Cisco breaks through the costume alibis and exposes the pair before the inheritance plot can succeed.

title: The 5000 Reward (1953-07-21)
plotSynopsis: Former stage guard John Tully, crippled during a robbery five years earlier in which his driver was killed and $5,000 stolen, gets a chance to ride the same route again after Cisco identifies the old robbers by a distinctive white scar and secretly arranges a trap that lets Tully face them and recover justice.

title: The Hondo Boys (1953-07-23)
plotSynopsis: The feared Hondo brothers, Ben and Smoky, terrorize Mesa after two of their men are jailed, burning the jail and threatening anyone who resists them, but Cisco and Pancho protect young Jerry and his grandfather, survive the gang's attacks, and help state troopers round up the Hondo outfit without allowing vigilante revenge.

title: The Mad Woman of Desolation House (1953-08-18)
plotSynopsis: After an eccentric old woman takes a young girl, Cisco joins the sheriff's search and begins to suspect that the apparent kidnapper may not be the true danger.

title: The Key of Death (1953-08-20)
plotSynopsis: Rancher Kayler schemes to wreck a cattle train so debtor Donlin cannot make his payment and Kayler can seize the ranch, murdering a telegraph operator for the switch key, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the sabotage, prove the killing with a torn neckerchief, and force Kayler to confess and grant Donlin an extension.

title: Renegade (1953-09-01)
plotSynopsis: Army deserter Todd Hollison leads a band of Mescalero Apaches in a campaign of revenge against Major Reynolds and his friends, marking each attack with a taunting arrow, but Cisco and Pancho help the fort break the renegade's hold over the raiders and capture Hollison.

title: The Railroad War (1953-09-03)
plotSynopsis: Powerful landowner Burke Meadows tries to stop a railroad from crossing his territory by seizing adjoining land and using hired gunmen against the construction crew, but Cisco and Pancho turn the tables on Meadows and end the short, violent railroad war.

title: Black Jack Larue (1953-09-10)
plotSynopsis: Black Jack LaRue's scheming lieutenant deliberately pits the outlaw chief against Cisco, kills a deputy and helps imprison Cisco and Pancho, then tries to manipulate and betray his own gang, but Cisco escapes, survives a dynamite threat, and breaks up the outfit.

title: Gunplay on the Riverfront (1953-09-17)
plotSynopsis: Cold-eyed gunman Count Steerland tries to seize a settler's valuable riverfront claim by force, attacking the father and putting his young son in deadly danger on the river, but Cisco and Pancho rescue the family, defeat Steerland's gang, and help the wounded settler rebuild.

title: The Red-headed Cowpoke (1953-09-29)
plotSynopsis: Cattle rustler Big Ed Boland tries to remove young cowpoke Red Mallory by making him jealous of Cisco over Daisy, hoping one man will kill the other; when that fails Boland moves directly against Red, but Cisco exposes the frame-up and the rustling plot.

title: His Honor the Killer (1953-10-01)
plotSynopsis: Mayor George Harley secretly murders each new town marshal as revenge for the lawman who once sent him to prison, but Cisco recognizes the mayor's prison-bred habits, escapes captivity, and exposes Harley as the killer behind Black Rock's string of deaths.

title: Law of the Forty-four (1953-10-06)
plotSynopsis: Two bullying gunmen terrorize the countryside and target Cisco, Pancho, and their friends during a community dance, leaving Cisco to survive gunfire and a burning cabin before turning the tables on them.

title: Planted Gold (1953-10-08)
plotSynopsis: Two crooks plant gold-bearing rocks on worthless land and imprison honest broker Sam Morland so they can swindle a visiting couple into buying the property, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the planted evidence and stop the sale.

title: The Red Demon (1953-10-13)
plotSynopsis: A pair of crooked brick salesmen secretly set fires to create new business, and Cisco must clear his own name, unite rival fire companies, and expose the arsonists before more homes burn.

title: Masquerade (1953-10-15)
plotSynopsis: Two cowhands disguise themselves as Cisco and Pancho to rob a stagecoach and bury the stolen money with their costumes, leaving the real pair blamed for the crime until Cisco finds the hidden clothes and forces the impostors' scheme into the open.

title: Frontier Justice (1953-10-27)
plotSynopsis: Bank president Sim Condon murders his cashier to conceal a large shortage caused by gambling debts and frames an innocent man for the crime, but Cisco uses the bank books and ballistic evidence to expose the embezzlement and force Condon to confess.

title: The Battle of the Border (1953-10-29)
plotSynopsis: Outlaw Global Cain uses a border-river technicality to operate from a criminal stronghold beyond the reach of American law and even steals Cisco's horse, but Cisco joins the border rangers against the gang and a change in the river channel finally leaves Cain standing on United States soil where he can be arrested.

title: The Double (1953-11-03)
plotSynopsis: A crooked lawyer and his partners recruit a man who closely resembles Cisco to impersonate him, take control of a dying rancher's property held in trust for daughter Madge, and kill the real Cisco, but the imposture collapses when Cisco survives and exposes the double.

title: To Uphold the Law (1953-11-05)
plotSynopsis: After the Conway brothers are sprung from custody in a deadly ambush, Cisco and Pancho help the wounded law track the gang and expose Mosch Arnold, a seemingly respectable drifter who hides a career of robbery and murder behind outlaw allies.

title: The Blacksmith (1953-11-12)
plotSynopsis: Outlaws Earl and Curly prey on gullible blacksmith Jeddy Beecher, flattering him into helping their schemes and trying to make him the fall guy for a bank robbery, but Cisco recognizes the manipulation and stops the brothers before Jeddy crosses the line into serious crime.

title: Posse of Killers (1953-11-24)
plotSynopsis: During a silver boom in Rockledge, cafe owner Rip Mears hires gunmen and coerces a claims agent into backdating a claim over the town's main street so he can seize valuable property, but Cisco breaks up his posse of killers and exposes the fraudulent land grab.

title: Murder at Ten Below (1953-11-26)
plotSynopsis: Two killers stretch a wire across a snowy mountain mail route to murder a ski courier carrying valuable diamonds, but Cisco and Pancho brave the brutal Ten Below country, uncover the trap, and bring the robbers down before they can escape with the loot.

title: Pattern of Crime (1953-12-08)
plotSynopsis: A group of outlaws gathers around a plan to steal a cache of diamonds just as Cisco and Pancho ride toward Cottonwood and into the developing robbery scheme.

title: The Killer Stallion (1953-12-10)
plotSynopsis: A wealthy smuggler covets a prized stallion and resorts to intimidation, theft and murder to get the horse, but Cisco and Pancho stand with the ranch family, track the criminals toward the border, and break up the gang before the stallion can be taken.

title: The Cayote Pup (1953-12-15)
plotSynopsis: Big Jake Griggs murders a settler to steal his lush, well-watered ranch and sends a henchman after the owner's young son, but the boy escapes into the brush; Cisco and Pancho protect the child, expose Griggs' land grab, and restore the ranch to safety.

title: The Boxcar Bandits (1953-12-17)
plotSynopsis: Bank robbers Max Benson and Matt Swain use freight boxcars as mobile hideouts, timing their daylight robberies around train stops so they can escape unseen, but Cisco recognizes the pattern, tracks them back to the railroad, and ends their run of robberies.

title: Valley of Killers (1953-12-22)
plotSynopsis: The Cullen gang rules a hidden canyon known as the Valley of Killers and rides into River Bend to murder two men who shot one of their outlaws in self-defense, but Cisco and Pancho help the frightened town resist, break the gang's power, and make the valley safe.

title: Dude Bandit (1953-12-24)
plotSynopsis: Respectable-looking rancher Heck Dover is secretly the Dude Bandit, using fancy clothes and strong perfume to create a misleading outlaw identity while he and Waldo Dane rob stages and commit murder, but Cisco follows the perfume clue to Dover's home, recovers the stolen money, and turns both men over to the sheriff.

title: Guns in the Rain (1953-12-29)
plotSynopsis: Seeking shelter from a driving rain, Cisco and Pancho unknowingly enter the hideout of Pose Wyman's outlaw gang and are trapped upstairs while the killers try to burn them out with black-powder bombs, but they escape through the weakened roof, defeat the gang, and help a young recruit face his punishment and choose a better life afterward.

title: The Great Land Rush (1953-12-31)
plotSynopsis: Land speculator Jim Ruford hires Sanders and Ridge to murder Olson and eliminate his nephew Tom Crisp so Ruford can file a false claim on Olson's strategically valuable property during the Sagebrush Valley land rush, while arranging for Cisco to take the blame; Cisco escapes the frame-up, protects Tom, exposes the hired killers and Ruford's scheme, and stops the fraudulent claim before it can succeed.

title: Sniffer Smith (1954-01-12)
plotSynopsis: Jeb 'Sniffer' Smith and Bar Morris rob a stage carrying gold, kill the guard, and later eliminate a wounded witness, but Cisco notices evidence that one robber was injured and traces the clue back to Smith's constant visits for medicine; after the outlaws attack Cisco and the sheriff, Pancho exploits Smith's hypochondria with a well-timed sneeze and panic forces the truth out before both men are jailed.

title: Riders in the Night (1954-01-14)
plotSynopsis: Crooked rancher Mace Spangler tries to seize John Middleton's ranch after the county records burn by sending men to steal Middleton's canceled mortgage and payment receipts, leaving him without proof that the debt was paid; Cisco and Pancho uncover the theft, recover the canceled note, defeat Spangler and his riders, and return the evidence that secures Middleton's ranch.

title: Avalanche and Morbid Jones (1954-01-19)
plotSynopsis: Carter and Norton follow lucky prospector Morbid Jones into the mountains and use dynamite to trigger avalanches intended to bury Morbid and his wife so they can take over his gold claim in the spring; Cisco and Pancho become trapped in the snowbound cabin with the Joneses, survive the gunfire and repeated slides, and defeat the plot before the claim can be stolen.

title: Son of the Chief (1954-01-21)
plotSynopsis: Former cavalryman Magoon Fraley seeks revenge on retired Colonel Duncan by rustling his cattle and planting evidence to blame Sioux chief Swift Antelope, while hiding the fact that years earlier he kidnapped Duncan's young son and left the boy to be raised among the Sioux; Cisco exposes Fraley's scheme, captures him, reveals that Swift Antelope's adopted son Billy is Duncan's missing child, and helps end the old feud without forcing the boy to abandon the chief who raised him.

title: Claim Jumpers (1954-01-26)
plotSynopsis: Dishonest assayer Ed Jessop falsely tells prospector Sam Fowler that his rich claim is worthless, then has honest assayer Reid Colby killed when Colby refuses to support the fraud and frames Cisco, Pancho, and Fowler for the murder; Cisco finds Colby's body, uses the forged note, gun-butt evidence, and Fowler's stolen ore samples to expose Jessop and his partner and preserve Fowler's valuable strike.

title: Beyond the Frontier (1954-01-28)
plotSynopsis: Notorious outlaw Monty Talon massacres travelers crossing the remote Saucer country and captures Cisco, Pancho, and a marshal, even offering Cisco a place in his gang before threatening to kill them when Cisco refuses; Cisco escapes the trap, helps free the prisoners, captures Talon, and leads the law against the leaderless gang so the frontier route can be used safely again.

title: Phantom Bandits (1954-02-02)
plotSynopsis: Bank robbers Leo Planey and Mel Pollard stay ahead of the law because Dolly, secretly Planey's wife, works near the sheriff's office and warns them whenever a posse is coming; when Pancho becomes acting sheriff and closes in, Dolly helps the outlaws ambush Cisco, but Cisco and Pancho survive the betrayal, capture Planey and Pollard, and uncover Dolly's role in the phantom bandit operation.

title: Cisco Takes the Trail (1954-02-04)
plotSynopsis: Two of Mark McDonald's former prospecting partners kidnap him in hopes of forcing him to reveal a valuable mine map and later capture Pancho and Mark's young son when they interfere, but Cisco follows the trail to the hideout, frees the captives, and sends the kidnappers to jail.

title: When Six Guns Speak (1954-02-09)
plotSynopsis: Wealthy merchant Norwell Kane hires gunman Dutch Freeman and his men to drive competing storekeepers Dave and Minnie Wayland out of Remrock, but Cisco and Pancho break the intimidation scheme, force the compromised sheriff out, and leave Dave as acting sheriff with Kane warned against further trouble.

title: Golden Anvil (1954-02-11)
plotSynopsis: Outlaws learn that an old rancher is carrying a gold shipment to his nephew and move to steal it, but after the rancher is murdered Cisco discovers the fortune was hidden in plain sight as a small black-painted anvil made of solid gold and helps the sheriff send the killers to jail.

title: Lady Sheriff of Sandy Gulch (1954-02-16)
plotSynopsis: Badger Jones and Coolfoot Snyder ambush a stage expecting to steal a male sheriff's jail keys and free outlaw Jeff Dalton, only to discover that Sandy Gulch's sheriff is the formidable Patricia Perkins, and Cisco and Pancho help her survive the gang's traps, stop Dalton's escape, and return the outlaws to custody.

title: Jail Rush (1954-02-18)
plotSynopsis: A protection gang forces county ranchers to pay tribute or lose their cattle, and after one rancher is murdered the leader is jailed just as an angry lynch mob arrives and the gang attacks to free him, but Cisco prevents both the lynching and the jailbreak, breaks the extortion ring, and leaves an honest rancher serving as acting sheriff.

title: Cross Examination (1954-03-02)
plotSynopsis: Sam Dublin kills John Smedley and frames John's brother Pete so that a relative can inherit the Smedley property and sell it to him, but Cisco interrupts Pete's trial, proves the fatal bullet came from Dublin's uncommon .44-40 rifle rather than Pete's revolver, and exposes the scheme in court.

title: The Law at Rocky Creek (1954-03-04)
plotSynopsis: Banker Jordan secretly runs an open cattle-rustling operation in Rocky Creek, using Joe Dodd and other gunmen to steal Fleming's herd and intimidate anyone who resists, but Cisco traces the cattle to Jordan's ranch, gathers the missing evidence, and stops Jordan as he tries to force Fleming to sign a false paid-in-full receipt.

title: Shoot to Kill (1954-03-23)
plotSynopsis: Bitter cowboy Carlos Blake pressures young Ricky Hart into robbing and murdering storekeeper Tom Dustin, then the pair rob the town bank and take Pancho and Dustin's niece Sarah hostage to keep Cisco away; Cisco tracks them back to the store, breaks the siege, rescues the hostages, and stops Blake and Hart before they can escape.

title: Sheriff Phantom (1954-03-25)
plotSynopsis: Cattle rustler Joe Naral tries to ruin Sheriff Bill Fanton's reelection by hiring fast gunman Mose to provoke and kill Fanton supporter Hook Hastings, hoping the unsolved crime will turn voters against the sheriff, but Cisco and Pancho expose the scheme, help break Naral's gang, and Fanton wins the election.

title: Avalanche in Arrow Pass (1954-03-30)
plotSynopsis: Crooked railroad marshal Joe Metz and deputy Hal Shoff plan to dynamite an avalanche into Arrow Pass so a $50,000 payroll wagon must take an alternate route where they can rob it, but Cisco uncovers the diversion, recovers the payroll, and sends Metz and Shoff to jail.

title: The Return of the Laughing Bandit (1954-04-01)
plotSynopsis: The escaped Laughing Bandit returns to Great Oak country seeking revenge on Cisco, kidnaps the sheriff's son and ties him beside a rising underground lake as bait, but Cisco and Pancho reach the cave in time, rescue the prisoner, and help capture the bandit and his henchman for good.

title: Killers at Large (1954-04-06)
plotSynopsis: Two wanted killers terrorize a Pineville ranch family and flee toward lawless Sage City, where cattle rustler Blaine Billings gives them shelter, but Cisco tracks them to Billings' ranch and fights through the rustlers to bring the fugitives back to face the law.

title: Waters of the Flood (1954-04-08)
plotSynopsis: After murdering a storekeeper over ammunition, Park Sanders and Jenks Doolins hunt witness George Willard and dynamite a dam to flood his home and destroy evidence, but Cisco and Pancho survive the flood, follow the killers, rescue Willard, and deliver the pair to the sheriff.

title: The Braggart (1954-04-13)
plotSynopsis: Two bank robbers exploit local braggart Hunt Hurley by goading him into a showdown with Cisco, then shoot Hunt from hiding so Cisco will be blamed for murder while they rob the bank, but Cisco and Pancho escape the frame-up, capture the real gunmen, and clear Cisco's name.

title: To Stop a Killer (1954-04-15)
plotSynopsis: Patient killer Bud Marlon returns after years to settle an old score with rancher Ed Carson, surrounding himself with gunmen and drawing the local law into the feud, but Cisco survives Marlon's attacks, rounds up the gang, and finally delivers the wanted killer to jail.

title: Showdown at Quicksand Bend (1954-04-22)
plotSynopsis: Cattle rustlers learn Cisco is coming to investigate and deliberately direct him and Pancho toward the deadly crossing at Quicksand Bend, but the trap fails; Cisco follows the evidence back to the gang, recovers the stolen cattle, and sends the rustlers to jail.

title: The Tactless Sheriff (1954-08-03)
plotSynopsis: Cattleman Jack Alton engineers a wave of rustling, including thefts from his own herd, to discredit unpopular Sheriff Bill McCann before the election, then kidnaps McCann's daughter to force his resignation until Cisco and Pancho break the scheme and rescue her.

title: Convict Valley (1954-08-05)
plotSynopsis: The outlaw settlement of Convict Valley retaliates when newspaper editor Tom Morse urges nearby citizens to wipe out the criminal haven, but Cisco and Pancho rally the law-abiding town, rescue Morse, and help return the valley's fugitives to jail.

title: The British Come Home to Brimstone (1954-08-10)
plotSynopsis: Ranch manager Rex Parker has been stealing cattle from Pamela Havisham's inherited spread and hiding them on an isolated mesa reached through a waterfall, then plots to kill Pamela before she arrives, but Cisco foils the ambush, discovers the hidden herd, and ends Parker's scheme.

title: Outlaw Trail (1954-08-12)
plotSynopsis: Two killers flee into the Gunstock Hills after robbing a store and murdering its owner, then kill a prospector and try to stay ahead of the sheriff, but Cisco and Pancho help track them down and their own knowledge of the earlier crime betrays them.

title: Tin Horn Killer (1954-08-17)
plotSynopsis: Stage robbers manipulate a hotheaded young gunman into challenging Cisco while arranging for Cisco's revolvers to be loaded with blanks, hoping to remove the gold shipment's escort, but Cisco survives the setup, stops the robbery, and the wounded youth learns the cost of chasing a gunfighter's reputation.

title: Vengeance at Wind Rock (1954-08-19)
plotSynopsis: Larry Carson returns to Windrock from prison blaming his marshal father Frank for sending him away, and criminals exploit that bitterness in a revenge scheme, but Cisco uncovers the manipulation, Larry learns the truth, and father and son reconcile after the conspirators are jailed.

title: Trial by Tomahawk (1954-09-07)
plotSynopsis: Land speculator Jack Cogland tries to provoke a war with the Nez Perce by having his gunmen raid them in stolen U.S. cavalry uniforms and steal their horses, but Cisco survives a tomahawk trial, proves the soldiers were impostors, and wins Chief Joseph's help in exposing the false-flag scheme before it can ignite wider bloodshed.

title: The Ace of Hearts (1954-09-09)
plotSynopsis: A gunman bent on revenge against retiring Sheriff John Dixon sends ominous playing cards to Dixon and his family before moving against them one by one, but Cisco intervenes, defeats the attacker, and helps protect the sheriff's family as Dixon returns to duty.

title: Murder at the Triple S (1954-09-14)
plotSynopsis: Ruthless outlaw Roof Dunbar targets the Triple S ranch as a new base, murders the ranch hands, and plans to force owner Hannah Wesley and her visiting father to sign the spread over to him, but Cisco and Pancho rescue the family and turn Dunbar and his lieutenant over to the law.

title: Who Lives by the Six Gun (1954-09-16)
plotSynopsis: Cold-blooded killer Snake Rollins robs a store, murders its owner for sport, and hunts the surviving witness, drawing Cisco into the chase; Rollins' violent path finally turns back on him when his own outlaw associate guns him down during the final confrontation.

title: Rustlers on the Lazy D (1954-09-28)
plotSynopsis: Two trusted Lazy D cowhands secretly rustle their employer's cattle and decide Cisco must die when they learn he has been called in to investigate, but Cisco survives their attack, uncovers the inside job, and helps recover the stolen herd and expose the disloyal foreman and gunman.

title: War on the Fort (1954-09-30)
plotSynopsis: Former soldier Ned and his partner learn that Fort Harlow is concealing a payroll shipment beneath hay and organize a nighttime attack on the post, but Cisco and Pancho help Major Harlow defend the fort, recover the payroll, and capture the raiders after the brief battle.

title: Black Kerchief (1954-10-05)
plotSynopsis: Stage driver Big Mac Tulsa secretly signals his road-agent partners with a black kerchief whenever valuable cargo is aboard, helping them rob repeated gold shipments while pretending to fight back, but Cisco uncovers the signal, turns the next holdup against the gang, and helps recover the stolen gold.

title: Terror Town (1954-10-07)
plotSynopsis: Sandy Creek marshal Drew Kegel uses his badge and deadly gun skill to extort protection money from townspeople, killing anyone who resists under the pretense of self-defense, but Cisco breaks Kegel's reign of terror, forces him to repay his victims, and sends him to prison.

title: The River of No Return (1954-12-28)
plotSynopsis: Bill Fenwick follows the mysterious River of No Return to the hidden mine left by his father, only to be captured by the men who murdered the elder Fenwick and seized the mine. Cisco, Pancho, and Bill's wife Maggie enter the cavern, survive a dynamite trap, discover the river's hidden route, rescue Bill, and capture the killers.

title: The Capture of Billy Vaca (1954-12-30)
plotSynopsis: Notorious bank robber Billy Vaca and his gang raid a bank and kill the cashier, then terrorize the town while the sheriff struggles to respond. Cisco and Pancho identify the gang, defend the jail from an attempted rescue, capture Vaca's men in a final fight, and help recover most of the stolen money.

title: The Brand of the Maverick (1955-01-04)
plotSynopsis: Rustlers Nate Willes and Tim Bolin murder Hank Myers and try to steal the Myers brothers' valuable registered cattle brand by forcing county recorder Morgan Myers to transfer it into their name, while manipulating the sheriff into treating Cisco and Pancho as the outlaws; Cisco turns the mistake around, exposes the real rustlers, and preserves the Myers brand and cattle.

title: Rodeo at Calico Corners (1955-01-11)
plotSynopsis: Rodeo-following bank robbers Bryce Tabor and Cannon Roy plan to hit Calico Corners while Sheriff Gordon is distracted showing his prized horse Baby, then hide among the beard-growing contestants after the alarm is raised; Cisco and Pancho survive the pair's ambush at the bank, chase them through the rodeo grounds, capture them, and recover the bank while Baby still wins her prize.

title: Murder Wagon (1955-01-13)
plotSynopsis: Freight haulers Jesse Post and Pierre Doolack murder isolated ranch families, burn their homes, and load the victims' furniture and valuables into a 'murder wagon' for resale; sent by the territorial marshal to investigate the string of deadly ranch fires, Cisco and Pancho survive the killers' ambush, turn the trap against them, and expose the robbery-murder scheme.

title: The Voice of the .44 (1955-01-18)
plotSynopsis: Red Toomey and his gang ride into Mesquite planning to take over the town, and Cisco helps the elderly marshal arrest Toomey. The gang forces blacksmith Mike Werfel into helping with a jailbreak, but Cisco turns the scheme against them, jails the gang, then rides after Toomey when he threatens the marshal at his ranch and defeats the outlaw in a final showdown.

title: Heritage of Death (1955-01-20)
plotSynopsis: Arthur Dobson, guardian of young Bobby Hargis, will inherit the boy's large ranch if Bobby dies, so he hires foreman Kirby Lawson to arrange a fatal 'accident'; Lawson frightens the horses at a flooded bridge and sends Bobby into the raging river, but Cisco rescues the boy, defeats Lawson, and sends both conspirators to jail while Bobby remains on the ranch with the Robertsons.

title: Gold at Bitter Creek (1955-01-25)
plotSynopsis: Mel Clemens and Adler Ferris discover gold in Bitter Creek but cannot claim it because the land belongs to the townspeople, so they fake a richer strike elsewhere and lure nearly the whole town away; Cisco and Pancho arrive to find Bitter Creek deserted, survive the outlaws' gunfire, rescue the wounded sheriff, and force the pair to confess before the residents return to share in their own gold.

title: The Cattle Train (1955-01-27)
plotSynopsis: Cattle king Barney Rankin tries to destroy smaller rancher John Sawyer for competing for railroad space, first having Sawyer and Ed Beale beaten and then ordering gunman Mose Dillon to uncouple Sawyer's loaded cattle car on a grade; Cisco and Pancho race to stop the runaway car before it collides with an express train, then bring Rankin and his men to justice for assault and attempted murder.

title: Murder at Pine Creek (1955-02-01)
plotSynopsis: Broke outlaws Nolan Kane and Bert Morrow learn that Ira and Tom Nesbit keep their gold and savings outside the bank, murder Ira, and ransack his cabin while trying to establish an alibi that points suspicion toward Cisco and Pancho; Cisco anticipates that the killers will return for the hidden money, traps them at the cabin, and clears himself when the pair confess to the murder.

title: The Midget of Broken Spur (1955-02-03)
plotSynopsis: A tiny outlaw called Little Sam mails himself aboard a train, robs the mail car of a large gold shipment, and leaves Cisco and Pancho under suspicion for the crime, but they uncover his scheme, capture Sam and his accomplices, and recover the stolen railroad money.

title: Gun War in the Mountains (1955-02-10)
plotSynopsis: Bank robber Mike Fora uses tracker Moss Wigan to mislead a sheriff's posse in the Black Mountains while his gang prepares an ambush, but Cisco and Pancho outmaneuver the outlaws, capture Fora and his chief men, catch Wigan trying to steal the loot for himself, and recover the bank's gold.

title: The Manhunt (1955-03-03)
plotSynopsis: Outlaw Scott Clemons escapes the Arizona territorial penitentiary determined to kill Cisco, setting off a hard pursuit complicated by a young boy who initially mistakes Cisco for the fugitive, but Cisco and Pancho stay on the trail until Clemons is stopped and the boy learns the truth.

title: Murder at Red Clay Bend (1955-03-10)
plotSynopsis: Banker Blake Duncan secretly runs an outlaw gang and tries to frame his nephew Jim for a stage robbery and murder by planting Jim's glove at Red Clay Bend so Duncan can profit from the boy's removal, but Cisco spots the planted evidence, follows the red-clay clue to Duncan's henchman, and exposes the entire scheme.

title: A Trap of Many Teeth (1955-03-15)
plotSynopsis: Smooth bank robber Randolph Meeker poses as a harmless writer, arranges a stage robbery in which the driver and guard are killed, and frames Cisco and Pancho for the crime to keep the law occupied while his partners move against the Silver City bank, but Cisco recognizes the setup and turns Meeker's elaborate trap back on the gang.

title: Dynamite on the Right of Way (1955-03-17)
plotSynopsis: Land speculator Wally Moran buys up the railroad's planned route through Gopher Valley and then tries to sabotage the alternate right-of-way so the company will be forced to pay his inflated price, but Cisco and Pancho expose the scheme, protect the railroad men, and stop Moran's gang before the project can be wrecked.

title: The Gun Slinger (1955-03-22)
plotSynopsis: Jack Cole and Mel Droun murder a young man and cultivate suspicion that Cisco was responsible, sending deadly gunslinger Hub Ferris after him for revenge, but Cisco defeats Ferris without killing him and then exposes Cole and Droun as the real killers when their attempt to finish the frame-up collapses.

title: A Party for Sheriff Fanton (1955-03-25)
plotSynopsis: Mad composer Gregory Macey can only find inspiration through violence and murder, so he captures Pancho and invites Cisco, Sheriff Fanton, and stage passenger Felicity Spring to his isolated mansion as intended victims for the climax of his concerto; Cisco uses Macey's vanity about his music to get close enough to strike, turns the gunmen against their leader, and helps the sheriff end the murder plot.

title: A Medal for Markmanship (1955-04-26)
plotSynopsis: Mine owner Carl Monroe plots to destroy the Fair Friday mine and eliminate his partner Chris Mitchell, using a silver marksmanship medal to identify the hired gunman who is to receive dynamite plans hidden in a box-supper sandwich, but Cisco uncovers the arrangement, breaks up the gang, and sends the gunman to jail.

title: The Hot Headed Sheepherder (1955-05-05)
plotSynopsis: Hot-tempered sheepherder Blinker McKay is trying to control his anger so postmistress Mona will marry him when criminals discover gold connected to the ground where his sheep have been grazing and try to force the location from him, but Cisco and Pancho defeat the gang while Blinker struggles to keep his temper in check.

title: The Hour of Terror (1955-05-12)
plotSynopsis: A Buckthorn mob prepares to lynch Joe Love before he can stand trial for a killing, even threatening the sheriff who protects him, but Cisco faces down the ringleaders, breaks the mob's momentum, and insists that Joe be judged by law; Joe is later tried and acquitted.

title: Dead Mans Gold (1955-08-18)
plotSynopsis: Prospector Fred Gates discovers a rich strike and offers to share it with fugitive Harold Alpine, who shoots him and leaves him for dead; Cisco secretly saves Fred and uses the supposed death to trap Alpine and murderous blacksmith Jory Goodell, whose own past crimes are also exposed.

title: Law of the Dead (1955-08-23)
plotSynopsis: A gang massacres a band of Gypsy travelers and tries to escape blame as Cisco and Pancho investigate, but a survivor identifies the killers; when the Gypsies capture the ringleader and demand justice under their own law, Cisco wins the right to turn him over to the sheriff for lawful trial.

title: Double Cross Gila Bend (1955-08-30)
plotSynopsis: A crooked scheme in Gila Bend begins when Paul Morgan stages himself as a hero by killing wanted Tex Rollins, then joins local conspirators trying to profit from land needed for a railroad right-of-way, but Cisco uncovers the double cross, survives their attempt to eliminate him, and breaks the conspiracy.

title: Silk Hat Herbert (1955-09-01)
plotSynopsis: Silk Hat Herbert Hicks hides his criminal past from his sister Katie, then binds her, attacks banker Caleb Lewis for the vault combination, and attempts to rob the bank, but Cisco and Pancho intervene and capture Herbert before he can kill anyone or escape with the money.

title: Hermit of Tall Tree Mt (1955-09-06)
plotSynopsis: Rustler Link Foggin repeatedly evades the sheriff by using a hermit high on Tall Tree Mountain as a lookout who signals when the law approaches, but Cisco recognizes the signal system, traces it to the mountain, and helps the posse capture Foggin and his cattle thieves.

title: Ventriloquist (1955-09-08)
plotSynopsis: A traveling medicine-show ventriloquist and his small-statured partner use voice tricks, a wooden dummy, and murder to cover a string of express-office robberies, until Cisco recognizes the impersonation scheme and recovers the stolen money.

title: Lynch Mob (1955-09-13)
plotSynopsis: Tim Ritter and his partner murder and rob a storekeeper, frame George Keel for the crime, bind the sheriff, and whip up a lynch mob, but Cisco and Pancho stop the hanging and help the sheriff capture the gang and clear Keel.

title: Battle of Lost Mine (1955-09-15)
plotSynopsis: Badger King and North Young seize a long-lost mine that rightfully belongs to the late owner's heirs, then try to stop Cisco from guiding the family back to it and force them to sign away their claim, but Cisco and Pancho defeat the pair and restore the mine to its rightful owners.

title: Messenger of Doom (1955-09-22)
plotSynopsis: Cora Gammel and her brother use carrier pigeons to pass stolen cattle-shipment information from a stockyard to a rustling gang, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the secret message system and help break the operation before another herd can disappear.

title: Passport to Death (1955-10-04)
plotSynopsis: Powerful Boyd Moser owns nearly every important business in Toyar and uses hired killers to silence anyone who challenges his rule, but Cisco helps the town resist, protects cafe owner Sully and the sheriff, and brings Moser's private reign to an end.

title: Deputy Marshall (1955-10-06)
plotSynopsis: Popular Roy Seagland hides a ruthless outlaw career behind small favors and a friendly reputation while he and Matty Ellness rob a gold stage, but Cisco and Pancho are sworn in as deputy marshals, expose Seagland, and connect his partner to an earlier murder.

title: Counterfeit Money (1955-10-13)
plotSynopsis: Counterfeiters Bell Patton and Jumbo Mulligan use a newspaper office and printing press to manufacture convincing fake currency while plotting to kill a Treasury agent, but Cisco turns his outlaw reputation to advantage, uncovers the plates and bogus money, and delivers both men to the government.

title: Storm on the Lake (1955-10-18)
plotSynopsis: Two thieves overpower a lakeboat captain and steal his vessel so they can hijack a valuable silver shipment from the mines, but Cisco and Pancho pursue them across the water, survive a dangerous storm, recover the boat and silver, and free the captured crew.

title: Senor Bull Frog (1957-01-24)
plotSynopsis: At Angel's Camp, Pancho's pet bullfrog accidentally exposes gold dust being skimmed from miners at a cafe, drawing Cisco and Pancho into a murder case; framed and jailed, they survive an attempt to drown them by diverting water into the jail, then use physical evidence from Albany Flat to expose the killers and stop another murder.

title: Marshall of Gold Fields (1957-02-05)
plotSynopsis: Cisco arrives in lawless Goldfield as the territorial marshal charged with cleaning up the town, while a huge drifter named Arleigh becomes entangled in the crackdown because his mother believes he is the marshal; after Arleigh proves he is not a killer, Cisco shows mercy and sends him home to make good on her faith in him.

title: Horse Race at Fort Sumner (1957-02-07)
plotSynopsis: Two strangers arrive at Fort Sumner posing as respectable bankers and sponsor a dance and horse race to win the town's confidence, but their real plan ends in robbery and flight; Cisco and Pancho pursue the gang, recover Sam's stolen money, and bring the impostors in.

title: Ring of Fire (1957-02-12)
plotSynopsis: Men hired by a creditor try to destroy Paul Croft's historic Oregon cattle drive by setting a ring of fire around his herd, hoping his failure will forfeit the ranch securing his loan, but Cisco defeats the sabotage, recovers stolen payoff money, and proves Croft satisfied the debt.

title: The Flagstaff Diamonds (1957-02-14)
plotSynopsis: Outlaws Mike Mulligan and Buckeye Pierce ambush a trusted courier carrying one hundred thousand dollars in diamonds to a Flagstaff ranch, but Cisco and Pancho pursue the thieves, recover the jewel case, and deliver the attackers to the law while the wounded courier recovers.

title: Poker Chip Draw (1957-02-19)
plotSynopsis: Gambler and gunman Matt Rebstock kills a poker opponent after being challenged over suspected cheating and then joins another badman in resisting the town's new marshal, but Cisco exposes the crooked draw, defeats the pair, and helps the marshal bring them in for murder and other crimes.

title: Morbid Jones and the Water Rights (1957-02-21)
plotSynopsis: A rancher secretly diverts Finale Creek before it reaches Morbid Jones' land, intending to monopolize the scarce water and drive Jones out during a drought, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the illegal channel, stop the gunmen enforcing it, and force the culprit to pay for the damage and restoration of the Jones property.

title: Swindle at Steamboat Springs (1957-02-26)
plotSynopsis: Two confidence men arrive in booming Steamboat Springs with a cheap stage-prop helmet they claim was worn by Hernando Cortes, planning to manipulate a merchant into buying it through a fake outside bidder. Cisco recognizes the swindle, uses the Spanish paper hidden in the helmet to reverse their trick, and sends the pair out of the territory poorer than they arrived.

title: The Fresno Fire (1957-03-05)
plotSynopsis: Bank robbers exploit a bitter rivalry between Fresno's sheriff and honorary fire chief by setting the jail ablaze while Cisco and Pancho are locked inside, counting on the town's fire crew to be distracted as they rob the bank; Cisco and Pancho escape through the flames, stop the robbery, and force the feuding officials to cooperate so Fresno is better protected from both fires and criminals.

title: The Finnias Boys (1957-03-07)
plotSynopsis: Caleb Finneas breaks his brother Tony out of the Rollins jail so the pair can join their gang in robbing a railroad express car, while Cisco is deputized by the Medicine Bow marshal to bring Tony back; Cisco and Pancho are captured at the gang's camp but escape, reach the train before the dynamite robbery succeeds, and return Tony to the marshal while Caleb goes back to jail in Rollins.

title: Battle of Wagon Box Corral (1957-03-12)
plotSynopsis: A corrupt Indian agent and his accomplice deliberately inflame tensions between the Army and Red Cloud's Sioux, hoping a massacre will trigger a wider war; Cisco exposes the provocation, gets new repeating rifles and ammunition to the threatened soldiers, and has them demonstrate overwhelming firepower without killing a single warrior, prompting Red Cloud to call off the charge and allowing the conspirators to be brought to trial.

title: Opera in Albuquerque (1957-03-14)
plotSynopsis: Outlaw Arch Collins, bitter that soprano Della Morelli rejected him and married impresario Giuseppe Duran, ambushes their touring opera company and tries to force the couple to sign over their financial interests before drowning them; Cisco follows the gang, escapes Collins's trap and regains the upper hand, while Pancho helps round up the remaining gunmen, allowing the company and scenery to reach Albuquerque in time for Aida, with Pancho joining the triumphal march.

title: Judge Colts Law (1957-03-19)
plotSynopsis: Fugitives Harley Griswold and his partner return to the Monroe ranch seeking money hidden there by the late outlaw Dutch Monroe, while Dutch's son Kip wrongly believes Cisco murdered his father; Kip's mother reveals the truth about Dutch's criminal life, the fugitives admit their connection to his death and threaten the family for the stolen money, and Cisco uses a dynamite bluff to capture them before Kip turns the hidden loot over to the law.

title: Emerald of the Aztecs (1957-03-21)
plotSynopsis: Cisco is asked to investigate the theft of Walker's priceless Aztec emerald and traces the jewel to a known dealer in stolen goods, where the hotheaded young thief opens fire and Cisco and Pancho are imprisoned; the criminals then move against Walker to silence him, but Cisco escapes their trap, stops the gang, and brings the stolen emerald case to a close.

title: Wild Horse Hunt (1957-03-26)
plotSynopsis: Two ruthless gold seekers believe the legendary great white Mustang can lead them to the Lost Dutchman Mine and join a wild-horse hunt with Cisco, Pancho, and another prospector, but their greed turns murderous when they try to eliminate the others; Cisco survives their attacks, prevents them from destroying the Mustang's freedom, and sends the would-be killers to jail after the horse escapes and a landslide seals the mine away again.

title: When Killers Escape (1957-03-28)
plotSynopsis: Two convicted killers overpower the sheriff transporting them from Holbrook, return to town for guns and supplies, and threaten the storekeeper who could help stop their escape; Cisco and Pancho pursue them, are gun-whipped and dropped into a hidden well to drown, but climb out, catch the fugitives before they can kill again, and make sure the pair are returned to prison.

title: The Butterfield Overland Mail (1957-04-02)
plotSynopsis: Bandits rob a Butterfield Overland Mail coach carrying a valuable jewel shipment and a young girl traveling with her supposed French nurse, but Cisco discovers the nurse is part of the plot when her false accent slips, exposes the gang, recovers the stolen jewelry, and sees the child safely reunited with her father.

title: Westward to St Joe (1957-04-07)
plotSynopsis: Bandits disguised as Pawnee Indians attack travelers heading west from St. Joseph, seize diamond dealer August Wagner's valuables, and capture Pancho to lure Cisco into an ambush, but Cisco recognizes the false trail, frees Pancho, breaks the masquerading gang, and recovers the diamonds.

title: The Hook Murders (1957-04-09)
plotSynopsis: A series of killings in the Buchanan family appears to be the work of a mysterious hook-handed murderer, but Cisco discovers that a family member and a crooked lawman are using a sharpened hook to eliminate relatives for the inheritance and plan to frame a traveling salesman who once sold similar hooked tools.

title: The Angry Constable (1957-04-11)
plotSynopsis: Crooks in outlaw-ridden Gailyville exploit recently released Alex Purdy's reputation to frame him for a stage robbery while hot-tempered constable Frank Grant is eager to make an arrest, but Cisco proves the same gang committed the earlier store robbery that sent Purdy to prison, stops their attack on the jail, and finally clears Purdy's name.

title: The Johnson County Raid (1957-04-16)
plotSynopsis: John Meringue and a band of hired gunmen try to terrorize Bill Davidson and his father off their Johnson County ranch, even preparing to burn the buildings with the family trapped inside, but Cisco realizes Meringue has deceived him, joins the Davises' defense, and helps end the raid so cattlemen and homesteaders can return to peace.

title: The Run on Oklahoma Lands (1957-04-18)
plotSynopsis: Rufe Mason and Adley Brooks steal a locomotive before the Oklahoma land run, send it unmanned toward an eastbound train, and slip into the territory early so they can seize valuable land before the legal starting signal, but Cisco and Pancho prevent the train disaster and help stop the pair's attempt to steal the claim.

title: Old Dinah in Death Valley (1957-04-23)
plotSynopsis: Prospectors Sam and Dutch abandon their failed silver search and take jobs around the Harmony Borax Works so they can rob the workers' payroll, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the plan, stop the robbery, and leave the would-be thieves to face the law while the borax operation returns to normal.

title: Ghost Town Gazette (1958-06-24)
plotSynopsis: Former printer Harper Hendrix turns an abandoned mining town into a land swindle by publishing a fake Ghost Town Gazette filled with glowing stories meant to lure buyers into purchasing worthless property, but Cisco and Pancho uncover the fraud, survive an attempt to drown them in the Colorado River, and break the scheme.

title: Gold in the Conestoga
plotSynopsis: Josh Dunbar asks Cisco and Pancho to find his overdue brother Will, who is traveling west by Conestoga wagon, but escaping bank robbers have already taken over the wagon and hidden the stolen gold inside; a suspicious sheriff repeatedly mistakes Cisco and Pancho for the criminals, until Cisco captures the real robbers, recovers the bank's gold, and brings the wounded Will safely to his brother.

title: Montana Guns
plotSynopsis: Montana gunmen Baxter Fraley and Woody McLuhan plan to seize the Kane brothers' valuable cattle, provoke Joe Kane into a gunfight and kill him, then move against injured brother Tom; Cisco and Pancho track the killers, survive an ambush at a remote ranch, and use evidence from the murderer's horse to tie the pair to Joe's death and send them to jail.

title: Stagecoach Race at Skeleton Bend
plotSynopsis: Rival stage operator Martin Stair and gunman Moose Judson are determined to steal Mabel Hotchkiss's expiring U.S. mail contract, first trying to seize her new team, then burning the horses' barn, murdering her driver Luke, and sabotaging the coach brake before the deciding race through Skeleton Bend; with Pancho driving and Cisco using Diablo to help control the runaway coach, they survive the descent, expose the sabotage, and defeat the killers so Mabel keeps the mail route.

title: The Actor (1946-11-10)
plotSynopsis: A young woman's whirlwind romance with an apparently ideal man becomes terrifying when clues suggest he may be the murderer police are seeking.

title: All The Money In World (1946-11-17)
plotSynopsis: A struggling man suddenly receives the limitless wealth he has always wanted, only to discover that getting everything he wished for carries consequences he never imagined.

title: The Story Of John Littlefield (1946-11-24)
plotSynopsis: A man tries to escape his old life by staging his death and taking a new identity, but his carefully planned disappearance traps him inside the deception he created.

title: One Eyed Cat (1946-12-01)
plotSynopsis: A paralyzed man depends on a devoted nurse whose attachment grows increasingly possessive, turning care into a threat to his safety.

title: Jungle Drums (1946-12-08)
plotSynopsis: Two lovers enter the Amazon with murder in mind, but their plan unravels in the jungle as they become victims of a deadly trap of their own making.

title: Aunt Emmy (1946-12-15)
plotSynopsis: A holiday visit to an aunt's isolated home becomes increasingly frightening when a winter storm cuts a young woman off from help and exposes sinister secrets inside the house.

title: The Hunter and the Hunted (1946-12-22)
plotSynopsis: A party of privileged hunters ventures into the wilderness expecting sport, only to discover that something far more dangerous has turned them into the prey.

title: A Helping Hand (1946-12-29)
plotSynopsis: An innocent man is condemned for murder, but as execution approaches the real killer finally reveals himself in a confession that changes the case.

title: Reference Please (1947-01-05)
plotSynopsis: An arrogant wealthy man receives a strange reckoning after a dental mishap, as a ghostly accounting of his life forces him to confront the value of kindness and friendship.

title: Lively Ghost (1947-01-12)
plotSynopsis: A couple plotting to kill a wealthy husband for his money believes they are being haunted, only for the apparent supernatural revenge to conceal an even sharper twist.

title: The Return of the Vanished Wife (1947-01-19)
plotSynopsis: A man attempts to use the return of his supposedly dead wife as part of a murder frame-up, but the fiancée helping him with the scheme turns against him.

title: Spanglers Attic (1947-01-26)
plotSynopsis: A new bride becomes suspicious of her husband and the attic he keeps secret, where clues point toward the unexplained disappearance of his first wife.

title: The Bank Vault (1947-02-02)
plotSynopsis: A talented locksmith agrees to help rob a bank vault and quickly finds himself caught in a lethal struggle over money, trust, and betrayal.

title: The Hitchhiker (1947-02-09)
plotSynopsis: A traveling salesman picks up companions on the road and gradually realizes that his casual journey has turned into a dangerous game with people who may intend to kill him.

title: Dr Carters Experiment (1947-02-23)
plotSynopsis: Three escaped convicts seek refuge in a doctor's isolated laboratory, where the physician turns their own violence and cruelty against them in a calculated experiment.

title: The Man Who Lived Once Before (1947-03-02)
plotSynopsis: Recurring dreams convince a man that he once lived as a murderer in eighteenth-century France, and he is suddenly drawn back into that past life and its dangerous court intrigues.

title: The Good Valet (1947-03-09)
plotSynopsis: A former valet tries to blackmail his rich employer after witnessing a murder, but his attempt to profit from the secret exposes the greed that may destroy him.

title: Island Of Women (1947-03-16)
plotSynopsis: After being washed ashore on an isolated island ruled entirely by women, Tracy becomes the prize in a strange lottery that leaves him struggling to escape his unexpected status.

title: Pretty Cousin Amy (1947-03-23)
plotSynopsis: The quiet routine of a married couple begins to fracture when an attractive cousin arrives and stirs up hidden desires that threaten to turn domestic tension into something darker.

title: Past Or Present (1947-03-30)
plotSynopsis: A couple seeking shelter from a storm enters an old-fashioned inn and soon realizes they may have crossed into a place where the past is not finished with the living.

title: Man With the Strange Trunk (1947-04-06)
plotSynopsis: The owners of a roadside tourist house become curious about a traveler's heavily labeled trunk, only to discover that the baggage conceals a horrifying secret.

title: Star Crossed Lovers (1947-04-13)
plotSynopsis: A blind date becomes an immediate romance, but the lovers' sudden happiness is threatened by an unexplained turn of events that seems determined to separate them.

title: Hollywood Heartache (1947-04-20)
plotSynopsis: A woman claims her husband is trying to kill her for insurance money, but the story she tells begins to unravel as hidden facts point toward a very different truth.

title: The Criminal Mind (1947-04-27)
plotSynopsis: A brilliant detective believes he has committed an untraceable murder, yet the crime begins to collapse when people he counted on behave in ways he did not anticipate.

title: Guilty as Always (1947-05-04)
plotSynopsis: An ambitious prosecutor is suddenly mistaken for a dangerous escaped criminal and finds himself forced to experience the fear and vulnerability usually faced by the accused.

title: Only Death Is Timeless (1947-05-11)
plotSynopsis: A frantic couple trying to reach their injured son encounters a mysterious woman on the road whose strange presence suggests that some appointments with fate cannot be avoided.

title: Angel With Two Faces (1947-05-25)
plotSynopsis: A reporter falls in love with a woman recently cleared of murder, but his attempt to build a future with her uncovers disturbing evidence about the killing she escaped.

title: Coming Events (1947-06-08)
plotSynopsis: A fortune teller's ominous prediction shadows a couple after they win a sweepstakes prize, making their sudden good luck feel more like the beginning of a trap.

title: Island Paradise (1947-06-15)
plotSynopsis: A detective escorting a murderer back for trial survives a plane crash on a remote island, where the fugitive sees an opportunity to steal another man's identity and escape justice.

title: Thou Shalt Not Kill (1947-06-22)
plotSynopsis: A drifter discovers what appears to be a foolproof roulette system, but greed and betrayal turn his gambling fortune into bloodshed and a haunting burden.

title: Behind the Mask (1947-06-29)
plotSynopsis: A respected philanthropist is challenged by a sculptress who claims she can expose the primitive creature beneath his civilized appearance, forcing him to confront a frightening side of himself.

title: The Hypnotist (1947-07-06)
plotSynopsis: A hypnotist uses a vulnerable pickpocket as an instrument for murder, but his attempt to control another human mind ultimately creates the conditions for his own destruction.

title: The Manicurist (1947-07-14)
plotSynopsis: A woman who considers herself completely normal moves through a series of deadly encounters with men until she meets a sophisticated stranger whose own secret is just as dangerous.

title: Gus Fowler (1947-07-21)
plotSynopsis: After being told he is dying, a man makes a grim bargain involving his body, only to learn that the diagnosis was wrong and the agreement may be impossible to escape.

title: Flaming Frances (1947-07-28)
plotSynopsis: A couple becomes convinced their new maid is the notorious fire-setter known as Flaming Frances, and their suspicion turns the household into a dangerous confrontation.

title: Ted and Cora (1947-08-11)
plotSynopsis: A young couple thinks they have found an impossibly cheap dream home, but the house's violent history begins to exert a sinister influence over their thoughts and behavior.

title: Professor Leonard Higgens (1947-08-25)
plotSynopsis: An anthropologist brings a woman from a head-hunting culture into modern society as an experiment in civilization, only to watch the project descend into obsession, instability, and death.

title: Don Miguel (1947-09-01)
plotSynopsis: A jealous bull breeder plots to use his animals as instruments of revenge against his protégé, but the scheme turns back on him with tragic results.

title: Mikes Dream (1947-09-04)
plotSynopsis: A former policeman's drunken encounter with a mysterious woman pulls him into a nightmare of murder and betrayal where he can no longer tell fantasy from reality.

title: Sea Story (1947-09-11)
plotSynopsis: A cynical Key West boatman agrees to help a beautiful woman and soon realizes he is sharing the open sea with someone willing to kill to get what she wants.

title: Ophelia (1947-09-18)
plotSynopsis: When a fortune is left to a cat, the disappointed relatives try to remove the animal from the inheritance, only to discover that Ophelia is far harder to kill than expected.

title: Deadlier Than the Male (1947-09-25)
plotSynopsis: A hardened criminal flees from the woman who once worked beside him, discovering too late that his former partner is more relentless and dangerous than the enemies he usually faces.

title: TheJekyll andHydeGangster (1947-10-02)
plotSynopsis: A head injury changes a ruthless gangster into a gentle, timid man, but his new personality cannot protect him from the violent debts accumulated by the man he used to be.

title: Lefty and Delilah (1947-10-09)
plotSynopsis: A promising fighter becomes involved with a seductive woman whose influence draws him away from his career and into betrayal, murder, and an inevitable reckoning.

title: Hazel (1947-10-16)
plotSynopsis: A man trapped in an abusive marriage unexpectedly inherits after his wife dies under suspicious circumstances, raising uncomfortable questions about how convenient her death really was.

title: Natalie (1947-10-23)
plotSynopsis: A lonely widow gives a struggling stranger shelter and support, only to find that the man she hoped to rescue is gradually turning her own home into a place of fear.

title: Leon (1947-10-30)
plotSynopsis: A drifter joins a fake medium and his alluring wife in a confidence scheme, but murder and an apparent haunting make it impossible to tell where the fraud ends and the supernatural begins.

title: Consuelo (1947-11-06)
plotSynopsis: A clever thief becomes trapped between two dangerous gamblers, and her attempt to play both men for profit develops into a lethal contest of deception.

title: Eddie (1947-11-13)
plotSynopsis: A reporter marries a beautiful woman acquitted of murder, but during their elopement he discovers evidence that forces him to reconsider both her innocence and his own safety.

title: Lover Boy (1947-11-20)
plotSynopsis: A smooth con man builds an elaborate insurance swindle around deception and death, only to find that the layers of his own scheme make him vulnerable to the final double-cross.

title: Gertrude (1948-01-01)
plotSynopsis: A calculating husband tries to murder his wife and pin the crime on a vulnerable young woman, but the wife he underestimates turns his carefully arranged frame-up back on him.

title: Nicky (1948-03-04)
plotSynopsis: A woman devises a desperate scheme to make it appear that her husband has been executed, but the deception sends them into a nightmare where the boundary between escape and death begins to disappear.

title: Bad Dreams (1948-04-25)
plotSynopsis: A man's recurring nightmares of guilt, judgment, and execution grow so vivid that he can no longer be certain whether he is waking from the dream or entering it.

title: Bank Holiday (1948-05-02)
plotSynopsis: A bank teller is abducted during a robbery after her fiancé chooses his career obligations over her safety, forcing her to confront what their relationship has really become.

title: Liz (1948-05-09)
plotSynopsis: A sharp diner waitress discovers a wealthy man's dangerous secret and uses it to pursue a richer life, but her blackmail scheme draws her into a deadly contest of double-crosses.

title: UNTITLED (aka-Eddie Gaynor Framed For Murder) (1950-07-20)
plotSynopsis: Detectives probing a murder discover that Eddie Gaynor has been deliberately framed and follow the setup into a broader network of criminals and hidden motives.

title: UNTITLED (aka-Paradise Murder Case) (1950-07-27)
plotSynopsis: A murder investigation begins to unravel a suspect's carefully invented alibi and exposes links to an earlier robbery that give police a different view of the crime.

title: UNTITLED (aka-Two Young Girls Killed by Hit and Run Driver) (1950-08-03)
sortKey: 0|1950-08-03|00005|untitled (aka-two young girls killed by hit and run driver) (1950-08-03)
plotSynopsis: Police investigate what first appears to be a hit-and-run death and learn that the young woman was deliberately targeted because of a past accident and another person's distorted loyalty.

title: UNTITLED (aka-Man Dies of Poisoning) (1950-08-10)
